content.display-name: 10 Essential Pieces of Jewellery for Every Beginner
content.description: Thinking of curating your go-to jewellery stack but don't know where to start? Go through our list of must-have jewellery pieces for beginners for a shiny jump-start!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Festivals And Celebrations
10 Essential Pieces of Jewellery for Every Beginner An outfit qualifies as a complete ‘slay’ once the dazzling jewellery knick-knacks are incorporated – so is the opinion of sensational stylists worldwide! From providing a tasteful amount of edge and shine to the ensemble, jewellery helps accentuate a look, making it one for the exclusive pages of magazines. Are you a budding fashionista, just starting to develop an affinity and an eye for fashionable detail? Accessorising is a big part of making or breaking an outfit, taking it to the ‘Icon’ level seamlessly! So, if you’re planning to begin your style-search journey somewhere – we say, start with some much-needed sparkle! Mia by Tanishq brings a collection of everyday jewellery – crafted to echo an air of minimalism and elegance. So, stock up on the must-have jewellery pieces for beginners - adorn them with a wide range of aesthetics, create several ornamental arrangements and have the drip feel ‘fresh’ each time! Consider this blog as a guide to curating your own 'capsule wardrobe’ – but, an embellished edition.
How to Pick the Perfect Pieces of Jewellery as a Beginner? A capsule jewellery bank is essentially going to serve as your go-to ornament pile, that you are going to reach out for on most days. Substitute this capsule with wearable jewellery pieces aligning with your style and preference in metal/colour. This way, you can build your style little by little! While your jewellery stack will remain versatile featuring all the essentials – it is also sustainable on your end, to stick to a handful of pieces rather than buying more and potentially keeping them locked away in a cupboard. So, we recommend you opt for jewellery pieces which are timeless. Mia by Tanishq has found a blend between trends and classics – making the products perfect for wear down through several decades, keeping up with the popping Summer-Monsoon trends! Here are some points to consider while making the first 10 picks of essential jewellery and laying a foundation for your style evolution:
1. Choose Finely-crafted Pieces For starters, you can opt for minimal designs in jewellery, like finely crafted gold chains, pendants, stud earrings and gold-diamond rings. While being expressive in make, the minimal ornaments are easier to style with different types of looks – flawlessly complementing workwear, evening #OOTDs, morning-time ensembles, etc.
2. Opt for One of Each Type Pick out a necklace, a pair of earrings, a bracelet, an armlet, a toe ring – and whatever else calls to you! If you stock up on one of each jewellery type – you’re rarely going to feel like ‘something is missing’. Any time you want to go for a certain vibe, mix and match it with different pieces to embody your vision.
3. Go for a Mix of Metals Select jewellery crafted from different metals to add an element of versatility to your collection. This way, on days you feel like transforming to the ‘gold goddess’ – you can easily do it! However, even during your silver-obsession phases, shower in the glory of silver’s delicate, reflective lustre in the form of minimal metallic accents.
4. Let Your Personality Shine If you’re set to pick out the first 10 jewellery pieces, make sure they fuel your dynamic personality. Personalised jewellery has taken the fashion world by storm, and here’s your chance to invest in a material manifestation of your quirks and whims – a silver charm, a pair of drop earrings, a brooch, or anything that screams ‘you’!
5. Don’t Shy Away from Showstoppers While it’s important to have a bunch of everyday jewellery ready to be adorned at any given moment, there's still room for a show stealer or two! So, don't shy away from glistening options – like, that alluring, bold pair of semi-precious gemstone studded earrings or the intricately-designed pendant and gold chain. Experiment with gemstones like sapphires, emeralds, rubies, etc., and dance to the shine emanating from them! Play with shades, textures, and silhouettes and get as creative as you want.
The Top 10 Jewellery Essentials for Beginners When it comes to picking jewellery essentials every woman needs – there are a few different options to explore within Mia by Tanishq’s wellspring of aesthetic innovation. In fact, the list below mentions jewellery options that are not only perfect for the first-time jewellery buyer but also a seasoned jewel enthusiast's taste palette.
1. Gold Chains
A jewellery essential that you’re going to get the most wear out of – the timeless gold chain. Perfectly suited to a vast variety of styles – the ‘Classic Link 22 Kt Gold Chain’ is an ideal fit for your ‘oomph-moments’ through brunch dates, casual game nights, as well as corporate, slays!
2. Gold & Diamond Stud Earrings
Next on the list of essentials is the pair of stud earrings featuring a sleek, modern finish. The ‘Sleep Dual-Bar Gold & Diamond Stud Earrings' are perfectly wearable on the daily, composed of shine and intrigue through pattern - in equal parts! Pair the parallelly running, heavy-on-geometric-intrigue stud earrings characterised by a captivating golden hue and the brilliance of diamonds - with your cheery, daytime looks. Transform them into the ‘Stars of the Night’ by styling them with fancy, embellished numbers!
3. Gold Bracelets
Opt for a classic, chunky gold bracelet. Our pick features a bold modification of the time-transcending chain detail. Pair the ‘Bold Interlink 18KT Gold Bracelet’ with your monochrome or neutral fits and make your inclination towards the classic crumbs evident!
4. Plain Gold Rings
Next, pick out a plain gold ring that will be versatile enough to wear singly as a statement jewellery piece or as a layering piece alongside other rings. The ‘Classic Grooves 18KT Gold Finger Ring’ is a perfect match to your sophisticated ensembles featuring silk blouses, midi-pencil skirts and collared baby tees.
5. Gemstone Pendants
Once you’ve found the perfect gold chain according to your style, you can go on to select a pendant to match the vibe. For example, you can choose our ‘Mia Birthstone Pendant’ which features a planned glisten tuned to some clear-coded magic! Adorn the pendant alongside a gold chain as a surprise ‘pop of focus’ against your decolletage area; or match with silver accents and another sprinkle of colour to embody a delicate yet suave aura.
6. Gold & Diamond Drop Earrings
Here’s a go-to option for your special events – the gold drop earrings ft. a twist of irresistible sparkle and a fascinating, delicate pearly surprise. The pair of ‘Glimmering Teardrop Gold & Diamond Drop Earrings’ is an iconic take on the classic drop design. If you want to show up and stand out at any event, this pair is your ‘Holy Grail’. From desi-slays to chic couture – the drop earrings have got you covered drama-wise!
7. Rose Gold Jewellery
Take part in the ‘mixing metals’ trend by opting for a rose gold jewellery option. It is a romantic variation of classic gold ornaments. For example, choose our ‘14KT Rose Gold Chic Dual-Tone Rhombus Diamond Bangle’ and wear it as a statement piece for your date nights. Alternatively, you can pair it with other gold and silver options to test your stylistic horizons.
8. Silver Charms
Explore silver options within your budget to potentially get your hands on rare finds! For example, you can opt for silver charms representative of your passions, hobbies, likes or things that get you excited about the day! Choose our ‘Pink Blossom Flower Silver Charm’ featuring a graphic flower motif, representative of jolly days under the Summer days. If you love Summers or spend your time basking in daytime glory – wear a symbol of the same around your neck even while being hard at work within 4 concrete walls.
9. Silver Toe Rings
The toe ring can be quite a unique choice of jewellery – yet one that makes an expressive statement on its own. Once you’ve invested in a toe ring, you’re hardly ever going to want to switch it out. Make your affinity towards unconventional styling the focus of your daily looks and stand out as the fashion icon that you are.
10. Nose Pins
Do you want to be known as the ‘dope girl in a nose pin’? It’s bound to happen owing to the degree of star factor our ‘14KT Yellow Gold Diamond Nose Pin’ adds to an overall ensemble! Pair the nose pin with an array of different outfits to make your signature avatar take form and slay through happening nights!
Final Word on Finding the ‘It’ Jewellery Pieces By opting for essentials in jewellery, you can make sure that you never run out of blingy combinations! Begin with the timeless classics including gold chains, stud earrings and gold-diamond options – build it up from there. Consider your style, how often you’d like to wear your pieces and what you’d want to convey with your looks. Now that you are familiar with the must-have jewellery pieces for beginners, you can get to shopping right away. Here’s something to chew on: check out Mia by Tanishq’s latest jewellery selection to find a marvellous mix of essentials and ultra-sparkly options at super cost-effective rates!

content.display-name: A Guide to Curating the Perfect Bracelet Stack
content.description: Master the art of layering and curate the most iconic bracelet stacks with Mia by Tanishq, as you prepare for Valentine’s Week 2025!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Styling Tips & Guides
A Style Guide to Curating the Perfect Bracelet Stack for Your Valentine’s Day Look With February already upon us, the lovey-dovey scent of the air has started making all the more sense! After all, it is the designated ‘Month of Love’, with 14th February especially being reserved for the dearly adored. Whether you are celebrating the day in your lover’s embrace, planning an event-filled Valentine‘s Day brunch or having a cosy time to yourself - the perfect outfit is just what you need to get into the affectionate mood! With fashionistas, influencers and stylists around the world gravitating towards meaningful details and minimally-made knickknacks as parts of their outfits - layering jewellery has emerged as a major trend in 2025. Symbolic charms, soulful carvings, meaningful gemstones and more, coming together to form a concoction screaming ‘you’ - is the stylistic route we suggest you take; tap into your most authentic self so capable of loving! In this blog, discover how you can layer pieces together to form an iconic bracelet stack that shall ideally complement your Valentine’s Day outfit and markedly represent your unique love story through each inclusion.
V-Day Agenda: Stylish Bracelets & Loving Confessions This Valentine's Day, prioritise self-expression and have it serve as the statement of your loving intentions. Not only get to fully bear your soul out in front of your beloved but also get those deep-seated confessions laid on the table, this time. Whatever type of love you are celebrating, remember to pay tribute to yourself while at it. An award for your inner child who only wished to sparkle and thrive - give yourself some sparkle-coded razzle-dazzle and pair it with your Dinner date outfit! Have the 14th of February serve as a day to celebrate all kinds of love. Of course - we’re here to help you dress the part! When it comes to stacking bracelets together, the options for your exploration are endless. As a compassionate and modern brand, we are dedicated to artistic experiments with jewellery design - you have an extensive catalogue of shine-coded bracelets to flip through. Whether you have stylish diamond bracelets, trendy gold and diamond bracelets, unique gold bracelets, or anything else specific in mind – there is an ornament for you to consider buying, with us! On this Love’s Day, unleash your truest fashionable avatar, showing up and glowing up for your V-Day date. Have your beloved in awe of your confidence, your style and you are contagious aura!
How to Stack Bracelets to Narrate a One-of-a-kind Love Story?

Take the phrase ‘wearing your heart on your sleeve’ to the next level by styling your metaphorical love story in the form of a materialised bracelet stack. Have styling accessories become an outlet for you to express your innermost feelings, deepest desires and love for your favourite person this Valentine's Day!

Let us give you some pointers on how you can stack bracelets that narrate your unique love story for the world to visually marvel at:

1. Pick a Representative Charm: The best way to personalise a jewellery pick is to opt for a charm that you or the person you’re gifting to, personally connect(s) to. By choosing a charm like the heart motif representative of true and unconditional love; a floral motif indicating a love that first blossomed in the sweet Spring-Summer season or other symbolic charms - you shall convey your genuine fondness for the concept of being smitten. 2. Select Specific Colours & Meanings of Gemstones: Various gemstones incorporated in the bracelet mix shall convey different degrees of meaning. For example, you can opt for a bracelet featuring a ruby gemstone representative of a passionate and fiery love - vivacious and energetic, to say the least. This shall add to the story of your bracelet stack. Go a step further by pairing this with other gemstone bracelets like Topaz (representing vitalism, love and health) and Garnet (echoing the flames of inner fire, twin soul-like love and friendship). 3. Timeless Formulas of Gold & Diamond Aesthetics: Do you want to convey to the world that your love is set for the ages, unbreakable by the strains of time? Opt for a stunning gold and diamond bracelet stack, featuring all gold bracelets, diamond-studded features, and a mix of modernity here and there with glimpses of rose gold fantasy! This formula is for the timeless intrigue lovers – set to never go out of style, just like a good old love story.
Are Bracelets the Perfect Gifts for Couples Who Love Symbolic Jewellery? Oh, Yes!

Not only are bracelets as part of stacks, the ideal style statements and endorsers of a unique love story - they are also the perfect gifts for couples who love to accessorise. For both women and men, the perfect pick of bracelet shall help level up the everyday apparel selection!

Here are some types of bracelets you can opt for if you're shopping for a memorable V-Day gift for your significant other:

1. Gold Bracelets: A versatile direction in fashion, gold bracelets embody a style that’s here to stay. This shall be a timeless addition to your partner's jewellery stack. 2. Gold and Diamond Bracelets: The gold and diamond partnership is an adored pairing down through generations. Delicate in design and classic in stature - the gold and diamond bracelets are perfectly suited to your Valentine’s Day look. 3. Gemstone Bracelets: Gemstone bracelets are particularly meant for the fashionista who loves taking risks with her style, going the colourful route often, yet keeping it grounded in minimalism! You can gift your partner a gemstone bracelet featuring the colour that she/he is going to rock on Valentine’s Day. 4. Rose Gold Bracelets: Add a twist of romance to your pick of bracelet this Valentine’s Day by opting for a rose gold variation. While the gold maintains a timeless appeal, the hint of rose only adds to the theme of love.
Final Word on Choosing the Perfect Bracelets for a V-Day-Approved Stack Even when love is on your mind, clogging all your senses with its hypnotic scent - there is much to think about and plan. Especially, for days, like Valentine's, dedicated solely to affection - the pressure to speak love’s language fluently, is super high! But if you have your gift already hand-picked out, you’ve done half the work. So here’s a final note for our love-smitten soul, whether you’re planning to gift the diamond goodness to your love or yourself as a way to elevate your Valentine’s look – choose with intention! Explore our latest and trendy collection of bracelets to find your potential sparkling matches and unlock the creative power to be able to put together the most iconic bracelet stack. Convey your love story, and your personal perspective on fashion and feel the most like you as you slay and love in your one-of-a-kind style.

Why Invest in Solitaires?

Timeless Beauty
  • Singular Elegance The very essence of the best solitaire rings lies in its singular diamond setting. This simple yet powerful design highlights the diamond's natural beauty without any distractions. The diamond, in all its glory, becomes the centrepiece, making the solitaire a definitive statement piece.
  • Versatility A testament to their timeless beauty is the versatility of solitaires. Whether it's an evening gala, a business meeting, or a casual brunch, the best solitaire rings seamlessly fit any occasion, making them a go-to choice for many.
  • Enduring PopularityTrends in jewellery come and go, but the best solitaire rings have consistently remained in vogue. Their timeless appeal ensures that they never feel outdated or out of place, making them a perennial favourite across generations.
Value Appreciation

  • Global Acceptance Diamonds, especially solitaires, are universally recognised and accepted as valuable. Their global market ensures that they retain value across borders, making them a portable form of wealth.
Symbolism

content.display-name: Silver A Gift That Lasts A Lifetime: Bhai Dooj Gift For Your Sister

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Gifting
A Gift That Lasts A Lifetime: Bhai Dooj Gift For Your Sister Bhai Dooj is a time-honoured festival celebrated with zest, zeal, and fervour.The day is significant, not for the rituals, but for the beautiful and sometimes mischievous bond between a brother and a sister. While that love and hate relationship is irreplaceable and beyond any materialistic possession, gifting something special on this day enhances the charm it. So, why not plan and gift something as precious as her this Bhai Dooj. If you're browsing through various bhai dooj gift ideas for sister, you're in the right place.
Beauty TIp
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
Gifts For Sister: Searching Now
It's never been an easy task to find the best gift for sister on bhai dooj.Clothes? She has plenty.Perfumes? Last year's choice. Gadgets? Perhaps too impersonal for an occasion this personal.The ideal bhai dooj gift for sister needs to be something that stays close to her heart, reminding her of your love and bond. It needs to last a lifetime, much like your love for her. Now,let's put ourselves in her shoes. Imagine something that is timeless, exquisite and whispers tales of love and care every time she looks at it. Doesn't that sound like the perfect gift for bhai dooj for sister? content.display-name: Choosing the Perfect Earrings for Your Face Shape: A Stylish Guide

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Latest and Trending
Choosing the Perfect Earrings for Your Face Shape: A Stylish Guide Every individual has a unique face shape that makes him or her stand out. While this uniqueness is a beauty in itself, matching it with the right accessories can enhance its charm even further. Among these accessories, earrings play a pivotal role in adding the right touch of elegance. But, how do you find the right earrings for your face shape? Let’s dive deep into this stylish guide and discover the art behind this.
Beauty TIp
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
The Importance of Choosing the Right Earrings for Face Shape
Have you ever wondered why certain earrings make your friend’s face light up but seem out of place on you? The secret lies in understanding the importance of face shape.
Your face isn’t just the forefront of your expressions and emotions, it’s a canvas that responds differently to various styles of earrings. Picture this: A dress, tailored to perfection, highlighting every curve and angle of your body, making you feel like the best version of yourself. Now, replace that dress with earrings. The magic of finding the right earrings for face shape is no less than hunting down that dream dress for your figure. The apt earrings don’t just accessorise; they blend seamlessly, amplifying the innate allure of your facial contours.
Earrings for different face shapes
Round Face
For those with circular facial features where the width and length are nearly the same, it's essential to add some length and divert attention from the fullness. Dangling earrings or elongated styles work wonders for this shape. Avoid round earrings or hoops, as they might accentuate the roundness. Opting for geometric-patterned earrings for round face can be your fashion secret to looking chic every time!
Oval Face
Blessed with balanced proportions, the oval face shape is versatile and can pull off almost any earring style. However, to enhance this shape further, go for oval-shaped dangling earrings. They not only resonate with the face's symmetry but also add a touch of grace. When searching for the best earrings for oval face, consider teardrop designs; they mimic the face's natural shape and amplify its beauty.
Long Face
If your face is longer than it is wide, the aim is to create an illusion of width. Shorter earrings, especially studs or small hoops, can add a broader aspect to your face. You can also look for round earrings to bring attention to the width of your face. Remember, when you’re seeking earrings for long face, the key is to balance out the length with width.
Square Face
Those with a square face have prominent jawlines and a forehead that's roughly the same width. Softening the angles is the goal. Go for earrings that are medium to long in length but have rounded designs. Oval shapes or circular earrings can help in offsetting the sharp angles of a square face.
Heart-Shaped Face
If your forehead is the widest part of your face, tapering down to a pointed chin, you have a heart-shaped face. Balance out this shape by choosing earrings that are wider at the bottom, like teardrop or chandelier designs.
Find Your Perfect Fit! Your face is our inspiration, and to us, earrings are the artistry that accentuates its beauty. It's not about seeking the most lavish or the grandest earrings, but about identifying the pieces that celebrate your unique charm. As you think about adorning yourself next, keep in mind this wisdom about selecting earrings for face shape that truly complements you. Have you had a chance to delve into Mia by Tanishq's curated collection? Each earring, with its exquisite craftsmanship, is a testament to contemporary elegance. Our designs are not just accessories; they are a narrative, ensuring there's a tale for every individual, embracing all face shapes. Dive into Mia by Tanishq's world and let your earrings be more than ornaments; let them be a reflection of you. Here's to finding your perfect match!

content.display-name: A Guide To Choose The Perfect Gold Coin For Dhanteras

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Gifting
Every year, as the festival of lights draws near, households across India prepare themselves for one of the most auspicious times to buy gold on Dhanteras. The sparkling gleam of the precious metal finds its way into homes, bringing with it prosperity and happiness. However, with so many options available, you might find yourself wondering, "Dhanteras what to buy?" This guide will help you navigate the Dhanteras gold buying time, ensuring you make the perfect purchase.
Beauty TIp
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
Dhanteras Tradition: Buying Gold Coins
Gold, being a symbol of wealth and prosperity, has always been an integral part of Indian culture. On Dhanteras, buying gold is not just considered a luxury or an investment, but it is also seen as a way to invite the blessings of Goddess Lakshmi. The act to buy gold on Dhanteras is believed to bring good luck, fortune, and abundance in the coming year. Gold coins, in particular, are the most sought-after purchase during this time. These coins often feature engravings of auspicious symbols like Tulsi leaves, Lotus flowers, etc., further enhancing their spiritual significance. Families come together to select these gold coins, making the process a communal and cherished activity. The coins are then used in evening prayers, often placed beside the idols or images of the deities, as a gesture of gratitude and reverence.
 
Factors To Consider At The Time Of Buying Gold Coins For Dhanteras
When planning to buy gold on Dhanteras, there are essential factors one should be aware of. Some of the key elements to consider include:
 
Gold Purity
One of the foremost factors to look into while selecting gold coins for Dhanteras is their purity, often measured in karats (K). Pure gold is categorised as 24K. However, for added durability in jewellery or coin form, it is often alloyed with other metals, resulting in varying karat values such as 22K, 18K, and 14K. To ensure that you get the value for money, Mia by Tanishq only offers 24k and 22k gold coins.
 
Authenticity
For those buying gold coins for Dhanteras, especially with an investment perspective, ensuring the coin's authenticity is vital. When you buy gold coins from Mia by Tanishq, they come with their own BIS Hallmark and Certificate of Authenticity confirming the coin's weight, purity, and provenance.
 
Budget And Size
Gold coins for Dhanteras come in various weights and sizes. While smaller coins offer cost benefits and increased liquidity, larger ones might have a greater inherent value. When choosing the size of your gold coin, consider both your budget and storage availability
 
The Significance Of Different Motifs On Gold Coins When one decides to buy gold on Dhanteras, the choice often extends beyond the mere weight and purity of the gold. The engravings and designs on the coin, especially those inspired by nature, hold deep-rooted cultural and spiritual significance. Among these symbols, the Gayatri Mantra, mango leaves, lotus, and Tulsi leaves are particularly esteemed.
Shop Now
Gayatri Mantra Motif
The Gayatri Mantra, a revered hymn in Hinduism, embodies the essence of spiritual enlightenment and divine wisdom. When this spiritual essence is combined with the tradition of buying gold on Dhanteras, it elevates the purchase from a mere financial investment to a quest for spiritual prosperity. Gold coins inscribed with the Gayatri Mantra become symbols of both material wealth and spiritual growth. They not only serve as treasured assets but also as timeless reminders of one's heritage and the seamless blend of spirituality in everyday life. The inherent purity of gold parallels the mantra's purifying essence, making such coins a profound choice for those seeking a deeper connection during Dhanteras.
Shop Now
Mango Leaf Motifs
Mango leaves have been an integral part of Indian rituals and ceremonies for centuries. Revered for their auspiciousness, they are often hung at the entrance of homes during festivals and special occasions. Their vibrant green colour symbolises life and happiness. When people buy gold on Dhanteras and choose coins engraved with mango leaves, they are essentially inviting prosperity, fertility, and a barrier against negative energies into their lives. The mango leaf, in essence, serves as a symbol of blessings and protection.
Shop Now
Lotus Motif/div>
The lotus, with its roots in muddy waters but blooming beautifully above, symbolises purity, beauty, wealth, and the promise of new beginnings. It holds a special place in Indian mythology and is often associated with Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity. Therefore, when individuals buy gold on Dhanteras and select coins featuring the lotus, they are invoking the blessings of the goddess and the promise of a prosperous year ahead. The lotus serves as a reminder that beauty and purity can emerge from even the murkiest of situations.
Shop Now
Tulsi Leaf Motif
Tulsi, also known as the holy basil, is not just a plant but a revered goddess in Hindu tradition. It is synonymous with purity, devotion, and wellness. The presence of Tulsi leaves on gold coins emphasises the blending of spiritual wealth with material wealth. When one decides to buy gold on Dhanteras and chooses coins adorned with Tulsi leaves, it signifies a prayer for physical well-being, spiritual growth, and protection from harm. As Dhanteras graces our homes and hearts, the shimmer of gold coins not only promises prosperity but also bridges the realm of tangible luxury with spiritual significance. At Mia by Tanishq, we recognise the essence of this auspicious occasion. Our coins, engraved with motifs like the Gayatri Mantra, mango leaves, lotus, and Tulsi leaves, represent our dedication to intertwining age-old traditions with modern elegance. Given the cultural importance of the festival, we aim to offer not just a piece of gold, but a symbol of heritage, spirituality, and a promise of prosperity. So, let Mia by Tanishq guide your choice, ensuring you welcome home not just wealth, but stories, blessings, and the timeless spirit of celebration this Dhanteras. Happy Dhanteras!

page-attributes.page-description: Separate fact from fiction with our diamond myth-busting guide. Learn the Separate diamond facts from fiction with myth-busting guide.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Beginner's Guide
Diamond Myth Busting: Unveiling the True Shine of Diamond Facts Diamonds have captivated our imagination for centuries, symbolising love, luxury, and everlasting beauty. Their sparkling allure is undeniable, but so are the myths and misconceptions that surround them. Diamonds are not just beautiful; they're also fascinating, and they possess a rich history. However, many diamond facts have been perpetuated. So, whether you are buying a diamond ring, a mangal sutra, or any diamond jewellery of your choice, you must get your diamond facts right.
Myth 1: Bigger Diamonds are Always Better One of the most pervasive myths about diamonds is that bigger is always better. While it's true that large diamonds are often associated with luxury and grandeur, size is just one factor that contributes to a diamond's value. The diamond fact is that the gemstone is judged by the "Four Cs": carat weight, cut, colour, and clarity, and not just size. The carat weight of a diamond refers to its size, but it's essential to understand that a larger carat weight doesn't necessarily guarantee a more valuable or more beautiful diamond. The cut of the diamond plays a crucial role in how it reflects light and sparkles. When it comes to colour, diamond’s interesting fact is that it comes in various shades, not just the traditional white or clear. Diamonds can be found in stunning colours such as yellow, pink, blue, and even red. The value of a coloured diamond is determined by the rarity and intensity of its colour. Additionally, clarity is a key factor in assessing a diamond's quality. Few diamonds are entirely flawless, as most contain tiny imperfections known as inclusions. These inclusions can be invisible to the naked eye, making them less significant in determining a diamond's overall beauty and value.
Myth 2: Diamonds Can't be Recycled It's a common belief that diamonds are forever and cannot be recycled or repurposed. However, the diamond fact is that it is one of the few materials that can be recycled, and there are various methods to do so. One of the most eco-friendly ways to recycle diamonds is through diamond cutting and repolishing. When a diamond is recut and polished, it can regain its original brilliance and sparkle, making it as good as new. This process allows diamonds to be repurposed and used in new jewellery designs. Furthermore, diamonds can also be removed from old or unwanted jewellery and set into new settings, giving them a fresh life. This not only allows you to create custom pieces but also reduces the environmental impact of mining new diamonds. So, if you own old diamond jewellery that you no longer wear, consider recycling or repurposing these precious gems to breathe new life into them.
Myth 3: Diamonds are Only White/Clear When most people think of diamonds, they envision clear, sparkling gems. However, the reality is that diamonds come in a spectrum of colours, and these coloured diamonds are far from ordinary. One of the amazing facts about diamonds is that coloured diamonds are graded based on the intensity of their colour, with pure and vivid colours being the most valuable. Some famous coloured diamonds include the Hope Diamond, a deep blue diamond, and the Pink Star, one of the largest and most valuable pink diamonds ever found.
Myth 4: Diamonds are Not a Good Investment It's a common misconception that investing in diamonds is not a wise financial decision. Diamonds are not typically seen as speculative investments like stocks or real estate. But they can indeed be a valuable addition to your investment portfolio if approached with the right knowledge and strategy. One of the key aspects of investing in diamonds is understanding their value factors, including the Four Cs mentioned earlier. High-quality diamonds tend to appreciate in value over time, especially rare-coloured diamonds or those with exceptional characteristics. However, it's essential to buy diamonds from reputable sources and have them certified by recognised gemological laboratories to ensure their quality and authenticity.
 
Don’t Miss Out - Get Your Facts! In this journey through diamond’s interesting facts and associated myths, we've uncovered a wealth of fascinating diamond facts about these timeless gems. While myths like "bigger is always better" and "diamonds can't be recycled" have been debunked, the truth about diamonds is even more captivating. So, the next time you admire a diamond's brilliance, you can appreciate it not only for its beauty but for the fascinating diamond facts and truths that make it even more precious. Diamonds are a true testament to the wonders of the Earth and the ingenuity of humans, and their timeless appeal will continue to shine brightly for generations to come.

What is Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold?

Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold is a safe and transparent platform for buying/selling/exchanging “SafeGold” offered by Digital Gold India Private Limited (“DGIPL”) in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. Mia Digital Gold is neither financial product nor a deposit but a method of purchasing gold for your personal needs. Each time you purchase SafeGold from the Platform, Gold will be purchased on your behalf on the basis of clear funds being made available by you for the transaction. Gold in grams up to 4 decimal places shall be credited to your account.

What is SafeGold?

SafeGold is a product of DGIPL- an institutionally owned company, where the World Gold Council is a minority investor (through World Gold Council (India) Private Limited).

Who can buy Mia Digi Gold?

All Indian citizens with a valid PAN Card can buy Mia Digital Gold. Please note NRIs can neither purchase, sell or redeem Mia Digital Gold.

What is the Purity of SafeGold offered through Mia Digital Gold?

Mia Digital Gold offers SafeGold which is 24 Karat Gold of 995 fineness (99.5% pure) or higher purity which are LBMA “good delivery” bars sourced by DGIPL from trusted sources.

What is the minimum and maximum amount I can purchase through Mia Digital Gold?

The minimum amount of purchase is Rs. 100. There is no maximum amount, subject to the completion of KYC verification for your account.

Is there a minimum lock in period?

There is no minimum lock in period- you can make a one-time purchase of SafeGold, without being obligated to make any fixed or periodic payments. You can choose to sell any amount of gold at the live sell price starting with minimum of Re. 100/- to maximum of the amount of gold that you own.

Where can I sign up to purchase this?

You can register through Mia's online platform (http://www.tanishq.co.in/digigold/home). You will be required to provide your name, mobile number, email address, pin code and PAN to get started. At stores, you can only redeem the SafeGold Balance that is available in your account, but buy and sell is possible only through the Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold platform.

Can I pay through Post Dated Cheques?

No, this is an entirely digital product, and hence Post-Dated Cheques (PDCs) are not available as a payment method for this product.

Can I cancel my purchase order to buy SafeGold ?

No, you cannot cancel the purchase order of gold once it has been successfully placed on the platform.

Where can I find the invoice for each order?

If your email address has been provided, an invoice shall be emailed to you as an attachment after each successful transaction. It is also available on the platform, by clicking on the invoice button.

How can I get my holding statement?

An online statement will be available at all times on the platform.

Can I open a joint account?

No, you cannot open a joint account for Mia Digital Gold powered SafeGold.

Is the gold associated with my accumulations kept in safe custody?

The gold purchased on your behalf is stored with Brink's, the leading safe keeper of precious metals across the world. The gold is insured, for both storage and transit when being delivered to you. Further, the Security Trustee has a charge on all gold stored in the vault in your favour. This ensures that your gold is protected at all times regardless of any external events.

What is the role of the “Security Trustee”?

The gold purchased on your behalf is stored with Brink's, the leading safe keeper of precious metals across the world. The gold is insured, for both storage and transit when being delivered to you. Further, the Security Trustee has a charge on all gold stored in the vault in your favour. This ensures that your gold is protected at all times regardless of any external events.

What will happen to the gold associated with accumulations in my account, in the unlikely event of the SafeGold going into liquidation?

The gold associated with the accumulations in your account is separate from the other assets of the SafeGold. IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited, an independent trustee, acts for and on your behalf. The gold purchased by DGIPL associated with the accumulations in your accounts is held with the Custodian. When you ask for delivery, the requisite quantity of gold will be removed from the Custodian and delivered to you through a reputed courier service. Since the Security Trustee has a charge over the gold, any unlikely adverse event happening to DGIPL will not affect the gold associated with the accumulations in your account. Further, the title of the gold clearly rests with you and the physical gold stored with the Custodian on account of SafeGold customers is not an asset of SafeGold in any way.

Who will insure the physical vault?

The secure storage provider (Brink's) has a comprehensive, global insurance policy that includes the insurance cover on your gold stored in their vaults. In addition, DGIPL has an additional insurance policy to cover gold in transit.

What is the maximum period of time for which my gold can be stored with DGIPL?

You can store your gold with DGIPL for a period of 10 years from the date of purchase. The custody shall be without charge for the first 5 years, and thereafter, will continue to be stored by DGIPL for a nominal fee to cover storage costs. You will be intimated in advance of being charged the fee, and will have the option to sell or request delivery of your gold at all times.

What will happen to my gold if my account is not operational on the platform?

We will always endeavour to provide you with immediate access to your gold. If, however, your account has been suspended for any reason, we would request you to get in touch with DGIPL’s customer service centre, in order to reactivate your account and access your gold once again. Customers may get in touch with Mia's customer service centre as a secondary recourse.

Why is there a difference between SafeGold Rate and Mia Ecom rate?

The Gold Rate in SafeGold is the price of Raw Gold that is being traded in the commodity markets which is influenced by various macroeconomic factors including global commodity pricing and Rupee valuation against USD. This Gold rate is not the selling gold rate of a finished product. There are operational costs involved even after raw gold is purchased from the market to convert the gold for amenability to make jewellery and these processing costs are why the Gold Rate of all jewelers (not just Mia) differs from the commodity rates. In addition, the SafeGold rate varies based on the time of the day, as there are intra-day price movements in the commodity market as well.

How do I sell my gold?

Mia Digital Gold Platform provides a live sell price quote. You can choose to sell any amount starting with a minimum of Re 100 to a maximum of the amount of SafeGold that you own. The sell quote may be temporarily unavailable in the unlikely event of a disruption in the bullion market. To sell your gold, you can enter the amount in rupees or gold in grams. You will be required to fill in the bank details, which will be verified. Upon verification and the sell transaction being successful, the sale proceeds will be credited to your verified bank account by DGIPL within 5-7 working days.

Where do I get the proceeds when I sell my gold?

When you sell your gold, you’ll receive funds against it in a verified bank account in your own name. You can add your account details prior to the sale, which will be verified by DGIPL. Once the verification is complete, you’ll receive the proceeds post the sale of your gold, within 5-7 working days. If the sell transaction has been made on Friday/Saturday or Sunday, then you will receive your sales proceeds by Tuesday of the following week.

What happens if the sales proceeds are not credited to me within 7 working days?

If the sales proceeds have not been received within 7 working days of the transaction, please email our customer service team at tanishqdigitalgold@titan.co.in with your related transaction details, and we shall resolve your issue.

I’m facing issues with bank account verification, what should I do?

In case you are facing any issues with uploading your proof of Bank account documents or completing the verification, please reach out to our support team with a screenshot of the issue on tanishqdigitalgold@titan.co.in

Why is the SafeGold Sell Price different from the SafeGold Buy Price?

DGIPL offers international grade bullion from institutional suppliers and sells this to consumers. When customers sell the gold back, the gold is sold back to institutional participants in the wholesale bullion market, where the buyback rate is lower than the selling rate – this is referred to as the buy-sell spread. In addition to the buy-sell spread in the commercial bullion market, GST is added to the buy price, but it is not levied on any sell transactions. Further, there are charges incurred on the payment gateway, trustee, insurance and custodian fees which also contribute to the difference in buy and sell price.

Can I cancel my sell order/request of gold sell?

No, you cannot cancel the order once it has been successfully placed on the platform.

What happens to the SafeGold Balance in the event of a Customer’s death?

In the event of your death, as per the process specifically allowed by DGIPL , and subject to the required due diligence, the title to your gold lying in the vault and your account shall transfer to your legal heir, subject to legal heirs providing valid documents to the satisfaction of DGIPL to prove their heirship.

Once I buy Mia digital gold how soon can I sell?

Users can sell their Mia digital gold after 3 working days of making the purchase.

What is the process for converting my SafeGold balance to jewellery?

You can redeem your SafeGold balance at the SafeGold sell rate for jewellery online or offline, exclusively at Mia or CaratLane retail stores or by visiting the appropriate websites, by following the process below:
Retail Store:
1. You may use the SafeGold balance which is converted to value based on the prevailing SafeGold Sell rate (“Redemption Value”) towards payment for the jewellery product selected. You may please note that the value of the jewellery to be purchased will be calculated based on the gold rate prevailing at the Mia/CaratLane store and making charges and any other charges will be extra (“Purchase Value”). You may have to pay any differential amount to Mia, if the Purchase Value is higher than the Redemption Value.
2. Share your registered mobile number as requested, along with the SafeGold Balance you wish to exchange.
3. You will receive an OTP to confirm the transaction.
4. On verification of the OTP, your SafeGold balance shall be transferred to Mia and adjusted against the price of the product calculated based on the prevailing rates at the Mia/CaratLane stores.
5. Any discounts or store offers, as may be applicable, will be extended to you.
Online Channel
1. You may use the SafeGold balance which is converted to value based on the prevailing SafeGold Sell rate (“Redemption Value”) towards payment for the jewellery product selected. You may please note that the value of the jewellery to be purchased will be calculated based on the gold rate prevailing at the Mia/CaratLane website and making charges and any other charges will be extra (“Purchase Value”). You may have to pay any differential amount to Mia, if the Purchase Value is higher than the Redemption Value.
2. Add the product to the cart and place the order
3. Enter the shipping details on the shipment page
4. On the payment page click on the Digital Gold tab
5. You can view the Mia Digital Gold balance or other SafeGold balance you are currently holding. Ensure you are using the same mobile number with which you have registered with DGIPL. The amount is calculated as per the SafeGold Sell rate for the grammage you are holding
6. Enter the amount that you wish to redeem. Minimum of Rs. 100.
7. You will receive an OTP on the registered mobile number, enter the OTP.
8. On verification of the OTP, your digital gold balance shall be transferred to Mia and adjusted against the price of the product calculated based on the prevailing rates on the Mia/Caratlane website
. Your digital gold balance and will reduce accordingly.
9. Any discounts or platform offers, as may be applicable, will be extended to you.
Note: Users can only redeem their Mia digital gold after 3 working days of purchase.

Can I convert my SafeGold balance at any Mia store?

Yes, you can redeem your SafeGold Balance for jewellery at any Mia or CaratLane retail store or even through the Mia/CaratLane online platforms.
Note: Users can only redeem their Mia digital gold after 3 working days of purchase.

Can I exchange my SafeGold balance at any other jewellery chain?

If you have purchased from Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold, you can only exchange it for jewellery at Mia or CaratLane stores or online platforms.

Can I exchange the SafeGold I have purchased on other platforms at Mia stores as well?

If you have purchased SafeGold on any other platform, you can exchange it for jewellery at Mia/CaratLane stores through the same process as above.

Can I request for physical delivery of my SafeGold?

You can request physical delivery of gold by visiting www.safegold.com and on as many occasions as you want. You will be required to log in using your registered mobile number, and transferring the gold balance you wish to have delivered, to your SafeGold wallet. Since it is not physically possible to deliver a fractional quantity of gold, the minimum quantity for which the delivery can be made has been kept as low as 0.5 gram and in multiples of 0.5 gram. You can select the quantity and denomination of the gold you wish to withdraw from the available options of coins. Each coin will have different making charges, based on the weight and design of the coin. You must confirm the transaction by paying the additional making and delivery charge. The coins will be delivered at your notified address by a logistics provider arranged by DGIPL, and you will receive a confirmation on your registered mobile number. The delivery can be tracked at any time by logging into the platform. In case of delivery of coin/ bar, the shipment will be mandatorily delivered to your registered address as provided by you and confirmed at the time of delivery request. DGIPL maintains a list of serviceable pin codes, and prior to making any purchase. You will be informed whether their pin code is serviceable by DGIPL. Note: Users can only redeem their Mia digital gold after 3 working days of purchase.

Can I change/cancel my delivery order?

Once you place a delivery request, you must accept the delivery made to you. It cannot be changed, cancelled or delivered at a later point in time.Please visit www.safegold.com for further details on the delivery of gold process.

Are there any charges for delivery of gold?

Yes, you will be required to pay the minting/ making charges, delivery charges and applicable taxes. All coins are independently assayed to certify purity and delivered in tamper proof packaging. Charges may be viewed on www.safegold.com.

What happens to my gold if I deactivate or close my account with SafeGold balance present?

At the time of deactivation, you will be offered the option to withdraw your SafeGold balance or request for delivery of your gold.

I have some queries regarding my gold account, how can I get in touch?

Please raise a ticket or get in touch with Mia's customer service centre, through tanishqdigitalgold@titan.co.in. Mia is available to provide the first level of support and SafeGold shall be available to address any questions/issues that may be escalated.

Is there any regulator or Grievance redressal mechanism?

SafeGold is neither a Collective Investment Scheme nor a Deposit. Thus, does not fall under the purview of SEBI or RBI, and there is no regulator for this product offering. To ensure that your interest is of foremost importance, a Security Trustee has been appointed for SafeGold. For any grievances specifically in relation to your gold purchase and related transactions, you can approach the Security Trustee.

page-attributes.page-title: Perfect Gold & Silver Gifts for Father’s Day: Timeless Gift Ideas | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Looking for the perfect gifts for Father’s Day? Treat your ‘Hero’ with a special token of love in the form of sophisticated gold & silver jewellery!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Gifts that Count: Find the Perfect Gold & Silver Gifts for Father’s Day
With Father's Day just around the corner, it is almost the perfect time to show your dad how important he is to you. From being your ‘ultimate Hero’ and role model to teaching you important life lessons as you go - Dad deserves to feel like ‘the idol’ he is in your life!
From running around the home on Sundays to playing one-on-one badminton matches with him on cosy cold Saturdays - he always had abundant hours to spare for his dear child! So, for all the times he let you win that board game match, just to see the toothy smile plastered on your face - buy him a thoughtful gift this Father's Day as a sweet ‘thank you’.
While purchasing gifts for Father's Day, you sure would want to make them count! Being a unique choice, gold and silver jewellery pieces are great contenders for the crown naming ‘the perfect gift’. From rings & chains to bracelets - the jewellery pieces hold ultimate sentimental value.
Additionally, with Mia by Tanishq’s signature minimalistic & refined style at play, you’re sure to find the ideal, subtle & classy giftable for your Hero in no time!
Beauty Tip
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
5 Best Gift Ideas for Dad on Father’s Day
Selecting gold and silver jewellery as gifts remains a timeless move. To particularly find pieces that suit your father’s ‘cool daddy vibes’, you must check out Mia by Tanishq’s collections of simple, sophisticated and subtle jewellery. These lightweight jewellery pieces can be worn by him daily - in fact, he would never want to take them off because of how comfortable they are!
Here are our top 5 picks of unique & memorable gifts for your Dad of the Year:
Chains
Plain gold chains are timeless essentials in jewellery. Your dad will not only be super comfortable in the lightweight 'Chic Charm 22KT Gold Chain’ but also be reminded of his beloved child with every glance in the mirror.
Gold chains are the epitome of confidence and swag. So, if your father loves to experiment with classic combinations of suit sets with bows and formal wear, a gold chain would be the perfect accessory to elevate the look.
A gold chain is also the ‘it’ accessory to wear all year round, regardless of incoming & outgoing trends! Owing to its classic make, your dad is going to feel cool and put-together at the very same time.
Gold Rings
Does your dad make efforts towards grooming himself every single day? He, who is striving to be the best version of the whole family, deserves to be treated well on the day dedicated to him! The 'Warli Whirlwind 22KT Gold Finger Ring’ is the ideal accessory to make an outfit 10x more polished and intentionally stylish.
Mia by Tanishq presents several distinctive designs of gold rings, whose splendid yellow sheen stands out even in the most crowded room. Your father will not only be able to adorn the luxurious 22KT gold ring on special occasions but also style it with his daily outfits - taking them to the next level of ‘sophistication’.
Brooch
The Silver Dragonfly Brooch Embellished With Open Polki is a one-of-a-kind accessory to add to an outfit. It casts a fashionable-forward spell on the look, further infusing visual appeal to the ensemble.
Your dad’s kurta and dhoti combo for the family function will immediately be taken to the ‘fancy’ category! Also, for any formal party wear, this brooch will add that extra shine to the classic formal look.
Silver Bracelets
Another jewellery item that your father can wear through the seasons and evolving trends is the silver bracelet! While silver adds an elegant touch to the get-up, dainty silver jewellery is also wearable daily.
Plus, it is the perfect choice if you're on a budget. At affordable rates, you can opt for chic silver bracelets for men they can wear every other day to work. Opt for the 925 Silver Unique Subtle Bracelet and witness it quickly become your father’s most prized possession!
Gift Cards
Finally, a gift card is a fitting present if your dad is fickle-minded when it comes to style. Let him pick out his present while you can #KahoKuchSpecial in your way! He can choose jewellery pieces on his own - something that he feels more comfortable in.
Whether Dad wants to try out a new, suave look or a simple, classic one which speaks to his old-school soul - he can use our special Mia gift card to make the purchase.
If you think the above-mentioned items align with your dad's choices, make sure to explore them in further detail on our website!
Points to Consider While Shopping for ‘The Cool Dad’
While it can be somewhat difficult to shop for your dad, it shouldn’t be an impossible task. Especially not, if you keep the following points in mind while shopping:
● Understand His Style: Once you get a grip on Dad's perspective on style, it will be much easier for you to pick out jewellery he would genuinely love wearing on repeat. For example, if he’s mostly dressing for work, opt for a subtle and sophisticated piece. On the other hand, say you're preparing to go on a family trip - you can help him jazz up his holiday looks with the incorporation of more sparkle through jewels!
● Accommodate His Lifestyle: Understand how often your dad would like to wear the jewellery pieces. Accordingly, choose lightweight jewellery for daily wear or intricately detailed ones for a chic-event look.
● Know Your Budget: If you keep a budget in mind, you can shop for the best jewellery gifts for your father in much less time. Mia by Tanishq puts you first - prioritising affordability alongside quality. So, make your choice of jewellery within your budget on our website; help your dad graduate to the ‘Icon’ level!
Final Word Before You Go Rant to Your Dad Again!
Jewellery pieces are a timeless option, especially so for men. As dads are notoriously known not to think much about themselves, the beloved children come to the rescue of their constantly sacrificing souls!
So, express your love and appreciation for him through a token of shine. Whether you buy him a gold chain or a silver brooch, it will be something he will treasure forever. The child he has raised so well has finally grown up to give him everything he deserves. Not only is this gifting moment one filled with pride, but marks a milestone in every father's life - so, make it count!
Mia by Tanishq introduces the freshest collections of jewellery for men which are sure to draw a trickling tear or two from even the strictest dad’s eyes! So, explore our catalogues to find the best gifts for Father’s Day at cost-effective prices.

page-attributes.page-description: Are you out of sparkly gift ideas for your best friend? Mia by Tanishq has got your back with fresh, sparkling jewellery designs!Check out these unique gift ideas that are sure to make your best friend smile.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Ideas For Gifting
Perfect Jewellery Gift Ideas for Your Best Friend One always thinks of one's childhood with great adoration for simpler times, especially owing to the innocent friendships they established through the formative years. While a lot of people lose touch with their childhood 'sisters a.k.a best friends', some retain the family-like bond and are blessed with a lifelong connection, free of judgment. If you have such a friend in your life, we understand how important they must be to you. Sometimes you find your soulmate guise as your best friend, later in life. Maybe, she made your college days a little more liveable or your teenage years’ character a little less insufferable - she has been your friend, confidant and advisor. As you grow older, you start to see her worth more and realise that this ‘real one’ cannot get away! If this best friend has been there for you all your life, standing by your side through thick and thin, it makes perfect sense that you’d want to treat her to something valuable. Whether it's her first time cracking a job interview, getting one more promotion under her sleeve or simply her birthday - a sparkly gift enclosed in the essence of precious jewels, can never go wrong. This blog shall discuss different gift ideas for your best friend that are fit for mesmerising the style-driven soul - take into consideration her passion for fashion and a soft corner for sentiment.
How to Choose the Perfect Gift for Your #BFF? Now that you have settled on jewellery as your choice of gift, the next step would be to make the perfect pick. Consider your best friend's clothing style, usual aesthetic, and preference in colours, metals and gemstones - accordingly, narrow down your selection pool. Here are some pointers to consider while making your final jewellery pick for the ‘flower’ of a friend in your ‘Garden of Life’: Apart from personal style being a major factor to consider, while picking the perfect anniversary gift for your beloved, here are some suggestions that shall simplify the gift-selection process:
1. Chalk Out a Budget If you have a specific budget, you’ll be able to limit your search to certain jewellery pieces. While it’s difficult to resist buying every sparkly item listed on our website, chalking out a budget shall help you choose the ones that will suit your best friend’s style the most. Based on your budget, you can go for a statement piece that you know she’ll love and wear repeatedly, through different aesthetic phases. Alternatively, you can curate a sparkly set, underlining a common theme, to rejuvenate her entire jewellery stack!
2. Consider her Preference in Metal Notice whether she leans more towards gold jewellery or silver accents. If she likes a classic, timeless silhouette radiating #boujee vibes - gold chains, pendants and earrings shall perfectly do the job, turning up the pizzazz in her daily looks. On the other hand, if she has an artistic fervour about her, she might like to dive into a stylish pile of silver knickknacks to accentuate her one-of-a-kind 'fit’-checks every other day.
3. Reflect Her Aesthetic through Your Pick When choosing jewellery for your loved one, reflect their aesthetic by considering their personal style, preferences, and personality traits. If she adores a classic and elegant vibe, opt for timeless pieces coated in boundless essence. If she has an experimental style and likes to express herself in terms of fresh takes on trends, choose bold and whimsical designs like a colourful gemstone-studded ring or a pair of statement earpieces.
4. Create a Fun Mood Board You and your best friend can have a fun little inspo-board-making session! Go through different aesthetics trending on social media and pick out the images you visually find appealing. Have your bestie do the same. While you can catch up over this bonding session, you can also pin down her specific interests and preferences in style, colours and vibes. Based on this, you can pick out ornaments suited to her visual taste. We know that you are barely controlling your urges to give your bestie the entire world, but trust us when we say - the above-mentioned points are all that you need to slay this gifting moment! By paying close attention to your bestie’s daily choices, you can present her with jewellery she sees herself represented. This can serve as a symbol of your unbreakable bond and the accompanying message shall resonate with her thoughts. So, pick out jewellery that shall align with her one-of-a-kind taste for aesthetics, love for the cheers of a season and her quirks that make her authentically, 'herself'!
Types of Jewellery: Pamper Your Bestie & Shower Her with Love & Shine There are a myriad of jewellery options available to discover online, with Mia by Tanishq. So, keeping in mind your best friend's unique preferences and taste in fashion, you can proceed to crown your ‘jewel’. Here are some unique gift ideas to treat your best friend to the sparkliest knick-knacks, almost on par with her radiant and passionate soul:
1. Evil-eye Pendants
The Evil Eye pendant shall serve as a thoughtful gift for your #BFFforLife as it not only features a pop of navy blue alongside the polished finish of 14KT yellow gold but also hosts a landmine of positive manifestations. This motif is particularly trending all over social media platforms currently, owing to its associations with a protective aura being cast upon the wearer. So, while you are already checking off the style factor with this purchase, you are also investing in a piece that shall convey volumes of sentiments. Express your appreciation and well wishes for the 'angel' in your life and have her dazzle in gleaming fonts as she adorns this quirky neckpiece.
2. Gold & Diamond-studded Earrings
As you may have heard at least once in your lifetime, ‘diamonds are a girl's best friend’. So, what better gesture than to present your human-diary with a dainty pair of trendy and personality-rich diamond studded earrings? The butterfly motif is particularly trending this season and has been for quite a while, on its way to quickly granting itself the status of a ‘timeless’ design. If your bestie adores summer-adjacent, bright themes and sunny moments under palm trees’ swaying shadows - gift her our ‘Twilight Butterfly 14KT Gold & Diamond Stud Earrings’ as a material manifestation of this contagious energy!
3. Glowy Rings
Glowy rings are a modern take on the classic gold bands, associated with a timeless stature in terms of style and value. Make a promise of eternal bond to your best friend by gifting her a ring with a centrepiece, engineered to accommodate a majestic glow pigment. So, gift your person a glowy ring from our latest launch, the Firefly Collection, so she can figuratively shine her brightest! Owing to the versatile design of our glow rings, they can be worn singly as statement pieces or stacked together with other bands.
4. Chain and Pendant with Heart Solitaire
A chain with a pendant is the default choice of jewel for fashionistas around the world, regardless of the occasion. Don't know what to wear on a particular day out? The shine-infused pendant shall elevate the floral dress and ballet flats combo at once! By choosing a chain and a pendant with a heart solitaire as the central piece - you’re not only investing in a timeless blueprint of ornament but also a symbol for the ages. The standalone diamond is symbolically representative of your bestie’s central position in your life!
5. Silver Bracelets
By opting for a silver bracelet, you can have it serve as a valuable substitute for your childhood friendship bracelet, commemorating the bond that you had nurtured all year long. Now, with the friendship seasoned and ripe, it shall be remembered through the gift of an alluring, silver, semi-precious gemstone studded bracelet. Silver is also a budget-friendly option if you’re looking for meaningful gift ideas for best friends at affordable rates. Plus, just look at the splash of colours and textures incorporated through the embedded gemstones - your ‘Jewel’ of a friend simply will not be able to resist its aesthetic appeal!
Final Word on Finding Your Bestie a New Sparkly #BFF! You and your best friend have served as support systems for one another, for most of your life if not all of it. So, it is finally time to pay tribute to this sacred connection. Express your gratitude towards the friend who has stuck by your side through ecstatic moments, scandals, heartbreaks and simply the unending boring days. The gift ideas for your best friend, provided above, shall get you a jump-start on your soul-searching journey. So, explore Mia by Tanishq’s latest jewellery launches to find your person the ideal sparklies, that shall talk to and of her dynamic personality!

page-attributes.page-title: Family Wedding Gift Guide: Perfect Jewellery Picks | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Looking forward to picking out jewellery gifts for a family wedding? Here’s everything you need to know before you begin your quest and celebrate family and special occasions.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Beginner's Guide
Choosing the Perfect Jewellery Gift for a Family Wedding When there is a wedding in the family, the cheer and the celebratory mood involved are contagious. There's not a single moment spent thinking about anything other than the ‘big day’ of the near & dear family member! You must be mentally planning the different outfits you're going to style and practising poses for the photographs that you'll get taken. A family wedding is the perfect moment to gather the entire extended line of folks under one roof and have a big, juicy catch-up session. In between all the hours invested in wedding preparation and planning sessions, the members of the family find themselves utterly caught up. It’s quite easy to forget about oneself when they’re dedicating all their time towards making the big day of their beloved daughter or son, the best day of their respective lives! The family members who are making the wedding scene transform into a fairytale-esque set-up, just according to the bride's and groom's vision - deserve a little reminder of how important they are. Wouldn't you agree? So, plan a nice, little gifting session. Present your parents, grandparents, beloved aunts and cousins some gorgeous jewellery knickknacks - which they can either treasure as keepsakes or wear as a style statement on the daily. Combine sentiment with trends in the form of contemporary jewellery with a wide range of options at Mia by Tanishq. This blog will give you dazzling ideas of Jewellery Gifts for a Family Wedding, so you can find a piece for every niece!
Discover Jewellery Options for Your Folks: Express Sparkling Gratitude in Bejewelled Fonts Be it your mom, your elder sister or even your dad - there is a jewellery piece, sure to match their style. Ornaments themselves are fool-proof options when it comes to gifting - and when they're made from gold or silver, they're immediately transformed into timeless treasures. The classic yellow sheen of gold and the delicate, metallic lustre of silver remain unbeatable when it comes to accentuating an ensemble. Additionally, they are the ultimate containers of sentimental value and nostalgia. Here are some family member-specific jewellery options you can explore:
1. Mommy-dearest You can opt for a timeless gold necklace featuring intricate details, like geometrical patterns or a modern, polished finish for your mom. While it will line up with her taste for elegance and grace, it will also be a trend-adjacent pick, considering the overall minimal vibe.
2. The Cool Dad Does your dad spend a few extra minutes behind properly grooming himself, every day before heading out to work? Introduce him to a brand-new category of suave styling by gifting him minimalistic, subtle and sophisticated men's bracelets. You can also present him with gold chains so he can test the waters in style, in his next curated cool-dad fit!
3. The Wise Elder Sister If the elder sister has a knack for fashion and accessories, bless her with a dainty go-to necklace that she can style every day. From workplace formals to party pizzazz - you've got all her avatars covered stylistically, down to the 'T'.
4. The Silly Younger Brother Gift your beloved younger brother a stylish brooch, which he can add to his everyday outfits. As a brooch is rather versatile, your brother can experiment with it by attaching it to his backpack, or casual T-shirt, or get further crafty with it.
5. The Fun Grandma/Grandpa Your grandparents would truly appreciate a sentimental jewellery gift. For example, you can opt for a birthstone necklace or bracelet, which holds special meaning in your grandparents' life. You can also remind them of their everlasting youth through vibrant gemstone jewellery as gifts.
6. Your Favourite Cousins Are you most excited to greet your favourite cousins? Bond over gossip like you used to, back in the day and reminisce about the glorious past - a path lined with child-like eccentricities. Gift them jewellery, possibly featuring charms which remind them of happier days, spent with you. Explore silver charms within a budget and find cute, wearable pieces for every day.
7. Uncles/Aunties a.k.a the Real ‘Besties’ You will surely never forget the good old days when your uncles and aunts came over to visit and brought you very many gifts. Now is the perfect time to show them some gratitude for adding innocent cheer to your childhood days! To the uncles and aunts who taught you a thing or two about real life, introduce the freshest and most aesthetic trends in jewellery. Present them with lightweight, yet expressive gold jewellery so they can tap into their inner ‘fashionistas’ just in time for the wedding! Apart from the wedding jewellery gift ideas we’ve provided, you can also change up the selection for different folks. To guarantee the best pick, there are a few points you can consider.
Things to Consider While Picking Jewellery Gifts for the ‘Fam’ Regardless of who you are picking accessories for, there are a few, common pointers to consider in every case. Choose the perfect wedding jewellery gifts for all your close ones, by checking off the following:
1. Know their Style When it comes to picking accessories for a specific person, the most important information surrounds their style preference. For example, if they embody a more minimalistic approach towards fashion, you can opt for subtle and sophisticated jewellery.
