page-attributes.page-title: Guide to Gold Purity: Understanding 24K, 22K, 18K & 14K Gold | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Thinking of buying your first gold piece? Understand gold purity with our guide. Learn about the different gold karats—24K, 22K, 18K, and 14K—and how they affect gold's quality and value. Read more!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Beginner's Guide
The Beginner’s Guide to Understanding Gold Purity Picture this: you’ve been tirelessly working extra hours at the office to climb that career ladder quicker - and now you get to taste the sweet flavour of hard-earned success! As gold is a testament to classic and time-transcending elegance, opting for gold jewellery as a reward for your unshakeable determination is a symbolic way to celebrate. Gold manifests itself across various moulds and forms - from dainty chains to exquisite gold coin designs. You may purchase gold jewellery or coins, as an aesthetic feat, an investment plan or for collection purposes. Thus, understanding the gold purity theory will help you make the right choice of jewels. With collectors and investors racing each other for the perfect gold piece, they must know the deal with gold purity, to make the ideal pick. So, if you’re just jump-starting your way through the gold-purchasing scene too, this is the only guide you require! Even if you’re an occasional buyer, this is an important bit, so you can get your money's worth. This beginner's guide to gold purity shall familiarise you with the basics of the gold purity scale. By the end of the blog, you’ll know exactly which gold purity level best aligns with your purpose of gold purchase!
What is Gold Purity? Gold purity is measured in 'karats', on a scale of up to 24. Karat denotes the percentage of pure gold present in jewellery pieces, in correspondence to the percentage of other metals. The karat value is represented by a ‘K’ or ‘Kt’ at the end of the numeric. In simpler terms, higher karat is equal to a higher purity of gold, with 24Kt gold being crowned as ‘pure gold’. However, pure gold is often considered to be too malleable or ‘soft’, when moulded to give form to jewellery, making the end products prone to scratches and dents. Hence, pure gold is mixed up with other metals, resulting in a more durable alloy. This is where 22Kt, 18Kt, and 14Kt gold come in – containing gold and a certain percentage of other metals like zinc, copper, etc. They are used in jewellery to boost the longevity of the ornaments through the decades. Plus, they are much less expensive than pure 24Kt gold and can be purchased within a limited budget.
Types of Gold Purity Levels For a better understanding of gold purity levels, discover their importance when it comes to jewellery design. Here are the different types of gold purity levels found in gold ornamentation: 24Kt Gold 24Kt Gold is known as 'pure gold' without featuring a mix of any other metal. So, it is extremely malleable and is not durable enough to combat wear and tear. While it is not a fit level of gold purity when it comes to jewellery-making, it is highly valuable on its own – making it the ultimate investment option. You can purchase 24Kt gold coins with Mia by Tanishq to start your investment journey on a strong note, and expect excellent returns over time.
22Kt Gold Containing a smaller percentage of other metals, 22Kt gold is the most preferred choice when it comes to jewellery shopping. With the rich, yellow sheen of the metal intact, the other metals extend a degree of stability and durability to the ornament. 22Kt Gold is often used to produce jewellery of varied kinds – from luxurious lockets and pendants that serve as family heirlooms to elaborate ones demanding the gaze of everyone present in a room!
18Kt Gold 18Kt gold is a popular choice when it comes to crafting dainty jewellery. As modern women and men prefer more of a 'clean look', subtle jewellery makes for the ultimate accessory option. It maintains a shiny lustre across royal, yellow gold, an elegant white gold and even a majestic rose gold. The durability is enhanced, making the 18Kt jewellery wearable on the daily. Explore an exquisite range of 18Kt gold jewellery with Mia by Tanishq to find the perfect, go-to piece for yourself or someone you love!
14Kt Gold Considered to be the most practical and budget-friendly choice when it comes to daily wear gold jewellery – 14Kt gold is used to supply your jewellery bank with valuable staples! It is a popular choice in jewellery-making, owing to immunity to scratches or dents and a hypoallergenic nature. 14Kt Gold is versatile as it can be moulded to form intricate aesthetic detailing, allowing for craftsmen to incorporate trendy carvings, across multiple colour options. Shine in a timeless yellow gold, mesmerise your beloved with a rose gold sheen on date nights or dazzle with white-gold sophistication! If you have a limited budget, skim through our options of 14Kt gold jewellery to find some dazzling pieces. Thus, accentuate the stylistic quotient of your daily fits.
How to Select the Best Gold Purity? To answer your ultimate question about which gold purity to select, we have compiled a list of points you can consider while shopping. Go through the following checklist to settle on your final pick:
Whip Up a Budget Much of the confusion is going to be eliminated once you whip out a budget. Then, you can scroll through a particular range of options which align with the set budget. For example, if you have a higher budget, we recommend you check out our gold jewellery options in 22Kt. On the other hand, a 14Kt gold piece shall satiate your taste for aesthetics at a much lower price! If you’re looking for modern, finely-finished jewellery, 18Kt gold ornaments are your wisest bets. Finally, 24Kt gold coins are perfect for kick-starting your investment journey.
Establish the Purpose of Purchase Depending on whether you're purchasing jewellery for personal, aesthetic use or long-term investment reasons, you can choose a specific gold purity level. For example, 24Kt gold bars or gold coins are ideal investment options. On the other hand, 22Kt gold is kept aside for traditional, heavy jewellery making. Lastly, 18Kt and 14Kt gold jewellery are preferred for everyday use.
Define Your Aesthetic First You can first find a jewellery design you prefer visually and then check out the gold purity level. As traditional gold jewellery has now evolved to incorporate more modern tastes, there are unlimited gold options for you to explore. Simply opt for the design which calls to your soul. With all of the technicalities now out of the way, we shall proceed to present you with some alluring gold options!
Types of Gold Options You Can Explore Online Mia by Tanishq offers an astounding range of gold items for both, the first-time buyer and the avid collector. Here are some iconic options in gold, for you to check out online:
1. 24Kt Gold Coin
The Coin are a great option in 24Kt gold – high in value and visual appeal. We promise you that once you purchase this gold coin, you will become a gold coin collector over time. Plus, you do not have to keep the gold coins locked away in a cupboard! Instead, you can repurpose them to serve as charms dangling from bracelets or chains. The coins will also serve as decorative pieces, when framed and put on show in a nice wooden box, catching the wandering eyes of visitors!
2. 22Kt Gold Necklace
Mia by Tanishq features several 22Kt gold jewellery options as part of the Native collection and their 22 karate range where they have gold jewellery designs with moder touch. These trendy designs are show-stopping pieces that you can style with your special-event outfits. From Silk sarees to fancy Salwar sets, this ornament is all you need to complete the look.
3. 18Kt Gold Ring
18Kt gold rings are a popular choice of engagement rings and bands. You can also purchase an 18Kt gold ring for yourself as a promise to never undermine your efforts and subsequent achievements. 18Kt gold is the ultimate choice when it comes to crafting of gold and diamond jewellery. While already preferred for the making of daily wear ornaments, 18Kt gold also takes the crown for being durable and strong enough to clasp onto a diamond efficiently. In a world that is moving all too quickly, there’s hardly ever time for self-reflection. However, a diamond ring, through its delicate design, shall remind you to organise a dedicated 'unwinding' session every other day – something you can for sure use!
4. 14Kt Gold Earrings
You can opt for 14Kt gold earrings featuring natural diamonds. The ‘Bow Grace 14Kt Gold & Diamond Stud Earrings’ are not only super unique, trendy and personality-abound takes on classic gold jewellery, but they are also budget-friendly. So, partake in the Spring-Summer trends of this year by getting your hands on the finely crafted bow-motif gold earrings. Expand your style horizon with the inclusion of meaningful and aesthetic pairs of 14Kt gold earrings into your jewellery collection. To get your gold collection started and on track, you can invest in all the above options and beyond, for a stylish and enviable concoction of shine!
Final Word on Understanding Gold Purity We hope this beginner's guide to gold purity can be your reference point while you go gold shopping. Depending on your budget and the purpose of your gold purchase, different levels of gold purity may be ideal for you. For instance, if you're on a limited budget, 18Kt or 14Kt jewellery options shine the brightest. However, if you're looking to gain heftily from your investments in gold, 24Kt pure gold and 22Kt gold are your go-to! With several options to explore with Mia by Tanishq, you’re sure to find your ideal gold piece at once. So, curate a range of masterfully crafted gold jewellery pieces with various purity levels or opt for a single type – in either case, the options are endless.

content.description: In search of tips & tricks on how to incorporate your Mangalsutra in everyday looks? Here’s the only style guide you’ll need!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Latest and Trending
How to Incorporate Your Mangalsutra into Everyday Looks A wedding is a momentous occasion in every bride and groom’s life. It marks their spiritual union with one another, and the simultaneous integration of two families. As part of the marriage rituals, the groom ties a sacred thread symbolising love, known as the mangalsutra, around his beloved bride’s neck. This ornament is traditionally significant and serves as a recognisable symbol of marital bliss. Marriage brings a significant shift to women’s lives. Whether you are moving into the in-law's house or staying only with your husband as a newly married couple, comes the need to reshuffle her usual schedule. However, between all of the newness and jitters of a ‘just wedded’ period, she should be able to stay grounded within herself. The best way to do so is through self-expression in subtle yet bold ways.

What better way to do so than through fashion?

We, at Mia at Tanishq, offer a stunning range of mangalsutra for the modern bride who keeps her individuality and sense of self in any aspect of life. So, this blog shall provide you with some voguish ways to incorporate the mangalsutra every day, expressing moods & slaying looks
Tips on Rocking a Mangalsutra with Everyday Ensembles As per the Indian culture, a mangalsutra is to be worn by a bride every day. So, transform this piece of culturally-equipped jewellery into a tasteful addition to everyday outfits. Here's how you can do it in style:
Go the Minimalistic Route The best way to incorporate a mangalsutra into your everyday looks is by opting for a minimal design of mangalsutra in the first place. With a lightweight and elegant route, it becomes much easier to incorporate mangalsutra with your casual looks as well as fancy get-ups. So, whether you are headed to the office in a formal or are attending a cultural function with the family, the minimal yet elegant mangalsutra will never look out of place. You can opt for a mangalsutra with an intricate yet quietly expressive pendant, like our 'Enchanted Bond 14 Kt Gold and Diamond Mangalsutra’.
Experiment with Different Versions of the Mangalsutra Explore your stylistic options by choosing a mangalsutra bracelet instead of a pendant. The mangalsutra bracelet is delicate and subtle in make and can serve as a unique expression of your style. It would be a one-of-a-kind pick among cultural jewellery, while also keeping with the latest trends surrounding dainty bracelets. Choose our ‘Mia Sutra DIY with Numerical Charms’, and get to pick your lucky number from the options!
Layer with Gold Chains Your mangalsutra can serve as a show-stealing piece among other layered gold chains. You can opt for classic gold chains or ones with dangly centrepieces – according to your creative vision. This will let you create a never-before-seen arrangement of jewellery around your decolletage area. It will not only be fashionably forward in look but also personal to you. Check out the gold chains from Mia by Tanishq’s latest collection to find some alluring options.
Play with the Length of the Mangalsutra Experiment with different lengths of the mangalsutra to match various silhouettes and cuts of clothing. For example, a shorter mangalsutra would look banging with a sweetheart neckline or against a collared, formal shirt. On the other hand, the longer length of the mangalsutra will suit a bold, deep-V cutout or even a high-neck top. Play around with different shapes through the incorporation of jewellery - create intrigue and define your style.
Mix & Match the Metals & Gemstones While matching the gold bits of the mangalsutra with gold chains, you can also match the embedded diamonds of the pendant with other diamond-infused pieces. To further draw interest to the layered arrangement of jewellery, you can opt for neckpieces containing semi-precious gemstones like rubies, sapphires, emeralds, etc. This adds a splash of colour to your ensemble while also speaking of your cheerful personality and boundless soul. As the look can be quite eye-catching, opt for a neutral base in clothing to go with it. For example, the iconic white shirt and beige, tailored trousers combo, is just the perfect fit!
Let your Confidence Shine Through The best adornment is always going to be that confident smile of yours. If you know you're slaying the look, there's simply no two ways about it – you're owning it! Style your mangalsutra with a vibrant tank top and a pair of solid-coloured denim jeans. Put on a white shirt, and keep it unbuttoned to stay cosy and comfy. Finally, accessorise to the brim and let your shiny personality come through! There you go with some stylist-approved ways to incorporate a mangalsutra in your daily looks and define the drip this year! However, we cannot just leave you with some top-tier styling tips and not give you a few options to consider for your artistic rendezvous. The next section provides a glimpse at our signature drop, the Mia Sutra collection.
Types of Mangalsutra Designs: ‘Glow’ from that Marital Bliss We, at Mia by Tanishq, are inspired by you, the modern bride, and your strive to be yourself through any major alteration in life. So, here are a few mangalsutra options for you to explore and find the style that matches your energy, drive & vigour:
1. Mia Sutra DIY with Numerical Charms
When it comes to styling a mangalsutra for every occasion, pick one that is simple & sophisticated in design and right up your fashionable alley. You can opt for our numerical charm collection which features a diamond-infused central charm shaped like the number '9'. The design is a modern take on the traditional mangalsutra blueprint consisting of a combination of black beads and a gold chain. This mangalsutra design combines the classics with a trendy twist - featuring minimally-designed shapes representing clover leaves, known to bring in great luck. The clover leaf motif as a part of the mangalsutra design stands for a marriage enraptured in the lucky essence of bountiful wonders. You can add multiple charms to the motifs and customise them as per your style.
2. Mia Sutra DIY with Alphabet Charms
The ‘Mia Sutra DIY with Alphabet Charms- N’ is the iconic bracelet variation of a mangalsutra. Simply style this piece to bring the whole look together, even on days you do not wish to go all out with your get-up. The bracelet is lightweight and easy to slip on. As it is so remarkably subtle, efficient yet expressive in design, it is not the type of ornament you would have to take off and keep aside at any point. You can just put the bracelet on and forget about it while it quietly does its job of making a loud style statement! Pair the mangalsutra bracelet with a white, ribbed tank top, and formal, structured trousers. Complete the look with a multi-coloured scarf to take the bohemian route or put on a suave, denim jacket to transform into a street-style goddess.
3. Classic Gold & Diamond Mangalsutra
Do you have a soft corner for the classic mangalsutra variant? We do too! So, including some classic designs in our Mia Sutra collection, is inevitable! Especially so, as it features the closest-to-classic visual appeal with a modern sprinkle of sparkly goodness. Throughout the country, panning across various regions - notice how cultural identity finds an outlet through their traditional jewellery design. The mangalsutra takes the form of a Thaali, Bottu, Vati, Minnu, and more, breathing out the modern-ethnic synergy into coherence. We’ve drawn inspiration from such variations and more to come up with our version of a trendy, gold and diamond mangalsutra delight for the iconic & outspoken bride!
Final Word on Styling a Mangalsutra & Doing it Well! As the mangalsutra is particularly unique in design, it naturally stands out among other jewellery pieces. However, the modern bride loves to style her looks in a way which expresses intention and an eye for fashion. To that end, picking out a mangalsutra which is simple to style, looks complimentary to the bride‘s overall closet and is personal to her - is the best way to go! Explore Mia by Tanishq’s latest range of mangalsutras to find a variation which speaks to the woman’s identity behind the bride’s ceremonial look. At affordable prices, flip through modern, minimalistic styles, personalised pendant options and diamond-studded charming alternatives. Now, incorporate the Mangalsutra every day to express your versatility when it comes to fashion and fervour.

page-attributes.page-title: Beginner's Guide to Buying Your First Jewellery Piece | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Ready to buy your first jewellery piece? Learn essential guide on making smart choices for your first purchase.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Beginner's Guide
Purchasing Your First Jewellery Piece: What You Need to Know Are you an avid jewellery lover but a first-time buyer? We've got your back with the 'deets' around making your first shine-abound purchase a marvellous success! If you’ve just drawn your first salary, show yourself some much-needed appreciation for coming such a long way, striking off milestones left & right. Treat yourself to an eye-watering self-love moment and some dainty allure enraptured in everyday-wear jewellery! Investing in your first jewellery piece can be exciting, and nerve-wracking at the same time especially so, as there are a myriad of options to explore online. Yet, this moment shall be immaterialised in the form of, possibly gold jewellery, as a pivotal time of your life - specifically if it’s your first, big, independent purchase. Well, it’s now your moment, where you get to say ‘yes’ to an adornment. That tear-jerking moment is about to happen for you and we’re here for it! We present Mia by Tanishq's stunning selection of meaning-rich, fine-tuned jewellery where you can find your perfect bejewelled match. As investing in jewellery comes with its own little guidebook, we’re here to help you read and interpret it!
Chapter 1: How to Find Your Sparkle? You'll know right when you see it! Just when the sparkle catches your eye, its glistening stature shall positively mesmerise you. You won't be able to help but add it to the cart. Certain factors come into play when you make your choice of jewellery. Some of them are your personal style, your lifestyle, and your preference for metal and gemstone, among other things. With all the factors checked off your list, you can proceed to make the final pick. To further ease up the selection process, we’ve compiled the 5 golden points to consider before you make your first jewellery investment:
1. Opt for a Basic Piece By choosing a basic essential in jewellery as your first piece is a great place to start. Whether you’re then planning to curate an entire, enviable collection of jewellery or simply are shopping for a special occasion, you can never go wrong with the basics. For example, opt for a simple yet sophisticated gold chain, a pair of gold studs or a dainty gold bracelet. You can pair the basic pieces with different outfits. Maintain a minimal vibe with the gold chain serving as a stand-alone piece. Alternatively, you can layer the basic piece with other accessories, like a ribbon tied into a bow, a choker, a scarf, etc. - to add intrigue to your ensemble!
2. Find Something in Your Style If you define your style in a specific way, let it find an outlet through your choice of jewels! Opposed to a randomised pick, choosing jewellery which aligns with your style gives them an edge over other trinkets. You are more likely to reach out for accessories which match your aesthetics on a day-to-day basis. Your first jewellery piece should not have to stay locked away in a closet! Instead, you can wear it every day to complement your various fashionable avatars. If you're still discovering your style and don't have a particular stylistic direction you're leaning towards - here's our recommendation! Opt for a minimally-crafted piece, like an expressive pendant with a gold chain, a pair of twinkling drop earrings or a polished bracelet! As these are lightweight options, they are much easier to style on different occasions.
3. Go for the ‘Show Stealer’ Piece While you can invest all you want in the essentials of jewellery, an aesthetic-lover cannot truly stop themselves from reaching for the ultimate showstopper piece! So, go for the 'show stealer' piece featuring an elaborate make, fit for a celebratory evening or a grand, wedding party. Even if you are not able to wear this piece daily, you can assign the role of a 'Muse' to it. Thoughts about this showstopper piece shall help you sleep peacefully at night and wake up with a sparkly smile! Go on, bring your aesthetic visions to fruition every time you get dressed for an event.
4. Decide on Your Metal of Choice Depending on whether you are a gold or a silver 'girlie', make your first choice of jewellery. Think back on the colour accents you prefer in your everyday trips to get a solid idea. However, if you're just getting into accessorising, the best way to figure out which metal would complement your skin the most is to figure out the undertones of your skin tone. While a cooler undertone makes the silver pop, gold complements a warmer undertone perfectly. You can also decide on the type of metal by keeping your wardrobe as context. If your style is inclined more towards a cooler colour palette, you can go for silver accents. For earthy tones and warm neutrals, gold would be the perfect match!
5. Consider Your Lifestyle The type of life you lead also plays a crucial role in deciding on the type of looks you get to create every day. For example, if you are a working woman, you must be dressed up for your office. On the other hand, if you are a budding university student, casuals and trendy aesthetics may be right up your alley. In either case, a certain set of jewellery pieces may complement your outfits more than others. So depending on how you are required to dress every day to seamlessly fit into your lifestyle, you can pick your jewellery items accordingly.
Extra Tip: Know What You Want to Convey Once you’ve settled on a sentiment you’d like to convey through fashion, the jewellery-picking moment can be further simplified. Opt for Silver charms if you want to portray your affinity towards personal passions and hobbies. On the other hand, you can also opt for gemstone jewellery pieces featuring your birthstone or a lucky gem. By picking specific types of gemstones, you are manifesting different prayers to fruition. For example, if you choose ruby-studded bangles, the rubies would be symbolic of new passions and ever-growing love. If you're gifting yourself emerald-studded jewellery pieces, it's almost like a wish for continued self-sufficiency, peace in your personal life and security! Besides the above-mentioned factors, you must also consider your budget. Sticking to a specific budget will help you narrow down your selection pool to a handful of sparkly options. The next section discusses some of Mia by Tanishq's most sought-after jewellery options among first-time buyers.
Chapter 2: Types of Jewellery to Make Your ‘First Buy’ Count! Purchasing your very first jewellery piece can set the foundation for a specific aesthetic you’d want to embody for life! This could help you establish a direction in your journey towards defining your ‘personal style’. So, make it count! Here are some of our favourite jewellery pieces you can check out as a first-time investor in 'self-loving':
1. A Gold Pendant with a Chain
Made from 22KT gold, the Warli tales-inspired gold pendant is not only rich in cultural and mythological crumbs but also serves as an iconic transition piece. By a transition piece, we mean a jewellery item combining the traditional vein composed of nostalgic essence with a modern finish. Owing to its minimal design, the ‘Warli Tales 22KT Gold Pendant’ can be worn across several aesthetics - from ethnic and boho to indie-inspired silhouettes, the styling scope remains unlimited!
2. Gold Stud Earrings
A pair of gold stud earrings is a classic accessory which boosts the elegance of an ensemble by several points. Our ‘Saura Sketches 22KT Gold Stud Earrings' feature a treasure-trove of sentiment, simultaneously maintaining the signature-Mia minimalist touch. While 22KT gold jewellery is perfect for the first-time investor in jewellery - it is also a style statement, easily pairable with a diverse lookbook.
3. Gold Bangles
Saura Symphony 22KT Gold Bangle We are sure you’ve seen nothing like this before! And, we confidently say so because we, too, have surprised ourselves with this innovative gold bangle design! The ‘Saura Symphony 22KT Gold Bangle' finds the perfect blend between a captivating tale told by the culturally rich tribal groups of India and a modern 'moral of the story'. While our inspiration shines through, our visual muse does not take a back seat either. So, choose this 22KT gold bangle as your first piece of jewellery and slay any ensemble from here onwards!
4. Gold and Diamond Rings
You can opt for a gold and diamond ring as it is a timeless classic. Plus, you simply never have to take the ring off under any circumstance, owing to its delicate ‘bling’ and versatile design. Pair it with your date tonight outfits, your office-ready looks and your Insta-worth OOTDs for a girls' night out. With a stunning piece like our 'Eternal Allure 14KT Gold & Diamond Ring’, replicating the Queenly crown, your jewellery collection is going to grow rapidly - and, we gladly take responsibility!
5. Silver Charms
Moving on to a silver option for our girlies with a cooler undertone and an affinity for metallic charms - here's an intricate silver charm you can get your hands on! With a lustre that never dims and a style quotient which never dips, silver jewellery pieces become a classic option for your first-time jewellery hunt. You can pair the ‘Geometric Grace Silver Charm for All' with your everyday looks - from casual baby tees to tank tops and long skirts, it's got all your aesthetics covered.
Final Word on Recognising Your Sparkly ‘Bestie’ We’ve covered all the basics on ways to choose the perfect first jewellery piece. Consider your take on style, lifestyle, preference for metals and gemstones, etc., before locking in your decision. Investing in jewellery becomes much more fun when you are absolutely in adoration of your choice. So, it’s important that you pick out the piece which speaks to and of your dynamic personality, connects to your passions, and serves as a point of stylistic expression. With all of that in mind, you are ready to start exploring the world of precious jewellery. Mia by Tanishq has several options for you to discover and find the ideal first piece, attached to a reasonable price tag!

content.description: Are you a Chartered Accountant looking to spice up your daily work attire? Do it through accessorising, and in style! Plus, know your options in this jewellery guide for CAs.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Styling Tips & Guides
Balancing the Books and Bling: A Jewellery Guide for CAs Day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting can be done in style – especially by our ‘fashionista’ Chartered Accountants! This Chartered Accountants Day, we strive to highlight our hard-working financial experts for their undeterred drive to maintain consistent accuracy with client records and manage other expenses. While no mistakes are made professionally – our beloved CAs often neglect themselves in favour of their workload. Under our watch, it cannot continue to be the case! We, at Mia by Tanishq, have brewed up a perfectly blingy yet elegant range of jewellery for our working women – prioritising comfort, versatility and affordability. Adorn yourself in lightweight, intricately designed gold and diamond jewellery as you put together an outfit for a specific workday. Explore your options with Mia by Tanishq to find a selection of easy-to-style and wearable jewellery throughout your work shift. This blog shall serve as a jewellery guide for CAs, providing you with stylist-approved tips on how to bling out your usual shirt & trousers combo.
Styling Tips for CAs: Discover Your Style Even While You're Hard at Work While there is a specific dress code for CAs, allowing for formal wear, sarees and salwar kameez sets – there are other ways to convey your eye for fashion. A popular yet subtle method of expressing an affinity towards fashion is through intentional accessorising. Whether you're arranging meetings in your office with your priority clients or visiting them on-site to deal with financial matters - be confident in your skin as the glaze of gold and shimmer of natural diamonds elevate your formals to a 'tasteful corporate-core slay'! Here are a few tips to keep in mind, that shall help you pick jewellery pieces you can style daily as a CA and make every work-#OOTD count:
Opt for the Essentials Start by opting for the essentials in jewellery – think of classic gold chains, intricate stud earrings and fine bangles featuring a modern flair. These pieces are easily the most versatile bet as they can be worn interchangeably with different kinds of colour palettes and texture collections. Whether you’re feeling a soft-pink silk saree or a bold-green ribbed shirt, the chain and studs can be worn in combination to embody a sophisticated look! We recommend our ‘Kollam Magnetic Gold and Diamond Necklace' and 'Kollam Wander Gold and Diamond Stud Earrings’ as a set for your ethnic slays.
Plan Minimal Looks Opt for minimal silhouettes for your work days – exploring a range of dainty pendants with chains, gemstone-studded jewellery and stylish gold rings. You can opt for an ‘only-statement-earrings’ look and embody the popping ‘clean-girl’ trend. It not only helps you express a sense of style but also keeps it perfectly professional! A little bit of sparkle added to your unsaid uniform for work, allows you to maintain a sense of ‘Self’ that is not simply lost in the hours spent behind preparing tax returns! Check out our ‘Enchanted Firefly Gold & Amethyst Pendant with Chain’ featuring a unique glow pigment which glows in the dark. Alternatively, designate our show-stopper piece, the ‘Blue Sapphire Moon 14KT Stud Earring’ as the statement pair of earrings, complementing your boho-fits!
Showcase Your Personality Your choice of jewellery can say a lot about your personality and style! So, have your traits and passions shine through your pick of ornaments. This will also add a sentimental touch to your go-to jewellery stack – which will, in turn, make you want to reach out for the pieces more often. Opt for our ‘Orb of Protection Evil Eye Gold Pendant' as a prayer for sustaining luck through your work life. Alternatively, you can choose our 'Spectral Glow Gold and Diamond Necklace’ as a statement piece, featuring a trendy hexagon frame seen across various fashion runways. It can also serve as a fun reminder of your long days spent in the arms of the delicate summer bloom.
Play Around with Metals You can opt for gold or silver, based on your skin undertone, preference, or budget. Opt for yellow gold from top to bottom and inculcate sophistication in its purest form. Maintain a sense of cohesiveness through your choice of accessories and convey your love for seamless styling. On the other hand, you can participate in the 'mixing metals' trend. This opens up the scope for experimentation with yellow, white and rose gold, while also leaving just enough room for a tender, silver sheen! Find your style by tapping into the different emerging trends across social media – while never running the risk of putting on ‘too much’, thanks to Mia’s signature minimal approach.
Create Mood Boards To find your style, you can resort to creating mood boards – featuring colours, textures and ensembles which tickle your aesthetic-detecting antennas. You can scroll through 'Pinterest’ or ‘We Heart it’ to find art and style ‘inspo’ and add the images to your personal mood board. Based on the boards’ overall vibe, you can pick out the jewellery accordingly. Do you notice a pattern in the types of colours or styles which catch your eye? Well, there you have it! You’ve found an aesthetic you visually lean towards. Dig into the vibe further and try to incorporate glimpses of it subtly, in your work attires – possibly through accessories! By applying the above-mentioned tips in styling your everyday work outfits, you'll surely feel most connected to your style even through rigorous shifts!
Types of Jewellery: Carve Out the Path to Glistening Success in Style Maintain a balance between professionalism and a stylish demeanour by opting for shine-rich gold ornaments and personality-abound semi-precious gemstone jewellery. Know what you want to convey through accessorising beforehand, to narrow down your selection pool. Let us provide you with some gleaming visuals to sleep on tonight, so you can make the purchase first thing, the next morning! Here are some of our favourite picks of dainty jewellery which are perfect for extensive wear, guaranteeing comfort as well as style:
1. Gold and Diamond Earrings
Trending jewellery ideas for CAs pretty much revolve around the timeless stud variations of earrings – and we’re not exaggerating one bit! Stud earrings are versatile jewellery options, which can be styled to either bling-ify a neutral base or to tie an outfit to a quiet luxurious vibe. You can get as creative as you want with our ‘Gleaming Brook Gold & Diamond Stud Earrings’ – pair them with a neck-piece counterpart like the ‘Meandering River 18KT Diamond & Pearl Necklace’ to turn up the appeal or embody the epitome of minimalistic tang with a ‘only earrings’ look.
2. Gold Necklaces
Does your closet mostly consist of ethnic motifs and attires? Take your ‘desi girl’ ensembles to the next level with the addition of our ‘Timeless Warli Art Gold Necklace’ to the mix! Play with patterns, prints and colours in your kurtas and churidar sets – complete the look with a classic gold necklace, featuring a blend of traditional carvings and a modern, refined finish.
3. Gold Bangles/ Bracelets
Opt for an arrangement of wristwear that complements your look on days you’re feeling a Kanjivaram or a Bandhani saree! For example, opt for the ‘Contemporary Chic Gold Bangle’ in combination with the ‘Radiant Fusion Gold & Diamond Bracelet’. While one is a classic bangle featuring a modern, polished lustre – the other is a minimally-crafted bracelet further adding to the subtle air of sophistication. The above options are time-transcending when it comes to design while also keeping up with the latest jewellery trends. So, you can adorn the pieces together to create a classy look – checking ‘style’ and ‘comfort’ off the list!
Final Word on Choosing the Perfect Jewellery for CAs When it comes to styling yourself for work as a CA – there’s only so much time every other morning! Plus, we know how dedicated you are to getting things done on time, from managing expenses, and following up with clients to bookkeeping in general. However, this surely must take hours off your ‘me-time’. Mia by Tanishq aims to appreciate the woman behind her profession, her quirks and the eccentricities that make her unique! So, now that you’ve gone through the jewellery guide for CAs, have yourself and your passions reflected through the choice of jewels. Explore an exquisite selection of ornaments with us – ranging from pendants and rings to bracelets, at affordable prices!

Styling Tips & Guides
The Little Black Dress: A Canvas for Your Favourite Jewellery Designs No matter what phase of fashion you’re currently in, a Little Black Dress, popularly known as the ‘LBD’, shall always remain a staple in your closet. The reason why the Little Black Dress gained so much popularity at once is its versatility. Be it a party, a formal event you must attend, or a romantic date night - slipping on the little black dress should do the trick of making you look ‘fab’ without even trying! It is also the perfect canvas for the adornment of your favourite jewellery designs, letting them take centre stage in terms of sparkle. Easily style the LBD and elevate it with layers of jewellery, faux-fur jackets or cashmere shawls. This blog shall introduce you to some ways you can style your ‘Little Black Dress’ to tap into its full stylistic potential in 2025. Also, discover rare and unique jewellery to wear with your black dress at affordable prices!
Tips on Styling the Mother of Clothing Essentials, the ‘LBD’ - Jewellery Edition Depending on whether you want to dress your ‘LBD’ up or down, opt for jewellery accordingly, to complete the vibe and set the tone. For example, if you want to keep it casual yet edgy, go for a dainty pendant, a pair of stud earrings and thinly-crafted bracelets. On the other end, if you’re a lover of the ‘drama’, proceed to show it off by layering up different jewels together - create a fascinating bunch to establish a personal ‘iconic moment’ in your fashion evolution history. Affordable, easy to style and versatile – the black dress was appropriate for any and every occasion. Even in the Gen Z era, the LBD has not lost its gripping hold on the style-driven lot, making its way into several fancy wardrobes. In fact, the little black dress pretty much introduced the need for having ‘basic essentials’ in one’s closet. Did you recently get your hands on the perfect LBD that you cannot wait to style? Here are some gleam-coated ways to coordinate jewellery with your black dress, so you can get started on your ‘slaying’ journey:
1. Try a Minimal Approach Opt for dainty versions of pendants, diamond studded earrings and gold rings. These knick-knacks in combination with one another can perfectly balance out the subtlety of your Little Black Dress. Choose a V-neckline, spaghetti straps, a cinched-in waistline and a flowy skirt for your black dress - complete the look with Mia by Tanishq’s Firefly Collection and Lovestruck Solitaires.
2. Go for the Classics Diamonds were the chief choice of gemstones featured in jewellery sets across time-transcending ‘black dress moments’ in pop culture. So, you can tie in your fresh looks with this nostalgic old Hollywood aesthetic, painting a true image of classic couture. Our Lovestruck Solitaires combines the classics with a modern minimalist trend, featuring a heart shaped solitaire diamond as the central focus of the chain. So, opt for it and embody the timeless appeal of diamonds-emanated shine.
3. Experiment & Express Your Style When you’re adorned in that perfect little jet-black number, glowy jewellery shall pop all the more, distributing focus to different points. Mia by Tanishq’s Firefly Collection features glowy jewellery that will remind you of the delicate yet determined glow of the light-bearing, zen creatures fluttering against the night sky - synonymous with your soul’s radiance.
4. Layer to Intensify Intrigue You can go for a layered arrangement of jewels. If you invest in more than one of our budget-friendly lovestruck ornaments, you can stack them together to create a unique mix! This one-of-a-kind fashion-forward take on jewellery will immediately re-centre the attention of your fellow fashion lovers on you!
5. Build Around Your LBD’s Neckline & Cut Outs (if any) Taking your dress’s neckline and overall symmetry into consideration may be an important step. It will help you decide on a vibe for a particular occasion. For example, if it’s an office event, you may want to opt for a high neck or an overlock-detail black dress. On the other hand, if you’re attending your regular boardroom meetings and want to keep it more low-key, go for a shirt-style collared black dress. Finally, at your college freshers’ party, an iridescent, cowl-neck dress will be the perfect choice to light up the environment. In either of these cases, you can pick out specific jewellery from the Firefly or Lovestruck collection, based on your style, trending motifs and budget.
Types of Jewellery: Explore Jewellery that Mystify like Fireflies & Unleash the ‘Arrow of Love’ Mia by Tanishq brings its beloved Mia women a range of versatile jewellery pieces which are not only artistically evolved but engineered to perfection. The secret glow formula used to ignite the ‘fire’ of our Firefly collection remains the central mystery of our Miaverse. The jewellery featured in this collection glows and is charged by ambient light. At night, you can charge your jewels with the help of a phone's flashlight - make this your supreme party check! The Lovestruck Collection features a selection of love-inspired jewellery, symbolising a bond that cannot be broken by the harsh strains of a limited lifespan on earth. It stands for a love that stretches beyond the ‘Jeremy bearimy’s of our Universe, battling through, to the ends of infinity! So, here are some jewellery options you can explore with us to find meaning through your LBD-based outfit curations:
1. Glowy Pendants
You can opt for the Firefly Fantasy 14 kt Gold & Swiss Blue Topaz Necklace to go with your ‘little black dress’-slay of the night. Whether it’s a cocktail dress or a formal delight, the glowy pendant shall vibe perfectly well with it, tying it to a whimsical, fantastical aura. While the little black dress has been done quite a number of times over the decades, accessorising it with one-of-a-kind jewellery can elevate the look, transforming the ensemble into a memorable statement of style.
2. Glowing Stud Earrings
Gold earrings have always been recognised as essentials in jewellery. By opting for such universally-styleable pieces, you can create a bunch of different outfits and lookbooks, without having to shop specifically for each one. Hence, you’ll be avoiding the wasteful risk of keeping certain items locked away in a wardrobe forever. Instead, you’d often want to reach out for the glow-pigment-bearing studs from Mia by Tanishq to uniquely complement your black dress drips.
3. Glowy Gold Rings
While you can go for a statement layered-rings look, that’s super popularly seen across front pages of style periodicals, you can also rock our singly. Made to serve multiple aesthetic purposes and stylistic directions, the fresh glow-rich ring designs are one-of-a-kind, rare gems in terms of jewellery design that are must-haves in versatile, diverse ornament banks. Especially, a simple black dress will be immediately elevated to the level of an ‘elite’ with the addition of our fireflies.
4. Necklace with Heart Solitaire
Transform your little black dress into a whimsical treat to the eye of the beholder. Pair it with a ‘chain and pendant with heart solitaire’ to highlight its romantic quotient in combination with a contemporary edge. You can also add a faux leather jacket to the Little Black Dress, to play on the textures and depth of your ensemble. The heart solitaire is not only a modern variation of the classic standalone diamond enclosed in a gold mould but also a reminder of a heart full of sentiments!
5. Stud Earrings with Round Solitaire
Choosing the classic black little dress as your dress of the night is a statement on its own. However, turn up the class with the help of our ‘stud earrings with round solitaire’ and have the sparkle speak in volumes, on your behalf! Apart from emphasising your eye for beaming detail, this choice shall also highlight your love for ‘vintage glam’, pushing it into the limelight.
6. Ring with Heart Solitaire
There’s always room for more rings! Alongside your glowy rings, pile on another - a ‘Ring with heart solitaire’ and further boost up the elegance metre. This combination of rings shall bring about a whirlwind of trending textures and evergreen sentiments together to form a visual, awe-striking treat!
Final Word Before You Take another Twirl in Your Little Black Dress The Little Black Dress shall remain a classic silhouette for many more years to come. Characteristics of strength, mystery, and boldness – the colour black combined with the graceful, feminine cut of a mini dress perfectly satiates the fashionista’s longing for a fashion-forward moment. The best way to personalise the Little Black Dress is through intentional accessorising - layering necklaces, dressing up the ear piercings and going for the perfect gold and diamond ring! By investing in jewellery to wear with your black dress, you get to make a statement with a classic direction in styling, combining timeless charm with fresh perspectives. With Mia by Tanishq, you can invest in jewellery that not only complements a black dress but also enhances its appeal with a tasteful portion of alluring gleam. At an affordable price tag, get your hands on versatile daily wear jewellery, and take your LBD-themed party drips to the ultimate ‘diva ’ level.

page-attributes.page-title: Fall in Love with the Lovestruck Collection: A Celebration of Romance | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Lovestruck Collection is a tribute to the timeless emotion of love, capturing its beauty through stunning jewellery designs. Discover how heart shaped solitaire makes every moment feel magical.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Mia's Collections
Unravel the Story of Mia by Tanishq’s Lovestruck Collection The rawest and most real feeling of them all – love – finds physical manifestation through Mia by Tanishq’s latest Lovestruck Collection. Through this launch, we bring you a platter - jewels representing vulnerabilities, authentic selfhood in a partnership, and a push towards risk-taking in love – all through sparkly finery! The tale surrounding our Lovestruck Collection revolves around our love-struck Mia beauties, and rightfully so! From chronicles about affections, heroic declarations of commitment, a battle fought in the name of spiritual union, and finally, to a conclusion resulting in ‘Happily Ever After’ – the tale covers the cycle of a warrior in love. While love can feel like the most natural thing in the world – it takes a brave heart to completely let their ‘anima’ intertwine with their partner’s. With this drop, we at Mia by Tanishq want to celebrate the untarnished love and the lovers who have allowed their souls to ascend into a state of emotional union, not letting the villains (doubts, questions and reluctance) take over! At the strike of Cupid’s arrow right into the heart of the to-be lover, the sparkly stars oozing out to replace blood is what went into brewing up the Lovestruck Collection! Now that you know about the secret ingredient that birthed the sparkle of our latest jewellery line, be ready to discover more legends and anecdotes within the infinitely wounding Miaverse!
Our Inspiration: Gleaming Thoughts & Loving Reminiscences There’s more than one way to express affection and ‘love language' does not shy away from making itself widely adopted. Gift-giving is a popular love language that comes in handy for people who tend to be shy or reserved about their feelings. As presenting a valuable gift to your partner is essentially a way to express your emotions, it is a much-appreciated love language spoken by lovers, loved by people who adore little surprises! What better gifts to word out a confession of your adoration towards a person’s sparkly soul, happy-go-lucky approach towards life and contagious cheer for being - other than diamond-studded jewellery? That's why we created an iconic line of pendants, chains and earrings so you can coat your love confession in ‘bling’ that never ‘dings’! Here are some thoughts and notions that inspired us to create the perfect glowy-concoction, emerging as our ‘Lovestruck Collection’:
Infinite Nature of Love The love stories we drew inspiration from not only spoke about romances stretching across far-fetched lands but also described the feeling as ‘immortal’. As anyone would find it ultimately difficult to define ‘love’ – there’s a version of it in everyone’s mind, closest to the vision of their lover’s pleasant face. How romantic is that? We were inspired to pick ‘love’ as our muse because of how much power it held even in its most relaxed state. To be in love is not to constantly convey how smitten one is with their person (even if that’s the case at all times) – instead, it is the quiet security that prevails even through ‘uneventful days’. It is the fullness of heart that stirs the mind of an intellectual in love. This whole concept moved us to incorporate pieces like Heartfelt Radiance 14 kt gold & Diamond Stud Earrings, Enchanted Heart 14 kt Gold & Diamond Pendant with Chain and Celestial Heart 14 kt Gold & Diamond Finger Ring so you can narrate fables about your deepest feelings, rooted in vulnerability and realness – all through a sparkly gifting moment!
Love as a Shield to Protect the Heart Love serves as a protective shield guarding the heart, at all times. No matter the adversities of daily life, the lover knows that he/she stays winning as they have that one constant person, part of their life-line. There's a sudden pump of ecstasy into the vein as soon as you set your eyes on the radiating face of the ‘Love of Your Life’! Do you remember that one day you had a super stressful time at the office? All you needed was a fresh cup of coffee with your beloved - and suddenly, all your worries vanished into thin air! You took that little post-work walk with your beloved and it simply refreshed your mind and rid it of any lingering anxieties. This effect love has on a person is what drove us to create love-infused knickknacks in the form of dainty jewellery.
Love Being the ‘Centre’ of One’s Life No matter how hard one tries to convince that love is not the only thing that matters – let's be real, it is! Whatever happens in life, however, many jarring wounds are inflicted upon the soul by the ridiculous absurdity of the Human world, and whatever goes haywire - love can heal, fix and re-track. It remains the centre of one’s life as it is a sensitive matter of the heart. If one is assured of being greeted by that dazzling, happy, smiling face once they get back home – everything seems to get a bit easier and the heart starts to feel lighter. Love is the driving force, the medium of mindful ascent, the motivator and the motto to ‘just keep going!’ As love serves as such efficient fuel in making one keep on rising above the daily dilemmas, we knew our love-struck customer base would much appreciate a sparkly remembrance to clasp onto, during their time of turmoil. So, we introduce our love-inspired collection as a symbol of the ‘goodness’ that’s waiting back home, the long-distance love that’s longing for and looking forward to being enraptured in your essence one day, and the love that’s working away to keep things afloat! That was our inspiration behind the Lovestruck collection - there’s a design for all our lady-loves in it. These pieces perfectly combine a sophisticated vibe with a valued sentiment, with, of course, an added coat of decade-abound glaze!
Love’s DNA: Materials Used in the Lovestruck Collection To make sure that our Lovestruck Collection remains in tune with the spirit of timelessness – Mia by Tanishq sourced raw materials with the ultimate aim to mesmerise souls across generations. Here's an overview of the materials that went into materialising the feeling of being ‘struck by love’:
Yellow Gold Yellow gold in jewellery has been a popular choice among ornament enthusiasts. Its value is prone to increase with time and so is its aesthetic appeal – yellow gold simply never goes out of trend. So, we moulded gold to produce intricate, contemporary jewellery designs – we’ve got your back in every aspect.
Solitaire Diamond The solitaire diamond is an ever-green symbol of commitment and pure love. Sentenced to solitary yet a glorious existence, the standalone diamond centrepiece grabs and holds the attention of the beholder, in a continued state of bewilderment. This Lovestruck collection features unique heart-cut diamonds further adding a romantic flavour to the timeless mix - wrapping the wearer in an ever-cuddly embrace of love.
Types of Jewellery: ‘Love’ in Collaboration with ‘Sparkle’ While we are all quite aware of the ‘Love is equal to a Spark’ equation, this spark can be lit in so many different ways! Apart from being lit through loving action and verbal affirmation, love is about the quiet acceptance of a person with all their goodness and flaws. It is the sigh of relief you have on seeing your partner come out on top of a challenging situation. It’s about knowing that you’ll be okay if they are okay! To bring these notions to fruition, we took up the job we do best and applied the honed skills of our dear craftsmen to create valuable jewellery representing the variable nature of sensitivity. Express your love comfortably and have them feel exactly what you want them to, through a gift of beaming beauty – rich in romantic metaphors, sentiments and of course, versatility! Here are the types of jewellery you can explore within the Lovestruck Collection:
1. Necklaces and Pendants The necklace designs that feature in our Lovestruck Collection, have one thing in common – a soft corner for a longing, loving heart. While you have already been introduced to the muse of this tale, ‘love’, there’s more to the narrative. From telling stories about fairytale-esque happenings to confessions about love filling the delicate heart with brewing emotions, the necklaces are characterised by a wide range of romantic musings.
2. Rings Love choreographs an awe-striking sequence, performed by the hearts of two lovers looking to emerge as one. This dance is the ritual that spiritually binds them to one another – down through several re-births and afterlives. The same notion is invoked and celebrated through our fresh, intrigue-piquing ring designs, birthed from love-driven subconscious feelings buried at the very bottom of a genuine lover’s dear heart.
3. Stud Earrings A pair of earrings is the figurative symbol of two people finding their way back to one another. The sense of surety that comes with being a part of a genuine connection grants unfathomable joy. We materialise this feeling of perpetual oneness with a partner through our innovative earring designs. You’re sure to find a jewellery piece in the Lovestruck Collection, that shall convey the sparkly nectar of loving, ‘sweet-nothings’ you have sheltered in your heart for so long!
Styling Tips to Make the Most of Our Lovestruck Collection's Aesthetic Spell Style is a very personal thing, often proving to be the most important consideration in one's life – as it serves as a medium of self-expression. When we were only at the planning and brainstorming stage that led to the creation of our final Lovestruck products, we collectively decided at once to incorporate a versatile style palette that would complement all our Mia women's styles. Yet, depending on how you style the jewellery, they can transform the look completely! Below, we've listed some trendy styling tips in regard to the Lovestruck Collection, so you can dazzle and feel connected to your love, anywhere you go:
1. Go for a Minimalistic Vibe The designs featured within our latest Lovestruck Collection are uniquely crafted to suit your modern, chic and minimal style. Versatile enough to wear with different categories of apparel, the minimally designed ornaments are just the ideal accessories to liven up a subtle statement! The minimalist, ‘clean’ look is trending all over social media. Fashion designers have also been dabbing their way into the ‘less is more’ vibe capsule through clothing. Ultimately, they are also experimenting with minimal accessories, as no look is ever complete without at least a quiet, slinky gold pendant strung along a chain! You can also experiment with such low-key, sophisticated ensembles and elevate them with the help of our Lovestruck collection. Picture this: You’re dressed in your usual office basics, a flowy, silk blouse with tapered sleeves and beige tailored trousers. Yet, it’s somehow making you sparkle extra bright – owing to the addition of our ‘chain and pendant with heart solitaire’!
2. Layer to Double or Triple the Love Why stick to one neckpiece when there are so many love notes to read? Opt for more than one pendant to double or triple the visual appeal, through a unique arrangement of sparkle across the decolletage area. Plus, if you have more than one piercing on your ears, you can dress them up and have them dazzled in our ‘stud earrings with heart solitaire’ and ‘stud earrings with round solitaire’. This combination shall infuse multiple, shine-rich points of focus around your face. Chew on This: Opt for a solid-coloured dress to maintain a cohesive vibe and go ham with the layering of accessories! Have the solitaire on your necklace, ring and earrings cast a sparkly trail as you walk down the Red Carpet of life.
3. Play With Monochrome Ensembles If you often like to dress like an ‘enigma', embodying a vibe that cannot be touched or shaken at once – a monochrome look is the way to go. Right now, the 'mysterious' aura is a particularly trending topic, with everyone wanting their way in. However, being 'mysterious' may or may not come with its lonely consequences. But there's definitely something fun and ‘edgy’ about looking the part! Go for an all-black, ‘matrix-like Keanu Reeves-esque look and complete the ensemble with the addition of gold accents. Plus, the standalone diamond emanates just the right amount of ‘shine to make your look appear well-thought-out!
4. Mix & Match the Love Chords There’s no #OTP when it comes to pairing jewellery with outfits. Be open to mixing and matching the different Lovestruck jewellery pieces together, across various vibes – one appropriate for the office, one for a social gathering and one for a movie night in! This way, you can get the full potential out of a specific piece, also ensuring extensive wear - making it worth your money. So, stock up on the essentials of jewellery, including a beaming pendant, a pair of studs and a classic, timeless ring – and get to experimenting fashionably, and regularly.
5. Let Personality Play a Part in Curating Your #OOTDs Whether you’re buying a Lovestruck piece for yourself or for someone you love – personalise the pick by infusing it with meaning and sentiment. For example, if you’re shopping for yourself, pick out a design that you see yourself reflected in. If you identify the sparkle of a certain piece, it may be a ‘calling’, almost confirmed by the Universe that the jewellery piece is meant for you and you’ve been love-struck! As our newest jewellery pieces are versatile, it's going to be rather simple for you to switch between styles, vibes and aesthetics. So, select an avatar of your choice, on any day of the week, and style your love-infused ‘sparklies’ to the heart’s liking. With the above-mentioned styling tips in mind, you can make the most of the Lovestruck jewellery's aesthetic splendour! Elevate your daily essentials with a much-needed glint of glamour while also being reminded of your version of the love story every time you get a glimpse of your dazzling reflection!
Final Word As another lore within the Miaverse comes to a close, we want to emphasise a little bit more, the importance of 'loving'. Let yourself find the emotional outlet you've been looking for, the channel to release your pent-up feelings into, and emerge as the best version of yourself. Become a ‘baby’ and bask in the glory of being able to let your inner child breathe in the presence of ‘your’ person. With Mia by Tanishq, find the perfect jewellery gifts for your lover or your beloved ‘self’ within your preferred budget. Sit pretty with the arm of your lover holding you close, as you dazzle and sparkle in our Lovestruck beauties.

page-attributes.page-title: Types of Mangalasutra: Traditional & Contemporary Designs | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Preparing to buy a Mangalsutra for the wedding? Set off on a journey to explore the different types of Mangalsutras adorned by women across diverse India.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Beginner's Guide
Mangalsutra Across India: A Journey Through Culture and Tradition A mangalsutra is adorned by brides across India – in the form of non-dimmable gold pendants in the South of our country to pristine, diamond-embedded masterpieces up North. It is essentially a sacred thread symbolising the marital status of a woman. Beyond its significance as jewellery, it is a medium of manifestation for a lifelong bond between two star-crossed lovers. While the traditional make of a Mangalsutra features a combination of black beads strung along a bright yellow thread – several variations of it have been introduced across our diverse land, aka India! Different types of Mangalsutras have dominated big fat wedding ceremonies within various regions of the country. They particularly encapsulate the aesthetics & aura of a place. Not only that, women have now taken it upon themselves to personalise their mangalsutras, having it represent their dynamic personality and unique taste in accessorising! Modern women have been expressing their preference for minimal designs in jewellery, for a while now. So, there’s no reason to step away from this personal inclination when choosing a necklace that they’re going to have to commit to, for the rest of their lives. The sacred thread in its most evolved, trendy form - combines the ritualistic vein with an intricate, refined finish! While Mangalsutras represent the deep-rooted cultural significance associated with a destination – they are, indeed, an intricate visual depiction of the ‘spirit of a state’. Traditional, region-specific aesthetic appeal personalises an ornament, showering it with meaning. So, take a visual tour of India and its cultures spread across acres of land through Mangalsutra trends capturing their aesthetic essence!
Types of Mangalsutras Worn by Women Across India Women across India wear different types of Mangalsutras – either one with a simple yellow thread and black beads combination or a pendant with its centre infused with marquise-cut diamonds, among others. As Mangalsutra designs vary from state to state in India, there's much to explore in terms of aesthetics and cultural pointers within a place. Since this ornament is specially designed with traditions and ritualistic essence in mind – it has much to tell of the culture & mythology associated with a place. Learn about different types of Mangalsutra designs dominating the wedding scene, from the Himalayan Peaks up North to the Kanyakumari of Southern India:
1. Dijhor or Dejhoor in Kashmir The groom's family gives a Kashmiri bride earrings made of gold, wrapped up in a plain red thread. It is an intriguing variation of a classic Mangalsutra pendant design, essentially being earrings at the very first stage. Once the bride steps into her groom's family home, the plain red thread containing the gold is replaced by a gold chain. Due to the ornament’s one-of-a-kind allure, it is particularly representative of the Kashmiri identity featuring distinct traditional motifs – tying the bride to her ‘roots of origin’ even on the day she leaves home!
2. Taagpaag in Bihar Mangalsutra is called a 'Taagpaag' in Bihar, featuring a classic black beaded chain. It is the groom's family's choice as to what type of pendant they want to opt for. A popular trend in pendant choices for a Taagpaag is a 'minimalist charm'. As minimal designs are lightweight, they are an ornament that the Bihari bride can wear at all times. Whether she is running her daily errands or helping around the house, she is not weighed down by her heavy jewellery. Plus, in Bihar, the Taagpaag is worn in association with a toe ring – casting a protective aura on the wearer, from the Heart Chakhra (‘Anahata’) to the Root Chakra (‘Muladhara’).
3. Gujarati Mangalsutra in Gujarat
A Gujarati bride adorns a classic version of Mangalsutra featuring a gold centrepiece strung along black beaded chains. However, a traditional design does not limit a woman’s creative vision and love for the aesthetic galore. So, women choose diamond pendants and prefer a shorter chain to add a personal touch to the look. Not only are the diamonds iconic within the 'Department of Sparkle', but also signify desirable traits like purity, life-transcending beauty & ever-blooming love.
4. Vati Mangalsutra in Maharashtra
The Vati Mangalsutra design originating in Maharashtra is special for its visual appeal – featuring a black beaded chain and two gold ‘Vati’s, the term translating to bowls in English. The incorporation of the Vatis in the Mangalsutra design hosts cultural significance – the bowls representing ‘Shiva’ & ‘Shakti’. 'Shagun' & 'Nirgun' are the two black beads’ variations, forming a dual-chain moment - symbolising the ever-lasting bond between the husband & wife.
5. Karthamani Pathak in Karnataka In Karnataka, a ‘Karthamani Pathak’ is worn by brides based in Coorg - as a symbol of eternal love and sacred matrimony. This variation is an interesting take on the classic Mangalsutra design – featuring two different segments, namely the ‘Karthamani’ and the ‘Pathak’. While the Pathak is a gold pendant, essentially a large coin with Maa Lakshmi’s image engraved on it, the ‘Karthamani’ is composed of gold beads and corals. Variations of the Karthamani Pathak also may feature accents of rubies and dangling freshwater pearls – multiplying the style quotient by a margin!
6. Thaali/Bottu in Tegulu Telangana The Telugu Mangalsutra, referred to as 'Thaali', 'Bottu' or 'Pustelu' is a figurative ‘gold mine’ of meaningful associations. It features 2 round-shaped coins or discs, each offered by the groom’s and bride’s side of the family, respectively. The coins are tied to a yellow thread, forming a new ornament that the groom ties around the bride's neck. According to the ritual, the 2 discs are connected after 16 days. After the ceremony draws to a close, the bride takes a refreshing bath and adorns a new saree. This whole ritual is an effort towards establishing harmony between 2 families. Finally, women can opt for a diamond, gold or gemstone-studded pendant with the mangalsutra – keeping up with their style or the latest, trendy jewellery trends!
7. Minnu in Kerala The meaning and importance of Mangalsutra in Indian culture continues to be reflected through ‘Minnu’ variation of the ornament. It is adorned by a Christian bride, as a symbol of commitment & love. It is also a representation of the type of relationship that a bride and groom must nurture – similar to the sacred one shared between the ‘Church’ and ‘Jesus’. Small gold circular dot-like constructions form a cross on a heart-shaped medallion as part of the Mangalsutra design. The Minnu is passed through 7 threads, each symbolic of a contestant of the spiritual-union ceremony – like, the bride, groom, Church, and parents of both the parties.
8. Thaali Kodi in Tamil Nadu Most commonly seen during a Hindu marriage ceremony, ‘Thali Kodi’ symbolises a spiritual union between lovers and hope for their growing prosperity. During a certain 'Mangal Dharanam' ceremony, the groom bestows a 'Thali' on his beloved. A ‘Thali’ being made of gold, bears sacred images relating to a Tulsi Patta (or plant), a family deity, or an avatar of Goddess Meenakshi and Lord Shiva. The groom’s family presents a Mangalsutra to their bride. So, they can opt for Mangalsutra designs featuring charms like gold coins, diamonds or gemstones to personalise the ornament. It adds a unique character to the Mangalsutra and personalises it to the bride's style.
9. Sindhi Mangalsutra in Rajasthan & Madhya Pradesh
A Sindhi Mangalsutra is the closest in aesthetics to the classic Sutra design – featuring a gold & black beaded chain alongside a breathtaking centrepiece. Modern women prefer to opt for this minimally crafted yet fantastical-in-make pendant as it is not only stylish but also lightweight – making it wearable. So, women can style the Mangalsutra with different types of outfits – ranging from traditional sarees to smart, business-casual attires! There you have it! Wasn’t that a rollercoaster ride through a vast, country-wide museum of visual ecstasy? Now, the next section provides insight into how the Fashionista woman has personalised her Mangalsutra– to transform the ornament into something unique & special.
Modern Makeover of the Traditional Mangalsutra Design Here are some of the popularly noted trends traced through the sacred act of choosing an ideal mangalsutra, within homes across India: Opting for a Minimal Mangalsutra Design
By choosing a minimal make of Mangalsutra, the bride is allowed way more scope to be creative with her daily outfit picks. While being versatile enough to style with different types of closets, a minimally-designed Managlsutra is also easy to wear 24/7.
Choosing Mangalsutras ft. Diamond & Other Gemstones
While a yellow thread/chain and black beads remain constant through most Mangalsutra variations, opting for pendants with diamond or gemstone-embedded casts a modern spell on a traditional design.
Going for a Mangalsutra with a Personal Character
As the new wife leaves her parents’ home to join her husband’s family, she is bound to feel displaced at first. Then, she would love to hold on to something that feels like her own. So, the groom's family may choose a Mangalsutra featuring a meaningful charm, like the initials of the bride’s name, or a date which is special to her!
The final Word on the Masterpiece is the Mangalsutra Across a country particularly known for its cultural diversity and for hosting the grandest weddings – jewellery designs are far away from taking a backseat. Plus, mothers tend to start selecting the jewellery pieces for their daughters at the fresh announcement of a possible wedding! While various types of Mangalsutras are adorned by women across India, notions of infinite commitment and blessed bonding remain consistent. Discover designs of Mangalsutras online with us to find your cultural & aesthetic match in jewels.
