page-attributes.page-title: Unveiling Mia Tanishq’s Elegant Native Collection | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Mia by Tanishq collection brings together delicate artistry and contemporary style. Discover the unique tale woven into every piece and why Mia by Tanishq is the perfect blend of tradition and trend.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Yet again, this Akshaya Tritiya, Mia by Tanishq is all set to personify elegance with the launch of the latest jewellery collection, the “Native Collection”. Through this game-changing collection, we celebrate women who are constantly breaking free from societal strings holding them back.
What makes a woman “divine” is her commitment to never being dimmed by the imposed mundanity of daily life - instead letting her unique shine come through by watering her very roots. It is what exactly our Native Collection signifies - a connection to your deepest, rawest self, grounded in originality and endurance.
As the sparkle has always been there somewhere, within you or your favourite woman - Mia by Tanishq aims to manifest it into reality. Have the native necklace designs like that of our Nomadic Warli Charm 22KT Gold Necklace glimmer around your neck and remind you of your power and determination every day before you head out to work.
Let a stack of Chic Warli 22KT Gold Bangle, Saura Artistry 22KT Gold Bangleon your wrist symbolise how far you've come with every graceful "clink"! The Artisanal Warli Art 22KT Gold Stud, Saura Alchemy 22KT Gold Pendant and Saura Symphony 22KT Gold Bangle are all representative of your constant, unchanging and all-powerful soul.
In our “Native Collection”, you’re sure to find the right piece of jewellery that vibes with your unapologetic self.
Beauty Tip
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
 
We are Inspired by You
Our main source of inspiration is you in your most authentic form and the metaphorical place of your nativity. Emerging from the fertile grounds of Mother Earth to a place of success and infinite love - you excel in every realm of life.
Nothing drives us more to create unique designs than your vibrant personality and consistent strive to get things done! Across the collection inspired by Warli art across the earrings to the pendant designs - every intricate carving and detail tells delightful tales about the Mia woman.
Womanhood and Feminine Poise
Not only are you blessed with unique characteristics of your own, but you inspire fellow women across generations, every single day. Your sensitivity to every situation drives away the stagnancy of modern life.
Even holding a conversation with you puts a disturbed mind to rest, healing others of any lingering doubts about the miraculous nature of life. Our Native Collection encapsulates all of these emotions in the form of 22-karat Gold Jewellery.
Warli Art Design & Saura Art
Warli art and Saura Art are ancient Indian cultures passed down through generations in Indian tribes. Their captivating art and vibrant culture­ touched something dee­p within us. These ele­ments became the­ foundation for the peaceful, grounding e­motions we aim to capture in our Native Colle­ction.
We drew inspiration from different elements of the Earth. Legends attest how Warli women were known to paint the walls of their new homes after marriage to reflect through the artwork, the emotions of delight and innocent ecstasy! This is what inspired us to turn such sentiments into material form - through our Native Collection jewellery ornaments.
The Tarpa Dance
This dance style depicts the circle of life. It has been around since ancient times, with tribal folks participating in it in full glory. The Tarpa is essentially an instrument which is played by some, while others dance to its tunes.
The moves are believed to impart the necessary vitality for the crops to grow healthily during harvest season. With its undeniable mystical undertones, the tarpa dance inspired a lot of the designs in our Native Collection.
Find the Perfect Type of Jewellery from Our Artful Native Collection
Have you been obsessed with the Indo-Western style lately and want to slay your look? The layering of a solid-coloured or floral-printed shrug on top of a pastel-coloured tank top, paired with classic ripped jeans is the perfect outfit-combo screaming Indo-western!
Finally, top it all off with the versatile Native jewellery pieces to bring the entire look together, while simultaneously maintaining an air of minimalism, grace and effortlessness.
Our Native collection has got you covered with the finest bunch of Insta-Worthy jewellery pieces. Explore the types of jewellery you can find in this latest collection from Mia by Tanishq to level up your style game this Akshaya Tritiya.
1.Pendants and Necklaces
Crafted in 22 kt gold, our pendants and necklaces symbolise an innate connection between you and the realms of nature. The designs reflect paintings on the walls of mud-houses and the famously adored Mandana paintings in Rajasthan.
Styling Tip: You can style the pendants or necklaces separately to complement the brown, green, beige or other Earthy tones of your outfit. Be it a Kurti-jeans combination or a white shirt with neutral-toned pants you can slay in every outfit with our stunning jewellery pieces. Alternatively, use them as a layering piece to create a unique set across the décolleté area.
2.Studds, Hoop Earrings and Drop Earrings
The various studs, hoop earrings and drop earrings are made with keeping “working women” in mind. So, if there is a celebration at your workplace, Warli Folklore earrings are sure to bring out the Fashionista look.
With minimalistic designs and a perfect finish, you will shine in your way and yet not be overwhelmed while wearing these ornaments. From circular spiral motifs to twisted wire filigree - you can find any design you can vibe with our Native Collection!
Styling Tip: For the days you are fully decked up in your Indian attire, possibly for a cultural celebration at home or your office - keep it light on the trendy jewellery by opting for the minimalist studs.
Skip the necklace, and only put on your Serpentine Spells stud earrings or Eternal Heirlooms drop earrings to spice up your look and yet look effortless!
3.Bangles
Intricately designed yet not overwhelmingly heavy - you can put on a Bangle or stack several of them up together. Make sure to check out the various Native bangle designs to find the one which speaks to you.
Throughout the day, remind yourself to take a deep breath now and then, on hearing the bangles tinkle. These are also crafted with minimalistic designs and are wearable as a style statement on every occasion!
Styling Tip: You can wear the bangle as a signifier of self-love pretty much every day. Our native bangle designs like Saura Artistry and Filigree Tales are so uniquely crafted that you can pair them with any outfit and become the Belle of the Ball.
Plus, if you want to save it for special occasions only – that’s perfect! Gold jewellery is timeless and yet constantly trending. So, pair it with anything, from a red evening gown and matching dupatta to a red saree with a black, sleeveless blouse!
We Prioritise Sustainability and Source Our Materials Ethically
Our Native Collection is a tribute to the boundless forces of nature on its own. As we prioritise the environment and Mother Nature over anything else, making sustainable choices of raw materials was a priority for us!
So, we present to you the main ingredient which went into bringing the Native Collection to life:
Recycled 22K Yellow Gold
We use recycled gold as a step towards reducing extra mining efforts and making strides towards conserving natural resources. Not only is the use of recycled gold more cost-effective but also has the same value and content as the newly mined gold.
With a high pure gold percentage, the Native Collection pieces hold incomparable value - in material and meaning! The shine of our timeless classic jewellery will be preserved throughout decades so you can hand it down to your favourite woman in the years to come too.
A Glimpse at Our Native Collection
Mia creates authentic native jewellery for the hustling woman, the stay-at-home mother dedicating all her time to keeping her family at bay or the lady looking to start her new business!
The term "Mia" translates to "mine" in Italian - gift your "own" or your beloved jewellery pieces she would cherish for life. Here’s a glimpse of some of our stand-out Native pieces:
1.Timeless Warli Art 22KT Gold Necklace
This dainty-looking pendant containing intricate lines and interesting circular patterns is a major conversion starter piece. You are sure to be approached by some of the stylish women in your community, complimenting your taste and even asking you for some style guidance!
2.Warli Dreams 22KT Gold Pendant & Chain
With the pendant as the star of the show, this neckpiece is not only a great ornament to style on its own but also a valuable layering piece. If you are confused about what to gift your mother on her birthday, this is the ideal choice!
It not only encapsulates her undeterred spirit but also her heart, the unending source of love for you and the rest of your family.
3.Artisanal Warli Art 22KT Gold Stud Earrings
The earrings find a mix between the modern and trendy shapes of the current year while also preserving the love for tangled details inculcated in generations of women. This is the perfect pair of earrings to gift your sister as a pre-wedding present.
Every time she looks at her earrings, she will be reminded of you, her hometown and her shine within, as she settles into her new lifestyle, in a new environment.
4.Whirls of Warli 22KT Gold Stud Earrings
Are you looking for the perfect pair of studs to gift to your best friend? Have her feel your appreciation for her in your life through this invaluable gift of love.
These stud earrings also tell a tale as old as time through complex lines and shapes while maintaining the iconic Mia touch of subtlety.
5.Saura Symphony 22KT Gold Bangle
Level up your style quotient by accessorising your wrists with classic yet modernly designed bangles. This bangle features semi-circles around the rim making it stand out among traditionally crafted bangles.
You can wear it on its own or pair it with a bunch of other bangles and have it play the showstopper. You can also wear it with a watch to elevate the look.
6.Tribal Rhythm 22KT Gold Finger Ring
This ring looks almost like the Evil Eye but is made with 22K Gold! Gift it to your beloved woman to protect her from all the bad juju in the world.
Every time she looks down at her ring, she is reminded of her divine power while being protected from and battling away any negative energy coming her way.
If you look through our Native collection, you are sure to find something which suits your personality or that of someone you have in mind. As there’s something for every woman, make sure that you explore this collection in detail and see for yourself which design resonates with your outlook on life!
We Prioritise Quality as well as Affordability We understand that you want to gift your beloved the highest-quality trendy jewellery while remaining within a budget. So, we at Mia by Tanishq, made affordability our top priority to set the most reasonable prices for our collections. So, you can simply choose the perfect design to match your vibe or that of the person you are gifting it to, without being held back by a budget! The bangles can be bought at around ₹30k - ₹1.2l while the finger rings start at only ₹30k! If you are comfortable with our prices, don’t miss out on the chance to explore the Native collection in depth today. Our Native Collection aims to help women connect to their roots and emerge in their most original form – not thinking about what anyone else has to say. These pieces of jewellery should serve as an emblem of how her authentic self is appreciated in the otherwise harsh world. Whether she is adorned in our Warli Symmetry 22KT Gold Pendant, Naga Talisman 22KT Gold Necklace, or Tarpa Legacy 22KT Gold Stud - It should remind her that she is divine, boundless and unstoppable!

content.description: Are you looking for the perfect necklace for an office party? Let Mia by Tanishq’s dainty & sophisticated line of necklaces do the talking and get you that deal!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Festival And Celebration
Choosing the Perfect Necklace for Your Office Party With the ‘corporate-core’ aesthetic particularly taking over social media by storm currently, dressing well for the office has not only become a requirement but a fun little moment for our 'fashionistas’. Plus, when it’s time to choose the perfect jewellery for a workplace party, that inner, office siren is simply 'so-ready' to come out! With the rise of pinstripes and grey tones as ultimate fashion codes this year, there was no stopping the ‘sophisticated avatars’ from ruling the vogue game. Think tailored trousers, fitted blazers and mid-length silk skirts - because they all serve as the perfect base for your corporate ‘slays’. But of course, dainty, subtle jewellery layered intentionally together, makes all the difference (we don’t make the rules)! An office-going fashionista tests her styling limits with a little assistance from her sparkly comrades - quirky, sheen-abundant jewels. Bam! She thus, turns into that ‘cool colleague from next cubicle’ in a matter of seconds, whom simply everyone wants to spark a conversation with. Are you specifically searching for the perfect necklace to go with your thoughtfully curated office party outfit? This choice is crucial as it can take your look from 'good' to 'an absolute banger'! 2. Understand Their Preference of Metals & Gemstones Does your person mostly wear gold or silver jewellery? content.description: Ready to put together the perfect Picnic Day Special look? We’ve got some fun & trendy tips on styling jewellery for a cheery day, outside!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Latest and Trending
Picnic Day Special: How to Style Your Jewellery for a Day Outdoors Who doesn't love a good old Picnic day with all their near & dear ones? Especially, as winter is approaching, it is the ideal time to plan out the perfect little outdoorsy moment with your closest circle! With the Sun shining its brightest, making the surroundings glimmer, get ready to soak up some great energy! While at it, create cute memories with your friends to think back on over the years to come. Besides heartfelt treats and stunning surroundings on a nice bright day, a picnic also calls for dressing up! For a picnic to qualify as ‘Pinteresty’, it requires its participants to indulge in theme-adjacent styling and accessorising.And, we at Mia by Tanishq got your back style-wise! If you love dressing up and expressing yourself through your style, decking up for a picnic day is a no-brainer. However, since it's an outdoor event, you might be wondering which type of jewellery would suit the occasion best. This Picnic Day special blog shall provide you with some pointers to chew on when styling and accessorising for a fun day on a nice Winter Sunday!
Styling Tips: Jewellery for ‘the Great Outdoors’ While planning a look for your picnic day outing, there are a few pointers to consider. Most importantly, you must remember that you will be moving around a lot – so, lightweight gold jewellery is likely to be the easiest to keep on throughout while maintaining a charming aura. Here are a few stylish yet practical ways to adorn your jewellery for the outdoors and make a statement as ‘the Summer Queen’:
Match with Nature Opt for jewellery which is on-theme with the environment you're in. For example, a picnic is preferably set in the arms of nature. So, choosing jewellery which features some of the recognisable elements of ‘the greens’, such as a blooming flower, tree twigs, the Sun motif, etc, will make your outfit look stunning and immersing with nature.
Match with Your Picnic Setup While you can match nature and its Earthy elements, you can also switch it up and match it with your picnic set-up. For example, if you opt for a specific theme, like an all-pink tea party - include jewellery which complements the pastel-pink shade of your picnic blanket or the hue of your Pina Colada. Alternatively, pre-plan a flower crown-making session as a bonding activity with your friends. You can then have the colourful accents of your jewellery picks match with the floral creations!
Keep it Light As you will be busy frolicking in the park or foresty area of your choice, you must opt for jewellery that is lightweight and easy to manage. So, choose dainty gold earrings or a sophisticated, subtle pendant to complete the look.
Don’t be Afraid to Layer it Up If you opt for lightweight jewellery in the first place, layering them together would not be ‘too much’ to handle at all. Rather, it would add a personal twist to your jewellery arrangement, defining your sense of style. So, choose gold, silver or mix the metals to create a stunning jewellery combination and add a personal character to your ensemble.
Incorporate the Trends Another way to make sure you’re on theme and looking fabulous, partake in the trends that are popping up this season. For example, the 'cottage-core' and ‘fairycore’ aesthetics are all the rage right now. They are particularly seen embraced by fashionistas going on their little picnics! So, consider opting for a floral dress, easy breezy in material and trendy in cuts - to embody the ultimate vibes of the season.
Opt for Waterproof Jewellery Opt for gold or silver jewellery - possibly embedded with diamonds or semi-precious gemstones if you love a pop of colour! These metals and gemstones are not the type to be stained or blackened at a splash of water. This step is crucial as it is likely that while you are outside, you’ll encounter water in nature. For example, if you go boating as part of the picnic itinerary, the inevitable water splashes may stain any metal that is not gold, silver or stainless steel. Plus, if you apply deodorant or perfume often, it's not going to affect the shine of your gold or silver jewellery.
Mixing Metals Match the natural and unpredictable vibes of the outdoors by opting for a mix of metals and gemstones. As mixing metals is a major trend as of now, this look is sure to stand out prominently on a bright, sunny Saturday. Quick Tip: While you are packing various treats, make sure to also include a small pouch. If it gets too warm outside or you’re heading over to indulge in any physical activity together with your friends, store the jewellery pieces in your pouch to keep them safe!
Types of Jewellery to Add a Cherry on Top of Your Picnic Day Special Looks If you’re looking to buy picnic jewellery online in India, make sure to check out all the dazzling options brought to you by Mia by Tanishq. We not only keep up with the latest jewellery trends in 14 KT, 18 KT, 22KT gold and silver but also are known for our marked, polished craftsmanship! So, here’s a glimpse of the types of jewellery you can explore with us and find the ones which aesthetically align with your ‘outdoorsy avatar’: Dainty Gold Necklaces
Opt for the ‘Lucky Charm 14KT Gold & Diamond Pendant’ as your necklace of choice, this Picnic Day. It is made to be lightweight on you as you go about your day, having the time of your life. In addition to that, the piece features a natural element as the centre-charm. The pendant is shaped to replicate a clover leaf, found in nature, serving as a symbol of good luck! So, put on your flowy, pastel yellow sundress and adorn the lucky charm necklace to tie the whole look together cohesively!
Semi-precious Gemstone Earrings
You can choose our semi-precious gemstone studded earrings and go for the trendy ‘no-necklace, only earrings’ look - a subcategory of the ‘Clean Girl aesthetic’. We recommend the ‘Cherry Chalice 14KT Ruby Stud Earrings’, so the pair can serve as a perfect statement piece! The vibrant pink of the rubies shall act as a pop of colour to an otherwise monochrome outfit. So, pick out your beige spaghetti top, peach shorts and brown sandals - break up the monochrome with a splash of alluring rubies!
Silver Bracelets
Opt for a multi-coloured silver bracelet to fetch in the ultimate ‘season vibes’. As the gemstones of our ‘Rainbow Sparkle Multi-Coloured Silver Bracelet’ match with different elements of nature, you can show up in the most colourful fit to match the seasonal cheer! Plus, the silver bracelets are a great option for accessories if you're on a budget. Mia by Tanishq specifically prioritises your budget over anything else, aside from quality (you're getting that in abundance!) So, you lean more towards a cooler colour palette of clothing - silver is the perfect choice of metal for you! For example, if you love to incorporate a bit of sky blue, lavender, grey or a sprinkle of green - the silver trinkets are the perfect way to elevate the look. There are a bunch of other options for you to explore at prices that shall blow your mind, here at Mia by Tanishq.
Final Word Before You Start Planning a Picnic to Remember! While it can be quite difficult to accessorise for the great outdoors, it is not an impossible feat. With Mia by Tanishq’s newest collection of dainty gold, diamond, & silver jewellery, experiment with different styles, to bring in the very vibe of the outdoor look. While the jewellery pieces are trendy in design, they are also made to incorporate timeless appeal. So, explore the latest designs of lightweight, subtle jewellery with Mia by Tanishq to wear on your adventures out into the arms of nature - at affordable prices!

content.content-id: The Tale of Mia by Tanishq’s Native Collection
content.display-name: The Journey to Our Roots, Crafted in 22 kt Gold

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Yet again, this Akshaya Tritiya, Mia by Tanishq is all set to personify elegance with the launch of the latest jewellery collection, the “Native Collection”. Through this game-changing collection, we celebrate women who are constantly breaking free from societal strings holding them back.
What makes a woman “divine” is her commitment to never being dimmed by the imposed mundanity of daily life - instead letting her unique shine come through by watering her very roots. It is what exactly our Native Collection signifies - a connection to your deepest, rawest self, grounded in originality and endurance.
As the sparkle has always been there somewhere, within you or your favourite woman - Mia by Tanishq aims to manifest it into reality. Have the native necklace designs like that of our Nomadic Warli Charm 22KT Gold Necklace, glimmer around your neck and remind you of your power and determination every day before you head out to work.
Let a stack of Chic Warli 22KT Gold Bangle, Saura Artistry 22KT Gold Bangle on your wrist symbolise how far you've come with every graceful "clink"! The Artisanal Warli Art 22KT Gold Stud, Saura Alchemy 22KT Gold Pendant and Saura Symphony 22KT Gold Bangle are all representative of your constant, unchanging and all-powerful soul.
In our “Native Collection”, you’re sure to find the right piece of jewellery that vibes with your unapologetic self.
We are Inspired by You
Our main source of inspiration is you in your most authentic form and the metaphorical place of your nativity. Emerging from the fertile grounds of Mother Earth to a place of success and infinite love - you excel in every realm of life.
Nothing drives us more to create unique designs than your vibrant personality and consistent strive to get things done! Across the collection inspired by Warli art across the earrings to the pendant designs - every intricate carving and detail tells delightful tales about the Mia woman.
 
● Womanhood and Feminine Poise
Not only are you blessed with unique characteristics of your own, but you inspire fellow women across generations, every single day. Your sensitivity to every situation drives away the stagnancy of modern life.
Even holding a conversation with you puts a disturbed mind to rest, healing others of any lingering doubts about the miraculous nature of life. Our Native Collection encapsulates all of these emotions in the form of 22-karat Gold Jewellery.
 
● Warli Art Design & Saura Art
Warli art and Saura Art are ancient Indian cultures passed down through generations in Indian tribes. Their captivating art and vibrant culture­ touched something dee­p within us. These ele­ments became the­ foundation for the peaceful, grounding e­motions we aim to capture in our Native Colle­ction.
We drew inspiration from different elements of the Earth. Legends attest how Warli women were known to paint the walls of their new homes after marriage to reflect through the artwork, the emotions of delight and innocent ecstasy! This is what inspired us to turn such sentiments into material form - through our Native Collection jewellery ornaments.
 
● The Tarpa Dance
This dance style depicts the circle of life. It has been around since ancient times, with tribal folks participating in it in full glory. The Tarpa is essentially an instrument which is played by some, while others dance to its tunes.
The moves are believed to impart the necessary vitality for the crops to grow healthily during harvest season. With its undeniable mystical undertones, the tarpa dance inspired a lot of the designs in our Native Collection.
 
Find the Perfect Type of Jewellery from Our Artful Native Collection
Have you been obsessed with the Indo-Western style lately and want to slay your look? The layering of a solid-coloured or floral-printed shrug on top of a pastel-coloured tank top, paired with classic ripped jeans is the perfect outfit-combo screaming Indo-western!
Finally, top it all off with the versatile Native jewellery pieces to bring the entire look together, while simultaneously maintaining an air of minimalism, grace and effortlessness.
Our Native collection has got you covered with the finest bunch of Insta-Worthy jewellery pieces. Explore the types of jewellery you can find in this latest collection from Mia by Tanishq to level up your style game this Akshaya Tritiya.
 
1. Pendants and Necklaces
Crafted in 22 kt gold, our pendants and necklaces symbolise an innate connection between you and the realms of nature. The designs reflect paintings on the walls of mud-houses and the famously adored Mandana paintings in Rajasthan.
Styling Tip: You can style the pendants or necklaces separately to complement the brown, green, beige or other Earthy tones of your outfit. Be it a Kurti-jeans combination or a white shirt with neutral-toned pants you can slay in every outfit with our stunning jewellery pieces. Alternatively, use them as a layering piece to create a unique set across the décolleté area.
 
2. Studds, Hoop Earrings and Drop Earrings
The various studs, hoop earrings and drop earrings are made with keeping “working women” in mind. So, if there is a celebration at your workplace, Warli Folklore earrings are sure to bring out the Fashionista look.
With minimalistic designs and a perfect finish, you will shine in your way and yet not be overwhelmed while wearing these ornaments. From circular spiral motifs to twisted wire filigree - you can find any design you can vibe with our Native Collection!
Styling Tip: For the days you are fully decked up in your Indian attire, possibly for a cultural celebration at home or your office - keep it light on the trendy jewellery by opting for the minimalist studs.
Skip the necklace, and only put on your Serpentine Spells stud earrings or Eternal Heirlooms drop earrings to spice up your look and yet look effortless!
3. Bangles
Intricately designed yet not overwhelmingly heavy - you can put on a Bangle or stack several of them up together. Make sure to check out the various Native bangle designs to find the one which speaks to you.
Throughout the day, remind yourself to take a deep breath now and then, on hearing the bangles tinkle. These are also crafted with minimalistic designs and are wearable as a style statement on every occasion!
Styling Tip: You can wear the bangle as a signifier of self-love pretty much every day. Our native bangle designs like Saura Artistry and Filigree Tales are so uniquely crafted that you can pair them with any outfit and become the Belle of the Ball.
Plus, if you want to save it for special occasions only – that’s perfect! Gold jewellery is timeless and yet constantly trending. So, pair it with anything, from a red evening gown and matching dupatta to a red saree with a black, sleeveless blouse!
We Prioritise Sustainability and Source Our Materials Ethically
Our Native Collection is a tribute to the boundless forces of nature on its own. As we prioritise the environment and Mother Nature over anything else, making sustainable choices of raw materials was a priority for us!
So, we present to you the main ingredient which went into bringing the Native Collection to life:
● Recycled 22K Yellow Gold
We use recycled gold as a step towards reducing extra mining efforts and making strides towards conserving natural resources. Not only is the use of recycled gold more cost-effective but also has the same value and content as the newly mined gold.
With a high pure gold percentage, the Native Collection pieces hold incomparable value - in material and meaning! The shine of our timeless classic jewellery will be preserved throughout decades so you can hand it down to your favourite woman in the years to come too.
 
A Glimpse at Our Native Collection
Mia creates authentic native jewellery for the hustling woman, the stay-at-home mother dedicating all her time to keeping her family at bay or the lady looking to start her new business!
The term "Mia" translates to "mine" in Italian - gift your "own" or your beloved jewellery pieces she would cherish for life. Here’s a glimpse of some of our stand-out Native pieces:
 
1. Timeless Warli Art 22KT Gold Necklace
This dainty-looking pendant containing intricate lines and interesting circular patterns is a major conversion starter piece. You are sure to be approached by some of the stylish women in your community, complimenting your taste and even asking you for some style guidance!
 
2. Warli Dreams 22KT Gold Pendant & Chain
With the pendant as the star of the show, this neckpiece is not only a great ornament to style on its own but also a valuable layering piece. If you are confused about what to gift your mother on her birthday, this is the ideal choice!
It not only encapsulates her undeterred spirit but also her heart, the unending source of love for you and the rest of your family.
 
3. Artisanal Warli Art 22KT Gold Stud Earrings
The earrings find a mix between the modern and trendy shapes of the current year while also preserving the love for tangled details inculcated in generations of women. This is the perfect pair of earrings to gift your sister as a pre-wedding present.
Every time she looks at her earrings, she will be reminded of you, her hometown and her shine within, as she settles into her new lifestyle, in a new environment.
 
4. Whirls of Warli 22KT Gold Stud Earrings
Are you looking for the perfect pair of studs to gift to your best friend? Have her feel your appreciation for her in your life through this invaluable gift of love.
These stud earrings also tell a tale as old as time through complex lines and shapes while maintaining the iconic Mia touch of subtlety.
 
5. Saura Symphony 22KT Gold Bangle
Level up your style quotient by accessorising your wrists with classic yet modernly designed bangles. This bangle features semi-circles around the rim making it stand out among traditionally crafted bangles.
You can wear it on its own or pair it with a bunch of other bangles and have it play the showstopper. You can also wear it with a watch to elevate the look.
 
6. Tribal Rhythm 22KT Gold Finger Ring
This ring looks almost like the Evil Eye but is made with 22K Gold! Gift it to your beloved woman to protect her from all the bad juju in the world.
Every time she looks down at her ring, she is reminded of her divine power while being protected from and battling away any negative energy coming her way.
If you look through our Native collection, you are sure to find something which suits your personality or that of someone you have in mind. As there’s something for every woman, make sure that you explore this collection in detail and see for yourself which design resonates with your outlook on life!

Styling Tips & Guides

Of course, a sweet little date is mandatory - whether it is a candlelit dinner, a stargazing night out, or a cutesy picnic date, the date outfit had to be on point! So, this year, expand your stylistic horizons by experimenting with new styles or tap into your favourite fashionable route to feel the most like you! We suggest going for a layered necklace arrangement with whatever shade of pink, red, or a dashing silver spurt you’re in the mood for this Valentine’s Day! There is a layered necklace arrangement for every mood of apparel you’re in, at Mia by Tanishq - that shall add the perfect amount of elegance to your dazzling #OOTDs, making you feel confident and ready to love!
Trend Dissection: The ‘IT’ Factor Brought Forth by Layered Necklaces in 2025 As we nose-dive into 2025, we notice how the year is rapidly warming up to clean details and minute inclusions as part of outfits. Styling has become all the more personal, and this sense of personality is brought forth by the addition of character to the overall ensemble. We’ve figured out the formula for you! It’s the right accessories paired together to get the ultimate stylish front. Now let us tell you why layered necklace arrangements are the iconic fashionistas’ favourites already, in 2025! Lined with notions of romance, triumphs and the chronicles of life - layered necklaces tell a story that presents the mind of the wearer of jewels. The layering trend has climbed to the top of try-lists for style enthusiasts owing to how every arrangement is different from the other and there is not a second curation that is similar to its predecessor or the one adorned by the next person. We say, go for it and just be ready to have your man flutter his eyelashes in awe of your gorgeous look!
How to Create Trendy Looks with Necklaces of Varying Lengths?

If you are looking to level up your style game this Valentine's Day, we hope you can take inspiration from our perspective on the layered necklace variants. Now, here are some tips and styling tricks to apply to slay with various necklace lengths, paired with one another, in terms of interest, practicality and story:

If you are the type of fashionista who cannot ditch her trousers in any case, this is the best option for you!

Perfectly suited to V-cut necklines, sweetheart cutouts and asymmetrical patterns - this one is for the rebel in love, unafraid to be herself and impress by being authentic!
Mixing the Royalty of Yellow Gold & Delicateness of Rose Gold
While a strain of timeless glamour runs through yellow gold jewels, a twist of loving ardour is imported by the rose gold feature. So, for this Valentine’s Day, harness the combined impact of the two, combining them in loving association with one another - curate a stylish mix of necklace layers that shall not only woo the lover but also fetch you a downpour of compliments on that Instagram photo-dump you post, later in the day! Beyond the meanings and narratives being nailed by this classic yet modern duo, gold and diamond necklaces and rose gold necklaces in collaboration shall be a super stylish 'cherry on top' of any category of outfit. Whether you are thinking, a pretty little black dress, an on-theme, fiery red number, an elegant gown to steal the show or a comfortable take on the top-and-trousers combo featuring an enchanting turn of sparkling surprise - the gold and rose partnership is the one you should recruit to do the slaying, this Valentine’s Day
Dinner Dates & Romantic Briefs: Layered Necklaces for Every Occasion You no longer have to stress over your outfit for the D-Day date because there's no way you're 'missing' with the perfect sparkle arrangement! Especially, with Mia by Tanishq, you get complete access to a gleaming edit, featuring the most iconic ready-to-wear layered necklaces and minimally-designed chains/pendants you can pair together to DIY your idea of ‘you’. Either do it yourself or pick out a classic necklace layers style - the choice is flexibly yours! Here at some styling tips to chew on as you plan your #OOTD for a dinner date or other romantic rendezvous: 1. Gold Glam for Dinner: You can opt for an all-gold layered necklace look for the dinner-time ensemble. Classic and timeless – be yourself as you feel the love running through your veins, as you indulge in delicacies and a ravishing conversation, sitting across your beloved! 2. Gold & Diamond for Daytime Picnics: Plan a sweet little picnic moment with your person for Valentine’s Day and elevate the floral dress of your choice with the addition of gold and diamond accents! 3. Yellow & Rose Gold for Long Drives: Opt for a DIY necklace arrangement featuring yellow gold and rose gold picks for your long drives and eclectic nights out on the town. This year, own your style and opt for accessories which truly make you feel confident. Go for a layered necklace arrangement and seal the deal with a memorable style statement - be rest assured, he’s going to be whipped all over again!

content.description: Are you curious about understanding diamond cuts? Learn how different diamond cuts influence its brilliance and value and choose the perfect diamond for yourself.

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Beginner's Guide
Understanding Diamond Cuts: A Beginner’s Guide Diamonds have captivated hearts for centuries, adorning women with a soft glow while accentuating their natural features. Their brilliance and fire symbolise love, commitment, strength, purity and enduring beauty for as long as they've been unearthed from the earth. But beyond their inherent allure, diamonds possess a fascinating world of light play and sparkle, determined by their cut. This ever-so-alluring gemstone is known for its ability to transmit light and sparkle so brightly. The brilliance of a diamond depends on its cut. Hence, a diamond cut is referred to as a design guide or style that is used when shaping a diamond for polishing. The cut of a diamond is like its magic formula, the way it interacts with light that brings its inner fire to life. As light travels through a diamond, it refracts, bends, and reflects, creating a mesmerising display of brilliance, fire, and scintillation. A well-cut diamond will unleash a symphony of sparkle, while a poorly cut diamond might appear dull and lifeless. In the same way, that a sculptor unlocks the form hidden within a block of stone, a diamond cutter awakens the brilliance locked within the rough diamond. While understanding diamond cuts may feel overwhelming, this blog article delves into the captivating world of diamond cuts. It lets you explore some of the most popular and dazzling options beyond the well-known round, princess, and heart shapes.
Exploring Popular Diamond Cuts : Blingy Options for the Sparkle Queens Diamonds are a beacon of fiery brilliance waiting to be unleashed - for they are the soul mates of modern women. Imagine the most dazzling disco ball you've ever seen, catching every flicker of light and transforming it into a mesmerising display. That's the magic of these diamond cuts! Each facet craves the light, urging the gemstone to erupt in a breathtaking display of brilliance that will set your heart ablaze and make you the queen of sparkle. Hence, read further in this guide to explore different diamond cuts and find the one that will ignite your inner radiance:
1. Round Brilliant Cut
The round brilliant cut is a classic and the most popular choice among the diamond ladies as it maximises the gemstone's brilliance and sparkle. Its symmetrical shape embodies the meticulous craftsmanship of cutting the 58 facets (including the culet) into round brilliant diamonds, enabling light to traverse and reflect through each facet easily. The versatility of this diamond shape is remarked for complementing various face shapes and necklines. You can adorn yourself with this diamond shape if your wedding guest vision board echoes the soft feminine aesthetic.
2. Heart Cut
The heart-cut diamond is the ultimate symbol of love, being an ideal choice for men in love to propose in a romantic way. This diamond cut features a sparkling stone in the shape of love and has 57 facets of which 6 to 8 facets are on the pavilion. The heart shape is completed when two rounded lobes meet at a point that exudes a romantic, elegant and bold design that radiates with fiery brilliance, being a stunning alternative to the round cut brilliance. From the perspective of a craftsman, it takes skills and expertise in abundance to create a stunning heart shape. The diamond initially takes the shape of a pear cut, which is later given a cleft at the rounded end. It is also to be noted that the heart's lobes or wings are mostly symmetrical, with the facets appearing as mirror images. As a stud earring, pendant set or engagement ring, you can style this iconic, romantic shape to a ceremony or event where the journey of two souls is commemorated.
3. Princess Cut
The popularity of the princess cut dates back to the early 80s and 90s when women raved about adding a tinge of that extra femininity to complete their elegant look. It is the second most sought-after cut choice in the contemporary era, enabling the dazzling queen bees of today's age to intertwine modernity and sophistication in their look subtly. This cut embodies a rectangular or square shape while its profile resembles the shape of inverted pyramids with four beveled sides. Its brilliance rivals the round cut, making it an excellent choice for the bridesmaids to befriend a bold statement piece.
4. Emerald Cut
The elongated and rectangular shape boasts step-cut facets, creating a hall-of-mirrors effect and symbolising understated elegance. This diamond cut prioritises clarity and colour over sparkle, making it a sophisticated choice for wedding guests who embrace refined beauty. Due to its large table, inclusions are more visible, so higher clarity grades are recommended. Rock your wedding guest look by recreating the styles of celebrities like Taylor Swift and Angelina Jolie. Give a new definition to the timeless and understated aesthetic, and let your jewellery piece share your unique story.
5. Oval Cut
The brilliance, gracefulness and elongated design of oval cuts have surged in popularity in recent times, thanks to the trendsetters Hailey Bieber and other superstars in the industry. If you are somebody who loves creating looks inspired by the Hollywood hot gossip girlies, then an oval-cut diamond necklace is the right choice for a wedding. This cut offers a unique contemporary twist on the traditionality of elegance. It also provides durability due to the absence of any sharp edges. Moreover, the slender and elongated look of the diamond shapes often makes the neckline appear slimmer and chiselled.
6. Cushion Cut
The cushion-cut diamond necklace is characterised by its combination of round and square elements, featuring rounded corners and larger facets that contribute to its vintage-inspired charm. Embrace the versatility of cushion cuts, suitable for various settings like solitaire, halo or three-stone designs. Its large facets enhance fire and brilliance, creating a captivating display of light. Additionally, this cut exudes a romantic and whimsical feel, with its unique brilliance making it a sought-after choice for those seeking a touch of nostalgia at vintage or bohemian-themed weddings.
7. Marquise-Cut
The marquise cut, known as the navette cut, is a popular choice among engagement ring diamond cuts and shapes. It boasts an elongated, elegant silhouette that resembles a boat hull. Its pointed ends, elongated elliptical shape and facet arrangement create a dazzling display of brilliance and fire. This makes it perfect for individuals drawn to a touch of vintage glamour. The marquise cut can flatter the fingers, making them appear slimmer and longer. Individuals planning to woo their partners with a timeless adornment must consider this diamond cut. It drapes your “LOML” in the magical diamond-y iridescence.
8. Pear Cut
The pear cut takes after the allure of marquise cut and the roundness of oval cut, offering a unique and romantic option for styling. This modified-brilliant cut is also known as the “teardrop cut” or “pendeloque” cut. Its teardrop shape features a pointed end and a rounded bulbous end, adding a touch of whimsy and individuality. Its brilliance is maximised when its facets and proportions are meticulously crafted, creating a play of light that dances across the stone. Incorporate a well-set pear diamond jewellery to add a touch of captivating sophistication to your clean girl ensemble.
9. Asscher Cut
The Asscher cut, with its geometric square or octagonal shape and high crown, reflects a vintage Art Deco charm. Unlike the square-shaped princess cut, this step-cut diamond accentuates Its large rectilinear facets and deep cuts that create a unique play of light, with a mesmerising hall-of-mirrors effect. This cut is therefore known for its brilliance and clarity, showcasing the diamond's inherent beauty. It is ideal for those seeking a distinctive and captivating diamond as it offers timeless elegance. Additionally, the corners of this diamond cut are markedly chipped to prevent chipping, making it perfect to slay your everyday ensemble.
10. Radiant Cut
Designed by Henry Grossbard in the late 1970s, this relatively new diamond shape exhibits the best features of the emerald and round brilliant cuts. This unique cutting technique combined with 70 facets enables the diamond to shine and sparkle like no other cut. Moreover, its rectangular or square shape features cropped corners, resulting in a dazzling display of light and fire. Its durability also makes it a versatile option for adding a tinge of sparkle to everyday wear. Individuals with an MBTI personality of ESFP can opt for this cut. It emphasises an outgoing and bubbly personality for people who view the world as their stage.
Beyond the Design: The Symphony of Details The true magic of diamond jewellery lies not just in its overall design but also in the finer details. The type of metal used, the cut and clarity of the diamond, and the craftsmanship all come together to create a symphony of luxury. Here are some expert tips to keep in mind while buying diamond jewellery:
The Metals Used The appeal of diamond jewellery is marked by the metal used to craft the piece. You must look for gold jewellery if you love the warmth of yellow or rose gold radiating against your skin. While, on the other hand, you should opt for white gold pieces encrusted with diamonds if you are looking for slightly more durable and versatile adornment options.
The Diamond Setting Gemstone Symphony The setting of a diamond indicates how the diamond is held in place, securing it from any damage and retaining its everlasting shine and beauty. The setting can affect the diamond’s appearance, security and overall design. There are various common settings, including channels, bezels, prongs and pave, each of which has its own advantages and unique characteristics. Hence, when you choose a diamond setting, consider your style, your preferred diamond shape and your desired level of security.
The Art of Craftsmanship When seeking diamond jewellery designs, pay attention to those that demonstrate exceptional craftsmanship, such as smooth finishes. Ensure that the diamond cuts are free of imperfections and look for intricate details that reveal the skill and dedication of the maker. All of these considerations work together to enhance the jewellery’s overall design. Remember, you must not settle for anything less. You are worth all the finer things in life, so why not indulge in the brimming opulence of diamonds?
Final Word About Understanding Diamond Cuts The world of diamond cuts is an adventure in light and sparkle. Each cut possesses its unique charm and fire, reflecting the personality and style of the wearer. Whether you are drawn to the classic elegance of the oval or the vintage glamour of the marquise, understanding diamond cuts empowers you to find a diamond that speaks to your heart and captures the brilliance of your life’s story. As you navigate the landscape of diamond cuts, you must remember that beyond the technical specifications, this gemstone is a timeless symbol of love. And hence, the cut you choose reflects the unique way your love story shines.

page-attributes.page-title: Unravel the Story of Mia by Tanishq’s Valentine’s Collection: Love in Every Detail
page-attributes.page-description: Read about the love story between inspiration & innovation that’s come to aesthetic fruition through Mia by Tanishq’s Valentine’s Collection - The Cupid Edit 3.0!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Mia's Collections
Unravel the Story of Mia by Tanishq’s Valentine’s Collection - Cupid Edit 3.0 With the ‘Season of Love’ scent brewing steadily to fog up the February air, it is only right for the Miaverse creators to stay one step ahead of the love-struck soul. Just as you're thinking about looking up some romantic gift options for the 'Love of Your Life', we've already set the tone and atmosphere for some heartfelt confessions against candle-lit backdrops! The Valentine’s collection features a range of gold pendants, rings and earrings, all sprinkled up top with the essence of being smitten in love. Regardless of the stage of love, you're in – the Mia by Tanishq hosts a line of sparkling manifestations of affection, representing various notions underlining the rawest, most deep-set feelings. Read this blog to dive into how we were inspired to designate ‘Love’ as our aesthetic muse – and the way we did Cupid’s image justice!
Notes on Our Sparkling Inspiration Points: The Different Stages of Love This Valentine’s we want to celebrate the journey of love which flows through the different stages of love, emotion, compassion, and affection. Whether it’s the playful spark of first love, the adventure of growing together, or the cosy magic of forever love, we’ve designed a piece that celebrates every kind of love story. But before we dive into the collection, let’s take a moment to explore the beautiful stages of love that inspired us to create a collection just for you to celebrate your love. 1. Ludus: Ludus is one of the first stages of love which inspired us the most. This represents a playful type of love that hits the lover like a minty breath of fresh air. When the soul feels irresistibly drawn towards another but isn’t sure if the feeling is mutual – one resorts to the power of heart-fluttering flirting. But even while the vibe remains low-key, the feelings start sprouting and ripening. Ludus is representative of the shy yet unafraid loving soul – ready to nosedive into a vessel of emotions! 2. Eros: When we were designing jewellery for Valentine's, Eros was one such stage which we related the most. Eros’s character is deeply intertwined with the concept of intense and fiery, representing the passionate side of love. Eros represents the comfort and excitement one feels in the presence of one lover bare-souled. 3. Pragma: When love is commitment, understanding, and compromise, when love is a sense of “Forever” then the stage is called Pragma. It represents a mature, cosily burrowed and calm – where one is locked in for even the unknown eternities to come. The character is representative of a sense of commitment to the love they’ve nurtured through time. Pragma represents the ability to love above and beyond the Self, committing one’s actions and emotions to one single breathing frame of affectionate abode. Beyond celebrating love and their feelings, we also pay tribute to Philautia, the God of self-love. For all our lovers who forget to appreciate themselves even after crossing off milestone after milestone - have your soul feel like it's wrapped up in a warm hug this Valentine’s Day with our The Cupid Edit 3.0 collection.
A Glimpse at the Designs Featured in Our Glimmering Cupid Edit Collection 3.0 The Valentine’s Collection features a line of trendy as well as soulful jewellery. High-quality jewellery gifts serve as the perfect tokens of love. With Mia by Tanishq, you can be assured of a shine that lasts a lifetime and beyond, echoing the timeline of your forever type of tale. Here are some of the concepts surrounding love, togetherness and partnership that materialised to serve as trendy, symbolic and everyday-appropriate jewellery:
Clouding Ludus’s Mind: 1. The Heart-in-Heart: Do you feel surreally calm when you walk hand-in-hand with your beloved person? The heart-in-heart design draws inspiration from the same concept and the essence of fireworks which result from such intimate moments! The interwoven hearts find physical manifestation via gold rings, gold pendants with chains, and more.
2. Love Locks: Such motifs are symbols of love and a commitment bound for the lifetime boat. Love locks, love collets and pad-lock forms are all representative of relationships being solidified, marked with a strain of infinity. Plus, you get to recreate your very own 'Emily in Paris' scene with your Gabriel, mimicking the love-scented atmosphere across Love Lock Bridge.
3. Dancing in Love: Have you ever experienced the freeing kind of love that sets your soul on fire and makes you want to dance away out of uncontainable ecstasy? Mia by Tanishq introduces heart-shaped designs featuring the repetitive and reverberating heartbeat pattern bound to form from a carefree tango! Highlighted with the brilliance of sparkling diamonds embedded into the love-strung constructions – the visuals shall ignite the same feeling as dancing the night away, in love.
4. Young Love & Pearls: Pearls represent a degree of purity of intention like no other. So, you get to have your confessions and intentions made crystal clear, pearly white from the get-go! Even at the starting stage of your relationship, express your motives and dedication at once – convey to them that you’re fully locked in!
In Eros’s Arms:
Toi-Moi (Two to Tango): The concept of Toi-Moi conjures up a world that only the two lovers in their sacred relationship can inhabit. This category features motifs like two in-sync hearts beating to the tunes of mutual feelings; the pairing of unique hearts; pear-shaped half-hearts coming together to complete each other and more. The Toi-Moi jewels also feature colour stones and pearls, forming a 'rare pair', like you and your beloved do!
In Eternal Love with Pragma: Eternity Bands: The eternity bands shall serve as figurative prayers for a love that breaks down barriers of wordy promises and transcends time with a confident stature. Such bands are crafted to host a whirlpool of meaning and sentiment, rich in thought and perfect for the February air.
Colour stones including Emerald, London Blue Topaz, Ruby and Rhodolite – all are incorporated in the Valentine’s Collection- The Cupid Edit 3.0, representing different traits that fuel the growth of love into an eternal entity!
Final Word for Our Lover Looking to Express their Deepest Affections With The Cupid Edit 3.0, we bring you a world of trendy, fashion-forward jewellery that’s perfect for your love story. Designed to be lightweight yet packed with heartfelt emotions, this Valentine’s Collection is made to resonate with love-struck souls everywhere. Discover gold earrings, pendants, and rings featuring textured heart patterns, vibrant gemstones, delicate pearls, and more. This ‘Season of Love,’ find the perfect piece to celebrate your person and cherish the magic of raw, real feelings. Explore the collection and find your perfect gift today!

content.description: Looking for trendy melody-coded jewellery? This World Music Day, trace the influence of music on jewellery trends & explore refined gold jewellery designs with Mia by Tanishq!

page-attributes.page-title: How Music Influences Jewellery Trends | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Looking for trendy melody-coded jewellery? This World Music Day, trace the influence of music on jewellery trends & explore refined gold jewellery designs with Mia by Tanishq!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Latest And Trending
Influence of Music on Jewellery Design Trends As music and fashion lie within the shared sector of art, the similarities adjoining the two together are impossible to miss. A big part of what it means to be fashionable is established by the way you ‘dress & accessorise to express’. From jewellery to other knick knacks: various items can be layered together to bring out the ultimate vibe of an outfit! The world of music and styling happens to be the expression of the Self & what satiates the soul. Musicians and fashionistas use their respective modes of art to share a piece of their ingenious mind with the world. While musicians strum the strings to create a perfect melody, fashionistas adorn themselves with fabric & jewellery which perfectly aligns with their creative vision. In celebration of the deep-rooted connection & romantic love affair between the two time-transcending modes of self-expression - Mia by Tanishq introduces a collection of exquisite music-inspired jewellery. Indulge in the aesthetic styling of an array of ornaments, ranging from pendants to rings, to express your taste for music and genuine love for nature's melodies! This blog highlights the influence of music on jewellery trends around the world. Find out avenues through which you can express your inner passions, shake off the inhibitions & tune into your true vibe!
Music & Jewellery Design: A Love Story for the Ages Indeed, it’s almost like one cannot exist without the other! Music and style go hand-in-hand in the sense that one serves as a mode of emotional enhancement, fueling the other. For example, rockstars would preferably express themselves through funky cuts & maximalist looks, topped off with chunky jewellery, studs and bold pieces to portray their fascination for the alternative. On the other hand, ballad singers would enjoy adorning themselves with delicately crafted, minimal ornaments to express their subtle preoccupations. Now look at the completely other end of the spectrum: the fashionista who loves layering jewellery to the brim, embodying trendy aesthetics swarming across social media platforms – has one dedicated playlist which hums the tunes of her inner, stylistic soul. For example, take a girl who enjoys the sophisticated, ‘Old Money’ aesthetic consisting of neutral apparel and lightweight, gold jewellery. Every time she has to take a long drive downtown, she switches to her go-to playlist consisting of musical artists like Lana Del Rey, Frank Sinatra & Amy Winehouse! There she goes, imagining herself in a music video not only featuring her classy style but also, her preferred melodies. The creative mind is set free when the two artistic elements of music and style come together. Here are some ways in which music and jewellery find their paths intertwined in passionate knots:
Emotional Expression Music can evoke strong emotions, and so can jewellery! One may listen to a particular song which takes them back to a time when they grinned their widest. On the other hand, a song heavy in sentiments can bring one to tears. Similarly, jewellery can be used as a method of emotional expression - representing the stage of life one is in, through styling. Especially, in the case of jewellery that has a story to tell, like representing a burning passion one cannot bury - styling becomes much more personal to the wearer.
Symbols Music and musical tastes find expression through musical motifs being incorporated into jewellery design. For example, one can opt for a gold chain featuring a musical note as a charm - to express their passion for creating the perfect sequence with notes!
Developing the ‘Self’ Music and style play a crucial role in helping one discover their personality and preferences. By having a unique taste for a specific type of music, or an aesthetic - one allows oneself to be seen for who they are. They are not what people make of them, they are their individual ‘Self’. This leads us to discuss jewellery and the influence of music on trends surrounding them!
Trace the Influence of Music on Ever-evolving Jewellery Trends With the connection between music and jewellery established and thoroughly felt, here's how music plays a role in modelling jewellery trends around the globe:
Musical Notes in Jewellery Designs A major trend encapsulating the essence of musical fascination is through its materialisation in the form of a ‘charm’. Mia by Tanishq offers 14KT, precious fine gold jewellery options featuring musical notes. So, you can express your passion for the melodies through fashion!
Hip-hop/Street-style Influence In hip-hop culture and through streetwear trends, gold has found its place as the ‘go-to’ metal of choice. Hip-hop artists usually opt for gold jewellery, including gold bracelets, chains and rings to accentuate their drip. With hip-hop being a part and parcel of pop culture, the associated style incorporating gold accents has also paved its way into the mainstream!
Cultural Representation through Music Videos Artists and musicians are starting to incorporate more of their culture through music videos, subtly featuring elements which connect to their roots. The best way to express cultural identity is through traditional get-ups including regional jewellery! This also allows fans around the world to appreciate different cultures and feel inspired to be more in touch with their origins - be it through notion or fashion. The next section dives into the myriad of jewellery options you get to explore with Mia by Tanishq, to arrange your personal melody sequence!
A Glimpse into Our Collection: Find Symphony & Style through Gold Jewellery Music-related charms are an iconic feature on traditional gold jewellery designs - to bring in a modern flair! So, here are some gold jewellery options from Mia by Tanishq to add to your collection for the music lover inside you:
Melodic Love Note 14KT Gold Drop Earrings
Opt for our ‘Melodic Love Note 14KT Gold Drop Earrings’, featuring a musical-note charm! This classic design is further made intricate and interesting to the eye of the beholder, with the intentional incorporation of the heart motif. While super trendy this Spring-Summer season, the ‘heart’ is representative of the genuine love and adoration you hold for music & its soothing powers. Plus, the drop earring design is a timeless one, perfectly fit for different types of closet essentials. Step up your everyday looks by creating unique, jaw-dropping ensembles!
Rhythmic Radiance 14KT Gold Finger Ring
Gold rings remain a basic essential when it comes to accessories. While holding great sentimental value, gold rings are also a style statement elevating any look they are paired with. By adding a gold ring to a silhouette, you portray your love for minute detailing. Be the Maestro of your outfits every day! Introduce harmony & rhythm to your monochrome or neutral looks by adding an element of ‘awe’ - the stunning, dainty Rhythmic Radiance 14KT Gold Finger Ring!
Symphonic Swing 14KT Gold Pendant
Are you looking for a signature pendant for everyday wear? For the music lover in you, we introduce our finest design of a 14KT gold pendant featuring a musical note enclosed within a heart. The ‘Symphonic Swing 14KT Gold Pendant’ represents how your favourite tunes always rule your heart. No matter which phase of life you are in, your passions and vigour associated with music remain safely within your soul. As the pendant is subtle in make yet intricate in detail – it expresses everything you want it to, in sophisticated fonts. Style the pendant with your daily workwear to elevate the fit to the ‘Corporate fashionista’ level!
Final Word Before You Press ‘Play’ on the Next Song on your Playlist It is clear how big of an impact music has had on jewellery trends through the decades. From the general vibes of a song & the visual arts finding an outlet through album covers to music videos setting the latest trends in fashion and accessories – music has had a significant impact on pop-styling tactics. Beyond the impact of music on jewellery trends, listeners shelter love for a specific genre of songs or a musical artist. This fascination drives them to invest in merchandise representing their passions rooted in melody. So, music inspires trendsetters and trendpartakers just the same. Through emotions of love, heartbreak, self-growth and more - music & fashion together have healed the ‘feeling’ soul. So, explore the latest gold ornament options extended by Mia by Tanishq - to find that missing symphony through meticulously crafted 14KT gold jewellery!

BEYON was born from desire—and the freedom to act on it.

Not as tradition dictates, but as desire compels.

We believe that jewellery should feel personal, intuitive, and alive. Not saved for someday. Not worn for approval. But something that just feels right. We’re creating jewellery not for your locker, but for you.

Working with laboratory-grown diamonds gives us a certain ease. It allows us to design jewellery you can actually wear and play with—layer, experiment, and still feel light.

Created with human ingenuity, designed for everyday desire and worn without rules—

BEYON is brilliance that lets you break free and indulge in jewellery that’s modern, accessible, and entirely your own.

BEYON RULES.
BEYON LIMITS.
BEYON IMAGINATION.

This belief shapes everything we do—from how our jewellery is imagined, to how our spaces feel when you walk in.

from the

Born from Titan’s long-standing belief in putting the consumer first, BEYON is built on the same foundations of trust, design excellence, and thoughtful innovation that have shaped some of India’s most loved lifestyle brands.

Titan brings decades of experience in building lifestyle brands and BEYON looks firmly ahead—reimagining jewellery for today, with freedom, confidence, and a distinctly modern point of view.​

At the heart of the brand lies the iconic Y

A symbol inspired by the universal gesture of arms raised—in joy, victory, and release. A shape found in moments when you feel the most yourself: open, alive, free.

A little clarity from

The way we design

We trust our instinct a lot.
That first pull. The heart saying yes.

We like letting our gold and laboratory-grown diamonds be free, easy, fluid, unrestrained. Everything is designed with intention, but never just one purpose. Stack it. Swap it. Wear it solo. Come back to it on a different day and wear it differently.

We like our gold bold and our laboratory-grown diamonds a little unexpected. Because playing it safe is not really our thing.​

We broke free from familiar shapes and let laboratory-grown diamonds try something new. Marquise, Baguettes and everything in between-each cut does something of its own.​

We urge you to wear as much or as little- as you like. The only limit here is how far you want to go. Stack the bracelets. Swap the rings. Layer the earrings.​

We imagine cuts the way we imagine outfits—based on mood, movement, and what feels current. We’re inspired by how style keeps shifting, and how we actually live in our jewellery.

BEYON pieces are designs you give in to.
The ones you don’t save for later.

You just wear them—again and again, without thinking twice. You just reach for them. And somehow, they always fit.

BEYON is made by people who care—sometimes a little too much.

About the tiny details. About how something feels.

We come from different backgrounds.
We bring different opinions.
We debate, pause, rethink, and circle back.
And yes, we disagree sometimes.
But when things get confusing, we ask one honest question:
Would we want this for ourselves?

			.heading-main {

			}
			
			.process-grid {
			  position: relative;
			  display: grid;
			  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
			  column-gap: 36px;
			}
			
			.process-grid::before {
			  content: "";
			  position: absolute;
			  top: 46px;
			  left: 5%;
			  right: 47px;

			  height: 2px;

			  display: flex;

			  align-items: flex-start;
			  min-width: 0;

			.process-step:nth-child(1)::after,
			.process-step:nth-child(2)::after,
			.process-step:nth-child(3)::after {
			  content: "";
			  position: absolute;
			  top: 41px;
			  right: 12%;
			  width: 12px;
			  height: 12px;
			  border-top: 1.5px solid #bf0d24;
			  border-right: 1.5px solid #bf0d24;
			  transform: rotate(45deg);
			  z-index: 1;

			  background: #efefef;

			  display: block;
			  width: 100%;
			  height: 100%;

			}

			}

<section>
	<p class="mob-text for-mob">If you’ve found yourself wondering what a laboratory-grown diamond is, we’re here to help you understand it in detail.</p>

	<p class="for-desk mid-text">
		<span>If you’ve found yourself wondering what a laboratory-grown diamond is, we’re here to help you understand it in detail.</span>
		<br />They look familiar, sparkle the same way, and behave just like natural diamonds — brilliant and hard. So why the fuss, you ask? Because they also open up a new kind of freedom.
		<br />The freedom to explore bigger ideas, experiment with unexpected shapes, and indulge your imagination without limits.</p>

<section class="sec4">

					<span class="first-t-second-t">It is the world's first lesson in patience, wonder, and possibility.</span>
				</p>

a) Passport with Visa Copy; b) Driving license; c) Employment card; d) Any other government issued ID proof of the the country of residence.

International Orders

Payments for International Orders are accepted through PayPal gateway either by your PayPal account or by using International credit/debit cards only. For orders being shipped outside India, the payment will be accepted only in US Dollars. Applicable currency conversion rates will apply according to the prevailing exchange rates on the day of placing the order.

Prices for international orders will include shipping and handling charges, taxes, etc., pertaining to the country of delivery.

For International Orders above value of INR 2 lakhs, you are required to send us the PAN Card or Form 60 as per applicable laws.

Cards issued in India or by Indian banks will not be accepted for international orders.

Any other import duties or charges levied in the destination country of the shipment has to be borne by the customer. These Duties or Taxes are to be paid extra as per actuals prevailing at the time of delivery and are subject to change.

All the above rates are subject to changes and to be borne by the customer as per actuals at the time of delivery.

For purchase above Rs. 2 lakhs, PAN card must be provided upon placing the order in the manner specified by Titan. Failure to provide the same shall result in cancellation of the order.

For all domestic shipments, if the order value exceeds Rs. 2 lakhs, the customer will need to enter the PAN and click on verify PAN card. Only upon PAN card verification the order will proceed to the payment page. The billing name is supposed to be the same as the PAN card else the PAN card will not get verified and the customer will not be able to proceed with the order.

In India, we serve to selected cities. Please check if we deliver to your PIN Code in shopping cart checkout page. If there is no courier service available in your area, we do apologize for the inconvenience caused.

We also provide international delivery to the following countries:

USA | UK | UAE | Australia | Singapore | Canada | New Zealand | Kenya | Spain | Malaysia | Germany | Romania | Portugal | Netherlands | Qatar | Kuwait | Oman

Domestic Orders

A tentative delivery date/time will be given along with the order confirmation email. The exact delivery date shall be provided as soon as your order is ready for dispatch. Alternatively, registered customers can track their order by clickingTrack Orderand find the order status.

Express Delivery option available for select PIN Codes for select cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai and Bengaluru) for select products. Under this option, the product will be delivered the next day subject to the condition that the order is placed by 2 PM. For Orders placed after 2 PM, the tentative delivery timelines will be T+2 days. If the delivery timeline falls on a public holiday or Sunday, the timeline for express delivery will be extended by another day.

For all other PIN Codes, delivery timeline will be of 5-7 days for domestic orders.

PLEASE NOTE:Customer needs to produce any of the following Government issued photo identity proof for receiving the delivery:

a.) Pan card

b.) Driving License

c.) Passport

d.) Voter identification card

International Orders

For International Orders, the tentative delivery timeline will be of T+15 days. PLEASE NOTE: Customer needs to produce PAN Card or Form 60 and passport or driving license for receiving the delivery for order value above INR 2 lakhs. For any customer assistance, you can write to customercare@titan.co.in or ecomsupport@titan.co.in

NOTE: At present, we do not have the option to deliver a single order to multiple destinations. You will need to place different orders for shipment to multiple destinations.

Domestic Order: We provide free shipping within India.

International Order:

In case of order which is to be shipped outside India, customer has to bear the shipping and handling charges plus any duty as applicable at the destination.

In case the order is not accepted by the customer and is returned to origin, freight charges and import duty will be levied to the customer.

Custom Clearance:

All shipments of Jewellery exported from India need to be cleared by the Indian Customs office. Products along with their complete documentation are filed with the authorized officer of the Indian Customs office for inspection, examination and assessment and only then delivered to your shipping address. Hence, please ignore the message on the package section which mentions: Please do not accept if the package is received in Open/ Tampered condition. You will find the package sealed with a label saying Opened for Customs.

Logistics Service Provider :

Our domestic logistic partner is Blue Dart, Sequel Logisticsy & Ecom Express. Our international logistic partner is UPS.

NOTE:

In case of International order, customer has to pay the shipping charges at the time of placing the order. Also, custom duty and taxes levied by destination country has to be borne by the customer and needs to be paid to the logistic partner at the time of delivery. Please note that all consignments are on Delivery Duty Unpaid (DDU) basis.

All registered customers have the option to track their orders by clicking on Track Order

7- days Return Policy for Domestic orders only

In the unlikely event that the order delivered is in damaged condition, or otherwise, you can return the product unused and in the same condition as you received it, in its original packaging, along with the invoice and get the refund. International Orders

Our logistics service provider will collect the order from provided address (within India). Customers need not pay any shipping charges to return the product.

How to Initiate the Refund Process?

1. Customers should contact Titan customer support on 1800-266-0123 or write to customercare@titan.co.in or ecomsupport@titan.co.in within 7 days from the receipt of product.

2. Customers should not return the product before receiving a confirmation mail from Titan about the delivery of the same.

3. All the products must be returned in their original condition, unaltered and unused in its original packaging.

4. Provide the invoice, Certificate of Authenticity into the package for return process. Without the above, returns will not be processed.

NOTE:

We shall not entertain any request after 7 days from the date of receipt of the product.

We shall process the refund once we receive the product. The product must be in unused condition, in its original packaging along with its original tags and invoice, failing which refund will not be processed.

Once the refund process has been initiated, the amount will be directly refunded to your account via the same mode through which the transaction was made or through cheque ( amount would be refunded through cheque, only in cases where the debit/credit card used by customer while placing the order is not in use).

In case of domestic order (where the product is shipped within India), where returns are accepted by Titan, 100% refund will be processed.

In case the customer pays through online mode then the amount will be refunded within 7-15 working days from the date of receipt of the returned product(s) at the warehouse of Titan.

In case of COD (Cash on delivery i.e. when received) the amount can be refunded either through cheque or online transfer as NEFT (National Electronic Fund Transfer). The mode of refund depends on the customer's choice:

1. If cancelled cheque with the returned product then the refund can be made within 7-15 working days & amount will be refunded directly into customer's account through online transfer as NEFT.

2. If customer doesn't provide any cancelled cheque then, amount will be refunded through cheque that will be sent by courier to the address provided by customer at time of registering/placing the order. It may take up to 30 working days. Further, Titan shall not be liable in case of any incorrect address provided.

i. Gold / plain platinum products will be valued at 100% prevailing metal rate at the respective stores on the day of exchange.

ii. Diamonds (on studded gold / platinum products) will be valued at 100% prevailing stone rate on the day of exchange.

iii. Solitaire (loose solitaire/ Studded gold or platinum solitaire jewellery) will be valued at 100% prevailing stone rate if customer buys studded gold / studded platinum product against the exchange

iv. Solitaire (loose solitaire/ Studded gold or platinum solitaire jewellery) will be valued at 90% prevailing stone rate if the customer buys plain gold / plain platinum product or coin against exchange.

v. No exchange for Solitaires of 2 carats and above

vi. Other Studded products will be valued at 80% of prevailing value of the product

viii. Making charges, taxes, and any discount given on the original invoice, will be deducted in full.
