content.display-name: Elevate Your Festive Look With Mia By Tanishq's Aurum Collection

page-attributes.page-title: Elevate Your Bold Look with Aurum Collection | Mia by Tanishq
page-attributes.page-description: Add a touch of trend to your look with Mia by Tanishq’s stunning Aurum Collection. Explore how the rich gold and modern jewellery can add the perfect finishing touch to your jewellery collection..

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Elevate Your Festive Look With Mia By Tanishq's Aurum Collection As the festive season has come, the allure of twinkling lights, vibrant hues, and the sound of laughter fill the air. It's that time of the year when dressing up is not just a desire but a joyous ritual. An essential aspect of this festive preparation is selecting the perfect jewellery. Mia by Tanishq, with its rich lineage and impeccable craftsmanship, brings forth a collection that encapsulates the essence of celebration: The Aurum Jewellery Collection.
The Allure Of 18kt Gold
Before diving deep into the collection, let's understand the charm of 18 Karat gold. Renowned for its splendid balance of purity and strength, 18kt gold boasts 75% pure gold, alloyed with other metals for durability. This balance makes it particularly favourable for crafting intricate designs, rendering it perfect for jewellery pieces that are both ornate and suitable for daily wear. Its lustrous yellow hue casts a glow, complementing the Indian skin tone beautifully and adding that touch of luxury to festive outfits.
 
Unveiling The Aurum Jewellery Collection By Mia By Tanishq
Since ancient times, gold has captivated cultures, often being associated with the radiant sun. Intriguingly, the very name of this precious element, "Aurum," stems from the Latin word 'aurora' - a homage to the Roman goddess of dawn. In the tales of Roman mythology, it was Aurōra who rejuvenated herself each morning, soaring across the expanse of the sky, heralding the sun's impending rise. Drawing inspiration from this ancient lore, Mia by Tanishq proudly presents the "Aurum Collection." Envision bold streaks of light piercing the darkness, heralding the dawn of a new day. This collection serves as a poignant reminder that despite the myriad challenges we encounter in life, there's always a promise of beauty and hope on the horizon. Every time you adorn a piece from the Aurum Jewellery Collection, it's as if you're embracing the spirit of a fresh beginning.
 
Embodying Strength And Elegance
More than just jewellery, each piece from the Aurum Jewellery Collection is a tangible symbol of inner fortitude, a testament to one's courage to confront the unknown. It empowers you to face life's adversities with unmatched confidence, all while radiating elegance and style.
 
Embodying Strength And Elegance
More than just jewellery, each piece from the Aurum Jewellery Collection is a tangible symbol of inner fortitude, a testament to one's courage to confront the unknown. It empowers you to face life's adversities with unmatched confidence, all while radiating elegance and style.
 
A Blend Of Classic And Contemporary
The Aurum Jewellery Collection is not merely about tales and inspirations; it's about style and substance. Marrying the grace of classic designs with the vivacity of contemporary aesthetics, the collection has something for every discerning individual. From understated earrings to statement necklaces and bangles, it caters to all who wish to infuse a hint of quiet luxury and sophistication into their ensemble. Starting your day with these pieces is akin to setting a luxurious tone, ensuring you transition seamlessly from the early morning sun to the evening's starlit embrace.
The versatility of the Aurum Jewellery Collection is truly its hallmark. Its comfort and ease of wear ensure that irrespective of the event on your calendar - be it a formal gala or a casual dinner date with friends - these jewellery pieces guarantee to leave a lasting impression. Each piece is not just an accessory; it's a testament to style, resilience, and the promise of new beginnings.
 
Spotlight On Our Star Pieces
The stars of the Aurum Jewellery Collection deserve special attention:
 
Charmful Hamsa Duo Bracelet
This 18-karat gold set of bracelets is an artful blend of designs that resonates with the rejuvenating spirit of Aurora from Roman mythology, heralding fresh beginnings and the cycle of rebirth. Meticulously crafted from radiant 18KT gold, each charm of the bracelet set carries a story, a significance that speaks to the soul. The ethereal Hamsa hand, celebrated for its protective aura, stands as a beacon against negative energies, embracing the wearer in its benevolent shield. Adding a touch of enigma to the design, the lock charm whispers tales of secrets held close, a symbol of assurance and confidentiality.
Blue Horizon Hoop Earrings
Elegance meets craftsmanship in the "Blue Horizon Hoop Earrings". Every curve and contour are thoughtfully designed, showcasing a soft domed exterior that gleams with a high polish. This impeccable finish ensures an effervescent sparkle that elevates any attire it graces. However, these earrings are more than just a beautiful accessory; they're a statement. The "Blue Horizon Hoop Earrings" serve as a tangible reflection of inner fortitude and resilience. They silently speak of the courage that propels one forward and the strength that stands resilient against life's tides. Each time they're worn, they become an affirmation of unyielding confidence, ensuring the wearer not only feels but also looks undeniably elegant.
Rays Of Renewal Swirl Finger Ring
Embodying the elegance of dawn, the "Rays of Renewal Swirl Finger Ring" is a masterpiece crafted with unparalleled precision and passion. Its mesmerising swirling design mirrors the bold streaks of light that paint the sky as day breaks, ushering in the promise of fresh beginnings and new hopes.
Drawing inspiration from Aurora, who heralds the Sun's grandeur, this ring is more than a piece of jewellery; it's a narrative. A tale of resilience, hope, and the certainty that even when faced with life's adversities, there remains a beauty awaiting us, just beyond the horizon.
Why Shop 18kt Gold Jewellery Online With Mia By Tanishq
The digital age has transformed our shopping habits. Buying 18kt gold jewellery online might seem daunting to some, but with Mia by Tanishq, it's an experience in itself. The brand ensures a seamless browsing experience, with every piece detailed meticulously, giving you an almost tangible feel.
When you choose Mia by Tanishq, you're not just selecting a piece of jewellery; you're investing in authenticity, quality, and trust. And for those who fancy exclusive pieces, the online platform occasionally introduces designs that aren't available in the physical stores, making your purchase even more special.
 
Styling Tips For The Festive Season With Aurum
The festive season is all about glitz, glamour, and making lasting impressions. The right jewellery not only complements your attire but also mirrors your personal style. Dive into the festive fervour with the exclusive Aurum Jewellery Collection. Here's how you can incorporate these timeless pieces to create head-turning looks:
 
Traditional Look
Embrace the charm of age-old traditions. Team up the Aurum necklace set with a deep-coloured silk saree, letting the necklace stand out and command attention. Avoid any layering neckpieces to keep the focus intact. Round off this ethereal look with the shimmering Aurum earrings. Consider an elegant bun or a braid adorned with jasmine flowers to elevate your traditional ensemble.
 
Traditional Look
Embrace the charm of age-old traditions. Team up the Aurum necklace set with a deep-coloured silk saree, letting the necklace stand out and command attention. Avoid any layering neckpieces to keep the focus intact. Round off this ethereal look with the shimmering Aurum earrings. Consider an elegant bun or a braid adorned with jasmine flowers to elevate your traditional ensemble.
 
Contemporary Chic
Modern festivities call for a blend of tradition and trend. Slide into a festive maxi dress or a draped saree gown, adding a touch of sparkle with the Aurum bracelet. Its minimal design is sure to turn heads. Pair the bracelet with understated Aurum studs to maintain an equilibrium, ensuring your look is chic yet not overwhelming. Opt for loose waves or a sleek ponytail to match this contemporary style.
 
Fusion Ensemble
Break the boundaries and redefine festive fashion. Pair a traditional voluminous skirt with a contemporary top or a sleek crop top. To complete this audacious look, let the Aurum earrings dangle gracefully, making a statement. With every turn of your head, they'll shimmer, reflecting light and drawing admiration. Consider pairing this ensemble with wedge heels or embroidered juttis for that perfect fusion touch.
 
Minimalist Elegance
For a more understated look, opt for a single statement Aurum ring. Wear it with a pastel-coloured Anarkali suit or a simple kurta-palazzo combo. Let the ring grab all the attention, and pair it with a sleek watch or a thin bracelet.
 
Celebrate With Mia By Tanishq
The festive season is about joy, celebration, and creating memories. Mia by Tanishq’s Aurum Jewellery Collection promises not just to be a part of these memories but to enhance them. It invites you to embrace tradition, with a touch of modernity. So, as you gear up for the festivities, let the Aurum Jewellery Collection be your jewel of choice, and shine on!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Mia by Tanishq “Bali With Mia” Valentine's Day 2024 Contest
 
How to participate? with the following steps!
 
1. Purchase Mia a product from the Mia/Tanishq store or Mia/Tanishq App or miabytanishq.com 
2. Follow @Miabytanishq on Instagram
3. The profile can be public or private handle
4. Click a selfie and DM it to @miabytanishq with one line expressing your love either towards your partner or Mia, using the hashtag #BaliWithMia
 
Terms and Conditions
 
This Mia by Tanishq “Kaho Kuch Special” Valentine's Day 2024 Contest ("Contest") is made available to you by Titan Company Limited (“Titan”). Please read these Terms and Conditions (“T&Cs”) before entering the Contest. You agree that, by participating in this Contest, you will be bound by these T&Cs and you represent that you satisfy all Contest eligibility requirements as provided herein below.
 
For the purposes of these T&Cs, wherever the context so requires "You" or "Your" shall mean any natural person who is a participant in the Contest.
 
1. ELIGIBILITY YOU NEED TO FULFILL THE FOLLOWING ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA TO ENTER THE CONTEST:
a) You should be an individual who has attained the age of 18 and should be a legal resident of the Republic of India.
b) You must have an active Instagram account at the time of participating in this Contest.
c) You must purchase a Mia by Tanishq product from any Mia By Tanishq or Tanishq store or from www. miabytanishq.com/Mia by Tanishq App or www.tanishq.co.in / Tanishq App or on Amazon or Flipkart or Tata Cliq. You must click a selfie and post it on your Instagram story tagging @miabytanishq, with one line expressing your love either towards your partner or brand Mia by Tanishq.
d) The reel/post must be your original creation, must not infringe any third party’s copyright or any other intellectual property rights, must respect community standards and follow Instagram's policies.
e) The content generated by you must not be copied or must not be someone else’s work and must not be edited, morphed or created using any AI or similar tools. 
 
This Contest is open to only those participants who meet the eligibility criteria as specified above. Further, considering the criteria involved in winning the Contest, it is advised that individuals belonging to geographical territories that expressly prohibit game of skill shall abstain from participation. Amidst the aforesaid, if any individual chooses to participate, he/she would do it at his/her own risk or peril and cannot claim ignorance of applicable law.
 
2. DETAILS OF THE CONTEST AND HOW TO ENTER:
a) This Contest will commence on 24th January 2024 and last until 29th February 2024 subject to any changes as per the discretion of Titan.
b) At the end of the Contest Period, amongst all participants who undertake the actions stated in ELIGIBILITY above in accordance with these T&Cs, 10 winners will be selected based on the evaluation done internally by Titan.
c) All the rights to declare and eliminate participants from the Contest remain with Titan.
d) Each Winner will be eligible to receive one prize only under this Contest as per the details specified hereinafter.
 
3. WINNER SELECTION CRITERIA:
All submitted entries will be reviewed for compliance with these T&Cs. Entries that violate the official rules, use offensive content, or fail to comply with eligibility criteria will be disqualified. Entries that meet the submission requirements and demonstrate creativity and alignment with the campaign theme will be evaluated further on various parameters including originality, creativity, visual appeal and aesthetics. Winners will be notified through direct messages on Instagram and thereafter Titan will announce the winners publicly.

content.display-name: Your Personal Guide To Buy The Best Finger Ring
content.description: Your Personal Guide To Buy The Best Finger Ring To Suit Your Personality

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Gifting
Your Personal Guide to Buying the Best Finger Ring to Suit Your Personality A finger ring is not just a piece of jewellery; it's a reflection of your personality and style. Whether you're buying a ring for yourself or as a gift, finding the perfect one can be a daunting task. With so many options available, it's essential to understand your own preferences and consider various factors to make an informed decision.
 
Beauty TIp
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
Buying the Perfect Ring for Yourself
Shop Now
 
Define Your Style The first step in finding the ideal finger ring is to define your personal style. Are you someone who gravitates towards timeless elegance, or do you prefer bold and modern designs? Take some time to explore different fashion trends and jewellery styles to get a sense of what appeals to you. Consider factors such as your wardrobe, the occasions you'll be wearing the ring for, and your overall aesthetic. Having a clear understanding of your style will help you narrow down your options and make the shopping experience more enjoyable.
Shop Now
 
Choose the Right Metal Once you've defined your style, it's time to choose the metal for your finger ring. The metal sets the tone for the entire piece and can greatly impact its overall appearance. Some popular choices include gold (yellow, white, or rose), silver, platinum, and titanium. Gold is a classic option that exudes luxury and warmth, while silver offers a sleek and contemporary look. Platinum is known for its durability and rarity, making it a favourite among those seeking a sophisticated piece. Consider your personal preferences, skin tone, and budget when selecting the metal for your ring. Once you know your preference, you can check out your preferred metal for discounts under various jewellery sales.
Shop Now
 
Explore Gemstones Gemstones add a touch of colour and personality to ladies' finger rings. If you prefer a ring with gemstones, consider the meaning and symbolism associated with different stones. For example, diamonds symbolise eternal love and are a popular choice for engagement rings. Rubies represent passion and vitality, while sapphires are associated with wisdom and loyalty. Explore various gemstone options and choose one that resonates with your personality and desired message. Additionally, consider the cut, clarity, and colour of the gemstone, as these factors greatly influence its visual appeal.
 
Find the Right Fit One crucial aspect of buying a finger ring is finding the right fit. An ill-fitting ring can be uncomfortable and may even slip off your finger. To determine your ring size, visit a local jeweller who can measure your finger accurately. If you're purchasing online, many websites offer ladies finger ring sizing guides and tips.
 
Pick a Budget Whether it is your first big purchase or just another ‘just because’ gift to yourself, it is important that you decide on a budget before you go out to buy a ring. Our advice is that you stick to a budget and keep an eye out for jewellery sales and discounts. Buying ladies finger rings during jewellery sales also ensures maximum savings which means you won’t risk going over budget. Buying a finger ring is a personal journey that allows you to express your style and individuality. By defining your style, choosing the right metal, exploring gemstone options, and finding the perfect fit, you can ensure that the ring you choose is a true reflection of your personality. Remember, there are no strict rules when it comes to selecting a ladies’ finger ring. Trust your instincts, take your time, look out for jewellery sales and enjoy the process. With this guide as your companion, you'll be well-equipped to find the best finger ring that suits your unique personality and brings joy for years to come.

content.description: Choosing the Perfect Earrings for Your Face Shape - A Style Guide

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Choosing the Perfect Earrings for Your Face Shape: A Stylish Guide

Every individual has a unique face shape that makes them stand out. While this uniqueness is a beauty in itself, matching it with the right accessories can enhance its charm even further. Among these accessories, earrings play a pivotal role in adding the right touch of elegance. But how do you find the right earrings for face shape? Let’s dive deep into this stylish guide and discover the art behind this.

The Importance of Choosing Right Earrings for Face Shape

Have you ever wondered why certain earrings make your friend’s face light up but seem out of place on you? The secret lies in understanding the importance of face shape.

Your face isn’t just the forefront of your expressions and emotions, it’s a canvas that responds differently to various styles of earrings. Picture this: A dress, tailored to perfection, highlighting every curve and angle of your body, making you feel like the best version of yourself. Now, replace that dress with earrings. The magic of finding the right earrings for face shape is no less than hunting down that dream dress for your figure. The apt earrings don’t just accessorise; they blend seamlessly, amplifying the innate allure of your facial contours.

Earrings for Different Face Shapes

Round Face

For those with circular facial features where the width and length are nearly the same, it's essential to add some length and divert attention from the fullness. Dangling earrings or elongated styles work wonders for this shape. Avoid round earrings or hoops, as they might accentuate the roundness. Opting for geometric-patterned earrings for round face can be your fashion secret to looking chic every time!

Oval Face

Blessed with balanced proportions, the oval face shape is versatile and can pull off almost any earring style. However, to enhance this shape further, go for oval-shaped dangling earrings. They not only resonate with the face's symmetry but also add a touch of grace. When searching for the best earrings for oval face, consider teardrop designs; they mimic the face's natural shape and amplify its beauty.

Long Face

If your face is longer than it is wide, the aim is to create an illusion of width. Shorter earrings, especially studs or small hoops, can add a broader aspect to your face. You can also look for round earrings to bring attention to the width of your face. Remember, when you’re seeking earrings for long face, the key is to balance out the length with width.

Square Face

Those with a square face have prominent jawlines and a forehead that's roughly the same width. Softening the angles is the goal. Go for earrings that are medium to long in length but have rounded designs. Oval shapes or circular earrings can help in offsetting the sharp angles of a square face.

Heart-Shaped Face

If your forehead is the widest part of your face, tapering down to a pointed chin, you have a heart-shaped face. Balance out this shape by choosing earrings that are wider at the bottom, like teardrop or chandelier designs.

Find Your Perfect Fit!

Your face is our inspiration, and to us, earrings are the artistry that accentuates its beauty. It's not about seeking the most lavish or the grandest earrings, but about identifying the pieces that celebrate your unique charm. As you think about adorning yourself next, keep in mind this wisdom about selecting earrings for face shape that truly complements you.

Have you had a chance to delve into Mia by Tanishq's curated collection? Each earring, with its exquisite craftsmanship, is a testament to contemporary elegance. Our designs are not just accessories; they are a narrative, ensuring there's a tale for every individual, embracing all face shapes. Dive into Mia by Tanishq's world and let your earrings be more than ornaments; let them be a reflection of you. Here's to finding your perfect match!

Buying Gold FAQs

What is Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold?
Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold is a safe and transparent platform for buying/selling/exchanging “SafeGold” offered by Digital Gold India Private Limited (“DGIPL”) in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations. Mia Digital Gold is neither financial product nor a deposit but a method of purchasing gold for your personal needs. Each time you purchase SafeGold from the Platform, Gold will be purchased on your behalf on the basis of clear funds being made available by you for the transaction. Gold in grams up to 4 decimal places shall be credited to your account.
What is SafeGold?
SafeGold is a product of DGIPL- an institutionally owned company, where the World Gold Council is a minority investor (through World Gold Council (India) Private Limited).
Who can buy Mia Digi Gold?
All Indian citizens with a valid PAN Card can buy Mia Digital Gold. Please note NRIs can neither purchase, sell or redeem Mia Digital Gold.
What is the Purity of SafeGold offered through Mia Digital Gold?
Mia Digital Gold offers SafeGold which is 24 Karat Gold of 995 fineness (99.5% pure) or higher purity which are LBMA “good delivery” bars sourced by DGIPL from trusted sources.
What is the minimum and maximum amount I can purchase through Mia Digital Gold?
The minimum amount of purchase is Rs. 100. There is no maximum amount, subject to the completion of KYC verification for your account.
Is there a minimum lock in period?
There is no minimum lock in period- you can make a one-time purchase of SafeGold, without being obligated to make any fixed or periodic payments. You can choose to sell any amount of gold at the live sell price starting with minimum of Re. 100/- to maximum of the amount of gold that you own.
Where can I sign up to purchase this?
You can register through Mia's online platform (http://www.tanishq.co.in/digigold/home). You will be required to provide your name, mobile number, email address, pin code and PAN to get started. At stores, you can only redeem the SafeGold Balance that is available in your account, but buy and sell is possible only through the Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold platform.
Can I pay through Post Dated Cheques?
No, this is an entirely digital product, and hence Post-Dated Cheques (PDCs) are not available as a payment method for this product.
Can I cancel my purchase order to buy SafeGold ?
No, you cannot cancel the purchase order of gold once it has been successfully placed on the platform.
Where can I find the invoice for each order?
If your email address has been provided, an invoice shall be emailed to you as an attachment after each successful transaction. It is also available on the platform, by clicking on the invoice button.
How can I get my holding statement?
An online statement will be available at all times on the platform.
Can I open a joint account?
No, you cannot open a joint account for Mia Digital Gold powered SafeGold.
Is the gold associated with my accumulations kept in safe custody?
The gold purchased on your behalf is stored with Brink's, the leading safe keeper of precious metals across the world. The gold is insured, for both storage and transit when being delivered to you. Further, the Security Trustee has a charge on all gold stored in the vault in your favour. This ensures that your gold is protected at all times regardless of any external events.
What is the role of the “Security Trustee”?
To provide you SafeGold through the Mia Digital Gold Platform, DGIPL has entered into a relationship with IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited to act as a Security Trustee for all digital gold customers. The Security Trustee is entitled to act on your behalf and ensure that your interests are protected. The Security Trustee will have a charge on the gold associated with accumulations held by you.
What will happen to the gold associated with accumulations in my account, in the unlikely event of the SafeGold going into liquidation?
The gold associated with the accumulations in your account is separate from the other assets of the SafeGold. IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited, an independent trustee, acts for and on your behalf. The gold purchased by DGIPL associated with the accumulations in your accounts is held with the Custodian. When you ask for delivery, the requisite quantity of gold will be removed from the Custodian and delivered to you through a reputed courier service. Since the Security Trustee has a charge over the gold, any unlikely adverse event happening to DGIPL will not affect the gold associated with the accumulations in your account. Further, the title of the gold clearly rests with you and the physical gold stored with the Custodian on account of SafeGold customers is not an asset of SafeGold in any way.
Who will insure the physical vault?
The secure storage provider (Brink's) has a comprehensive, global insurance policy that includes the insurance cover on your gold stored in their vaults. In addition, DGIPL has an additional insurance policy to cover gold in transit.
What is the maximum period of time for which my gold can be stored with DGIPL?
You can store your gold with DGIPL for a period of 10 years from the date of purchase. The custody shall be without charge for the first 5 years, and thereafter, will continue to be stored by DGIPL for a nominal fee to cover storage costs. You will be intimated in advance of being charged the fee, and will have the option to sell or request delivery of your gold at all times.
What will happen to my gold if my account is not operational on the platform?
We will always endeavour to provide you with immediate access to your gold. If, however, your account has been suspended for any reason, we would request you to get in touch with DGIPL’s customer service centre, in order to reactivate your account and access your gold once again. Customers may get in touch with Mia's customer service centre as a secondary recourse.
Why is there a difference between SafeGold Rate and Mia Ecom rate?
The Gold Rate in SafeGold is the price of Raw Gold that is being traded in the commodity markets which is influenced by various macroeconomic factors including global commodity pricing and Rupee valuation against USD. This Gold rate is not the selling gold rate of a finished product. There are operational costs involved even after raw gold is purchased from the market to convert the gold for amenability to make jewellery and these processing costs are why the Gold Rate of all jewelers (not just Mia) differs from the commodity rates.

content.description: digiGoldExchangeFAQ

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Redeem FAQs

What is the process for converting my SafeGold balance to jewellery?
You can redeem your SafeGold balance at the SafeGold sell rate for jewellery online or offline, exclusively at Mia or CaratLane retail stores or by visiting the appropriate websites, by following the process below: Retail Store: 1. You may use the SafeGold balance which is converted to value based on the prevailing SafeGold Sell rate (“Redemption Value”) towards payment for the jewellery product selected. You may please note that the value of the jewellery to be purchased will be calculated based on the gold rate prevailing at the Mia/CaratLane store and making charges and any other charges will be extra (“Purchase Value”). You may have to pay any differential amount to Mia, if the Purchase Value is higher than the Redemption Value. 2. Share your registered mobile number as requested, along with the SafeGold Balance you wish to exchange. 3. You will receive an OTP to confirm the transaction. 4. On verification of the OTP, your SafeGold balance shall be transferred to Mia and adjusted against the price of the product calculated based on the prevailing rates at the Mia/CaratLane stores. 5. Any discounts or store offers, as may be applicable, will be extended to you. Online Channel 1. You may use the SafeGold balance which is converted to value based on the prevailing SafeGold Sell rate (“Redemption Value”) towards payment for the jewellery product selected. You may please note that the value of the jewellery to be purchased will be calculated based on the gold rate prevailing at the Mia/CaratLane website and making charges and any other charges will be extra (“Purchase Value”). You may have to pay any differential amount to Mia, if the Purchase Value is higher than the Redemption Value. 2. Add the product to the cart and place the order 3. Enter the shipping details on the shipment page 4. On the payment page click on the Digital Gold tab 5. You can view the Mia Digital Gold balance or other SafeGold balance you are currently holding. Ensure you are using the same mobile number with which you have registered with DGIPL. The amount is calculated as per the SafeGold Sell rate for the grammage you are holding 6. Enter the amount that you wish to redeem. Minimum of Rs. 100. 7. You will receive an OTP on the registered mobile number, enter the OTP. 8. On verification of the OTP, your digital gold balance shall be transferred to Mia and adjusted against the price of the product calculated based on the prevailing rates on the Mia/Caratlane website . Your digital gold balance and will reduce accordingly. 9. Any discounts or platform offers, as may be applicable, will be extended to you. Note: Users can only redeem their Mia digital gold after 3 working days of purchase.
Can I convert my SafeGold balance at any Mia store?
Yes, you can redeem your SafeGold Balance for jewellery at any Mia or CaratLane retail store or even through the Mia/CaratLane online platforms. Note: Users can only redeem their Mia digital gold after 3 working days of purchase.
Can I exchange my SafeGold balance at any other jewellery chain?
If you have purchased from Mia Digital Gold powered by SafeGold, you can only exchange it for jewellery at Mia or CaratLane stores or online platforms.
Can I exchange the SafeGold I have purchased on other platforms at Mia stores as well?
If you have purchased SafeGold on any other platform, you can exchange it for jewellery at Mia/CaratLane stores through the same process as above.
Can I request for physical delivery of my SafeGold?
You can request physical delivery of gold by visiting www.safegold.com and on as many occasions as you want. You will be required to log in using your registered mobile number, and transferring the gold balance you wish to have delivered, to your SafeGold wallet. Since it is not physically possible to deliver a fractional quantity of gold, the minimum quantity for which the delivery can be made has been kept as low as 0.5 gram and in multiples of 0.5 gram. You can select the quantity and denomination of the gold you wish to withdraw from the available options of coins. Each coin will have different making charges, based on the weight and design of the coin. You must confirm the transaction by paying the additional making and delivery charge. The coins will be delivered at your notified address by a logistics provider arranged by DGIPL, and you will receive a confirmation on your registered mobile number. The delivery can be tracked at any time by logging into the platform. In case of delivery of coin/ bar, the shipment will be mandatorily delivered to your registered address as provided by you and confirmed at the time of delivery request. DGIPL maintains a list of serviceable pin codes, and prior to making any purchase. You will be informed whether their pin code is serviceable by DGIPL. Note: Users can only redeem their Mia digital gold after 3 working days of purchase.
Can I change/cancel my delivery order?
Once you place a delivery request, you must accept the delivery made to you. It cannot be changed, cancelled or delivered at a later point in time. Please visit www.safegold.com for further details on the delivery of gold process.
Are there any charges for delivery of gold?
Yes, you will be required to pay the minting/ making charges, delivery charges and applicable taxes. All coins are independently assayed to certify purity and delivered in tamper proof packaging. Charges may be viewed on www.safegold.com.
What happens to my gold if I deactivate or close my account with SafeGold balance present?
At the time of deactivation, you will be offered the option to withdraw your SafeGold balance or request for delivery of your gold.

What is Digital GOLD?

Mia Digital Gold is a trusted and transparent method of purchasing 24 Karat pure gold to help you start your golden savings journey with the trust of Tata and powered by SafeGold. You can start with as low as INR 100. You can also exchange your Digital Gold at any point on Tanishq.co.in or across 350+ Mia stores pan-India. We’re here to make buying gold absolutely seamless for you.

Safety Safety Guaranteed

Safely Convert to Physical Gold in our store or website

Safely Buy as low as ₹100

Safely Sell anytime from Home

Selling Gold FAQs

 How do I sell my gold?
Mia Digital Gold Platform provides a live sell price quote. You can choose to sell any amount starting with a minimum of Re 100 to a maximum of the amount of SafeGold that you own. The sell quote may be temporarily unavailable in the unlikely event of a disruption in the bullion market. To sell your gold, you can enter the amount in rupees or gold in grams. You will be required to fill in the bank details, which will be verified. Upon verification and the sell transaction being successful, the sale proceeds will be credited to your verified bank account by DGIPL within 5-7 working days.
Where do I get the proceeds when I sell my gold?
When you sell your gold, you’ll receive funds against it in a verified bank account in your own name. You can add your account details prior to the sale, which will be verified by DGIPL. Once the verification is complete, you’ll receive the proceeds post the sale of your gold, within 5-7 working days. If the sell transaction has been made on Friday/Saturday or Sunday, then you will receive your sales proceeds by Tuesday of the following week.
What happens if the sales proceeds are not credited to me within 7 working days?
If the sales proceeds have not been received within 7 working days of the transaction, please email our customer service team at miadigitalgold@titan.co.in with your related transaction details, and we shall resolve your issue.
I’m facing issues with bank account verification, what should I do?
In case you are facing any issues with uploading your proof of Bank account documents or completing the verification, please reach out to our support team with a screenshot of the issue on miadigitalgold@titan.co.in
Why is the SafeGold Sell Price different from the SafeGold Buy Price?
DGIPL offers international grade bullion from institutional suppliers and sells this to consumers. When customers sell the gold back, the gold is sold back to institutional participants in the wholesale bullion market, where the buyback rate is lower than the selling rate – this is referred to as the buy-sell spread. In addition to the buy-sell spread in the commercial bullion market, GST is added to the buy price, but it is not levied on any sell transactions. Further, there are charges incurred on the payment gateway, trustee, insurance and custodian fees which also contribute to the difference in buy and sell price.
Can I cancel my sell order/request of gold sell?
No, you cannot cancel the order once it has been successfully placed on the platform.
What happens to the SafeGold Balance in the event of a Customer’s death?
In the event of your death, as per the process specifically allowed by DGIPL , and subject to the required due diligence, the title to your gold lying in the vault and your account shall transfer to your legal heir, subject to legal heirs providing valid documents to the satisfaction of DGIPL to prove their heirship.
Once I buy Tanishq digital gold how soon can I sell?
Users can sell their Tanishq digital gold after 3 working days of making the purchase.

You will be required to fill in the bank details, which will be verified. Upon verification and the sell transaction being successful, the sale proceeds will be credited to your verified bank account by DGIPL within 2-3 working days.</p>", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" }, { "itemtTitle": "Where do I get the proceeds when I sell my gold?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "When you sell your gold, you’ll receive funds against it in a verified bank account in your own name. You can add your account details prior to the sale, which will be verified by DGIPL. Once the verification is complete, you’ll receive the proceeds post the sale of your gold, within 2-3 working days. If the sell transaction has been made on Friday/Saturday or Sunday, then you will receive your sales proceeds by Tuesday of the following week.", "itemDescriptionColor": "" } ] }, { "itemIndex": "1.4", "itemTitle": "Customer Support", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemNeedsToDisplay": "true", "subItems": [{ "itemtTitle": "I have some queries regarding my gold account, how can I get in touch?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "Please raise a ticket or get in touch with Tanishq’s customer service centre, through tanishqdigitalgold@titan.co.in. Tanishq is available to provide the first level of support and SafeGold shall be available to address any questions/issues that may be escalated.", "itemDescriptionColor": "" }, { "itemtTitle": "Is there any regulator or Grievance redressal mechanism?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "SafeGold is neither a Collective Investment Scheme nor a Deposit. Thus, does not fall under the purview of SEBI or RBI, and there is no regulator for this product offering. To ensure that your interest is of foremost importance, a Security Trustee has been appointed for SafeGold. For any grievances specifically in relation to your gold purchase and related transactions, you can approach the Security Trustee.", "itemDescriptionColor": "" } ] } ] }

You may use the SafeGold balance which is converted to value based on the prevailing SafeGold Sell rate (“Redemption Value”) towards payment for the jewellery product selected. You will be required to log in using your registered mobile number, and transferring the gold balance you wish to have delivered, to your SafeGold wallet. Since it is not physically possible to deliver a fractional quantity of gold, the minimum quantity for which the delivery can be made has been kept as low as 0.5 gram and in multiples of 0.5 gram. You can select the quantity and denomination of the gold you wish to withdraw from the available options of coins. Each coin will have different making charges, based on the weight and design of the coin. You must confirm the transaction by paying the additional making and delivery charge. The coins will be delivered at your notified address by a logistics provider arranged by DGIPL, and you will receive a confirmation on your registered mobile number. The delivery can be tracked at any time by logging into the platform. In case of delivery of coin/ bar, the shipment will be mandatorily delivered to your registered address as provided by you and confirmed at the time of delivery request. DGIPL maintains a list of serviceable pin codes, and prior to making any purchase. You will be informed whether their pin code is serviceable by DGIPL.", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" }, { "itemtTitle": "Can I change/cancel my delivery order?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "<p>Once you place a delivery request, you must accept the delivery made to you. It cannot be changed, cancelled or delivered at a later point in time.</br>Please visit www.safegold.com for further details on the delivery of gold process.</p>", "itemDescriptionColor": "" }, { "itemtTitle": "Are there any charges for delivery of gold?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "Yes, you will be required to pay the minting/ making charges, delivery charges and applicable taxes. All coins are independently assayed to certify purity and delivered in tamper proof packaging. Charges may be viewed on www.safegold.com.", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" }, { "itemtTitle": "What happens to my gold if I deactivate or close my account with SafeGold balance present?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "At the time of deactivation, you will be offered the option to withdraw your SafeGold balance or request for delivery of your gold.", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" } ] }, { "itemIndex": "1.3", "itemTitle": "Sell Gold", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemNeedsToDisplay": "true", "subItems": [{ "itemtTitle": "How do I sell my gold?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "

You can redeem your SafeGold balance at the SafeGold sell rate for jewellery online or offline, exclusively at Tanishq or CaratLane retail stores or by visiting the appropriate websites, by following the process below:

Retail Store:

1. You may use the SafeGold balance which is converted to value based on the prevailing SafeGold Sell rate (Redemption Value) towards payment for the jewellery product selected. You may please note that the value of the jewellery to be purchased will be calculated based on the gold rate prevailing at the Tanishq/CaratLane store and making charges and any other charges will be extra (Purchase Value). You may have to pay any differential amount to Tanishq, if the Purchase Value is higher than the Redemption Value.

", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" }, { "itemtTitle": "Where do I get the proceeds when I sell my gold?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "When you sell your gold, you’ll receive funds against it in a verified bank account in your own name. You can add your account details prior to the sale, which will be verified by DGIPL. Once the verification is complete, you’ll receive the proceeds post the sale of your gold, within 2-3 working days. If the sell transaction has been made on Friday/Saturday or Sunday, then you will receive your sales proceeds by Tuesday of the following week.", "itemDescriptionColor": "" }, { "itemtTitle": "What happens if the sales proceeds are not credited to me within 4 working days?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "If the sales proceeds have not been received within 4 working days of the transaction, please email our customer service team at tanishqdigitalgold@titan.co.in with your related transaction details, and we shall resolve your issue.", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" }, { "itemtTitle": "I’m facing issues with bank account verification, what should I do?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "In case you are facing any issues with uploading your proof of Bank account documents or completing the verification, please reach out to our support team with a screenshot of the issue on tanishqdigitalgold@titan.co.in", "itemDescriptionColor": "" }, { "itemtTitle": "Why is the SafeGold Sell Price different from the SafeGold Buy Price?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "<p>DGIPL offers international grade bullion from institutional suppliers and sells this to consumers. When customers sell the gold back, the gold is sold back to institutional participants in the wholesale bullion market, where the buyback rate is lower than the selling rate – this is referred to as the buy-sell spread.</br>In addition to the buy-sell spread in the commercial bullion market, GST is added to the buy price, but it is not levied on any sell transactions. Further, there are charges incurred on the payment gateway, trustee, insurance and custodian fees which also contribute to the difference in buy and sell price.</p>", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" }, { "itemtTitle": "Can I cancel my sell order/request of gold sell?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "No, you cannot cancel the order once it has been successfully placed on the platform.", "itemDescriptionColor": "" }, { "itemtTitle": "What happens to the SafeGold Balance in the event of a Customer’s death?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "In the event of your death, as per the process specifically allowed by DGIPL , and subject to the required due diligence, the title to your gold lying in the vault and your account shall transfer to your legal heir, subject to legal heirs providing valid documents to the satisfaction of DGIPL to prove their heirship.", "itemDescriptionColor": "#000000" } ] }, { "itemIndex": "1.4", "itemTitle": "Customer Support", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemNeedsToDisplay": "true", "subItems": [{ "itemtTitle": "I have some queries regarding my gold account, how can I get in touch?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "Please raise a ticket or get in touch with Tanishq’s customer service centre, through tanishqdigitalgold@titan.co.in. Tanishq is available to provide the first level of support and SafeGold shall be available to address any questions/issues that may be escalated.", "itemDescriptionColor": "" }, { "itemtTitle": "Is there any regulator or Grievance redressal mechanism?", "itemTitleColor": "#000000", "itemThumbnail": "", "itemContentLink": "", "itemContentType": "", "itemDescription": "SafeGold is neither a Collective Investment Scheme nor a Deposit. Thus, does not fall under the purview of SEBI or RBI, and there is no regulator for this product offering. To ensure that your interest is of foremost importance, a Security Trustee has been appointed for SafeGold. For any grievances specifically in relation to your gold purchase and related transactions, you can approach the Security Trustee.", "itemDescriptionColor": "" } ] } ] }

The Symbolism and Beliefs

This ancient belief revolves around the notion that malevolent glares and envious looks can bring harm or misfortune to an individual. 3. Meaningful Gifting

Do you know what the most underrated evil eye bracelet benefits can be? - Overlooking it as a gifting option. These bracelets make thoughtful gifts, carrying the message of protection and well-wishing. You can gift this bracelet to your family, friends or loved ones.

content.description: Online Shopping Made Easy: How To Find Out Your Ring Size

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Gifting
Online Shopping Made Easy: How To Find Out Your Ring Size Online shopping for jewellery has transformed the way we explore and purchase ornate pieces, offering unmatched convenience right from our homes. A standout benefit of this digital shift is the simplicity with which one can determine their ring size. Many online jewellery retailers now offer detailed guides and tutorials addressing the query, "how do you find out your ring size." These resources typically illustrate straightforward methods, such as using household items like a string or leveraging a printable ring sizing chart, ensuring accurate measurements of one's finger circumference. This eliminates the need to visit a physical store to determine your ring size, streamlining the entire purchasing process. Additionally, online retailers frequently offer size conversion charts to help customers easily understand and choose the right fit for their desired jewellery piece. Let us have a look at the DIY methods to determine ring size and translate measurements into ring sizes.
Beauty TIp
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
Why Ring Size Matters?
Knowing your ring size is essential for several reasons:
 
Comfort And Wearability A ring that fits properly is comfortable to wear. Too tight, and it might constrict the finger, potentially causing circulation issues or discomfort. Too loose, and there's a risk of it slipping off and getting lost.
Ensures Safety Rings that are too loose can easily slide off without the wearer noticing, leading to potential loss or damage. Conversely, a ring that's too tight can become stuck, which might necessitate professional removal.
Symbolic Importance Rings often symbolise special occasions or commitments, such as engagements, marriages, or personal milestones. A ring that fits perfectly enhances the joy and significance of the moment.
Preservation Of Design Some rings, especially those with intricate designs or stones set all the way around, can't be resized without altering or damaging the original design.
Avoiding Wear And Tear A properly sized ring minimises unnecessary wear and tear. A loose ring can get knocked around more, while a tight one experiences stress.
Enhances The Wearing Experience When you wear a ring that fits perfectly, you're more likely to enjoy the experience without having to constantly adjust it or worry about its fit.
DIY Methods To Determine Ring Size If you want to learn how to measure ring size at home or find out your ring size without visiting a jeweller, there are several DIY methods you can try. Here are some methods that may help you determine your ring size:
1. Use A Printable Ring Sizing Chart:
  • Search online for a printable ring sizing chart. Many jewellers and online jewellery stores offer these charts for free.
  • Ensure that the printed chart is to scale by checking the provided measurement or scale indicator on the chart.
  • Place one of your existing rings on the chart until you find the circle that matches the inside diameter of your ring. This should give you an accurate size measurement.
2. Measure Your Finger With A String:
  • To answer your question ‘how do you find out your ring size’, you can use a piece of string or a thin strip of paper.
  • Wrap it around the base of the finger where you plan to wear the ring, making sure it's a bit loose, not too tight.
  • Mark the point where the string or paper overlaps and measure its length in millimeters.
  • Once you have the measurement, use an online ring size chart to find your ring size based on the length you measured.
Translating Measurements Into Ring Sizes Translating measurements into ring sizes can be done with relative ease. If you're wondering how do you find out your ring size or how to know your ring size, below mentioned are some points you can adhere to while measuring your ring size:
1. Measure an Existing Ring: If you already have a ring that fits comfortably on the finger you want to wear your new ring on, you can measure its inner diameter using a ruler or a digital calliper. Match the measurement to the sizing chart to determine your ring size.

2. Finger Circumference Measurement: If you don't have an existing ring, you can measure the circumference of the finger you intend to wear the ring on. Use a flexible measuring tape to wrap around the base of the finger. Mark where the tape overlaps and then measure the length in millimetres. Match this measurement to the ring sizing chart.

3. Consider Ring Width: Keep in mind that wider rings feel tighter than thinner ones, so go up a half or full size for wider bands.

Expert Guidance For Ring Shopping Determining the right ring size is a pivotal step in purchasing a piece that not only represents a significant sentiment but also fits seamlessly. At this point, you should have a clear understanding of how to find out your ring size, a question many grapple with, especially when purchasing online. The evolution of e-commerce has made the process remarkably straightforward. With innovative sizing tools and comprehensive guides available, one can now shop from the comfort of their home with confidence. Our website offers a user-friendly interface, ensuring that the process of finding your ideal ring size becomes an engaging and enlightening experience rather than a daunting task. Our team of experts is available to assist and guide you, ensuring that every concern or question is addressed. We believe that every individual has a unique style and story, and our collection resonates with this belief. Each ring in our assortment is crafted with precision, symbolising an amalgamation of timeless elegance and modern charm. Mia By Tanishq stands not just as a brand but as a testament to quality, design, and trust. When you embark on your journey with us, you aren't just purchasing a piece of jewellery; you're investing in a legacy. Dive into our curated collection, and let each piece echo your individuality, grace, and spirit. With Mia By Tanishq, every ring tells a story – let yours narrate a tale of elegance, style, and timeless beauty. Shop now and let your hands shimmer with the allure of perfection.

Gifting
Looking To Invest In Gold Coins? Remember These Points For centuries, gold coins have remained a sought-after investment option. Their enduring appeal lies not only in their tangible nature but also in their ability to retain value amidst market volatility. In today's unpredictable economic climate, investing in gold coins can serve as a prudent strategy to diversify your portfolio and safeguard your wealth.
 
Beauty TIp
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
Investing in Gold Coins
Gold, with its rich history and universal allure, has stood the test of time as a reliable store of value. Unlike intangible assets, gold coins offer a physical presence that can be held in your hand, providing a sense of security and tangibility in your investment endeavours.
One of the key advantages of investing in gold coinsis their ability to withstand market fluctuations. While other investment options may be subject to the ups and downs of the financial world, gold has consistently maintained its intrinsic worth. This stability makes gold coins an attractive choice for investors looking to protect their wealth during uncertain economic times. However, if you want to buy gold coins online, there are a few things you must consider.
 
Gold Purity Gold is a naturally soft metal that needs to be combined with other alloys or metals like zinc, copper, or silver to enhance its strength and durability. The purity of gold indicates the level of adulteration or mixing that has occurred to make the gold suitable for specific forms and applications. Gold purity is commonly measured in Karat. For instance, a 24 Karat gold coin means it is composed of 24 parts gold out of 24, representing the purest form. Similarly, 22 Karat gold consists of 22 parts gold and 2 parts other alloys. When you buy gold coins, it is crucial to verify the purity to ensure you receive the correct value for your money.
Shop Now
 
Hallmark Always check for the gold hallmark when buying a gold coin. Hallmarking ensures the credibility and validity of the manufacturer's claims regarding the purity of the gold coins. It is a trademark that certifies the gold purity according to the specified standards. Gold items are tested and certified for their purity and fineness at official BIS (Bureau of Indian Standard) Hallmarking Centres, assuring that you are receiving what you paid for. As a general rule, look for the BIS logo, purity in Karat or fineness, the logo of the Hallmarking centre, and the jeweller's ID. These markings can assist you in authenticating the gold coins.
Shop Now
 
Weight The weight or denomination of the gold coin is another crucial factor that affects its price. Jewellers and banks offer various denominations, with 1 gram, 5 grams, and 10 grams being the most common due to their high gold coin prices. Other available denominations range from 0.5 grams to 50 grams, depending on market trends and sizes. Since gold prices fluctuate, the price of gold coins today may differ from a few days ago, potentially influencing the denomination of the gold coin you purchase.
 
Making Charges Making charges refer to the fees imposed by the manufacturer for their creativity and efforts involved in crafting the gold coin. These charges can range from approximately 8% to 16% for jewellery and are an additional expense you need to bear, not transferred to the next purchaser when you resell the gold. However, making charges on gold coins are usually lower compared to other pieces of jewellery. This is because manufacturing gold coins requires less effort and craftsmanship than creating intricate jewellery designs. This affordability and accessibility make gold coins a popular choice for many buyers. As you embark on your journey to invest in gold coins, it's also worth exploring various jewellery deals available in the market. Many jewellers offer attractive discounts and promotions on gold coins, making them even more affordable and appealing for investors. Keeping an eye out for such deals can help you maximise your investment potential while ensuring that you are getting the best value for your money. Investing in gold coins can provide a secure and tangible asset in your portfolio. By considering the points mentioned here and keeping an eye on jewellery deals, you can make a well-rounded investment decision and potentially reap the benefits of gold's enduring value in the long run. So, take your time, do your research, and make a wise investment choice that aligns with your financial goals..

Currently Gift Vouchers, Gift Cards and Helmets are not available on COD.
NOTE : COD is not applicable for International Orders. As per the Indian Govt's rule, denominations of Rs 500 and Rs 1000 are deemed to be illegal tenders effective 9th November 2016. Therefore, these currency notes will not be accepted by our delivery personnel for any orders placed via COD as a payment option.

Please use the e-mail ID used at the time of placing the order. The contact details of our logistic partner will be shared with you. You need to coordinate with them for return shipping and take the following steps:

a) Pack your order in original packaging and mention your name, order number and mobile number.

b) Lock the metal box using the orange lock that would be provided to you in the box itself. If the orange lock is not available, let us know, and we will send you the lock separately.

c) Enclose the original invoice, guarantee/warranty card & other tag, if any.

d) Our logistic partner will pick up the package from you.

e) Post inspection, only after we get a go-ahead from the QA (quality assurance) team, the refund process will be initiated.

For International Orders, currently, we do not accept any returns or exchanges of our products.

Please note that returns are not accepted for coins, silver products, and nose pins.

  1. Mia by Tanishq products purchased online can be exchanged at any Mia by Tanishq or select Tanishq stores, however, the Company will exchange the product at 70% of the current value of the product subject to the below conditions:
    1. Exchange will be considered with either the Certificate of Authenticity or the Original Invoice
    2. The company will accept Mia Jewellery for exchange after due examination for defects, weights and originality, including the identification and damage or stone defects (cracks, replacements, alterations etc.).
  2. If the customer seeks a refund, additional deductions of 10% on studded jewellery & 3% on other jewellery or as applicable from time to time on the exchange will be levied on the final exchange value.
  3. Any discounts provided for the Mia product to be exchanged shall be recovered at the time of exchange.
  4. All Mia Products can be exchanged only in Stores and not Online. Only return is applicable online provided it falls within the return policy window and other T&Cs are met. For more information, please check the Return policy.
  5. Silver products cannot be exchanged.

Styling Tips & Guides
Maintaining Professionalism with Jewellery: A Guide for Doctors Doctors are mostly busy being real-life superheroes, enhancing their healthcare practices by the day and saving lives by night. But, doctors, too, deserve to feel most like themselves while dedicating a whole life characterised by expertise, to saving the world, don’t they? If you’re a doctor who would like to showcase more of her personality and passions through styling, we’re here to save the day! Mia by Tanishq presents a diverse collection of lightweight and subtle jewellery which will not only let you maintain a professional persona – but also, in style! With dainty jewellery options like pendants, studs, bracelets and more - elevating your everyday looks featuring lab coats and scrubs, shall become much more fun. You’ll feel the grip on your ‘sense of self’ tighten, even while making routine rounds in the hospital. So, explore stunning jewellery options for doctors to infuse your doctor’s uniform with some much-needed sparkle!
Tips on Styling Doctors’ Attires: Maintaining Professionalism with Jewellery While doctors are working professionals taking on a dozen responsibilities, they are still 'feeling' souls who need to stay grounded to avoid burnout. We also want to prioritise doctors' mental health by allowing them access to little avenues of outlet. Fashion allows one to speak one's mind without using words explicitly. One's get-up can help them subsequently get out of a rut. While it can be difficult to experiment with clothing wardrobe, you can resort to jewellery to get your word out. So, express yourself in stylistic ways. Adorn high-quality ornaments which align with your style. Feel more connected to your tastes and preferences through your choice of ornaments. Here are tips on styling jewellery as a doctor, while staying on par with the professional dress code:
1. Keep it Minimal If you opt for more minimal options in jewellery, you can be assured of continued comfort throughout your 12-hour-long work shift. Finely-crafted jewellery is all the rage within the fashion world owing to trends popping up, surrounding ‘corporate’-inspired looks. This trend, popularly known as the ‘corporate-core’ trend, plays with silhouettes featuring stripes, solid bases and polka dots across whites, blues and greys. So, you can opt for a minimal gold jewellery design and pair it with a grey base piece, white flared trousers and of course, the doctor's patent, white coat. Plus, you can get as creative as you want without being worried about ‘over-doing it’.
2. Go for the Elegant Vibe With several different aesthetics to try, the ‘elegant’ look is an ideal fit for the environment you’re in. Even while you can dress up in simple pieces, you can elevate the entire look with the help of dainty, gold or silver jewellery. For example, you can opt for Mia by Tanishq’s ‘Sparkling Moonlight 14KT Diamond Pendant’ and wear it as a statement piece across different outfits. Explore colour palettes featuring shades of cream, peach, beige and pastel colours to tie in with the ultimate ‘haute-couture’ vibe. You can also, on the other hand, skip the necklace altogether and opt for an ‘only-earrings’ look with our ‘Tribal Charm 22KT Gold Drop Earrings’. This pair is perfect for the days you’re leaning towards an eastern-formal flavour! Kurtas, sarees, salwar sets – you name it and our earrings will complement it!
3. Opt for Gemstone Jewellery While you can opt for simple gold or silver jewellery – choosing a contemporary piece featuring a fusion of gemstones into the metal, can add a little cheerful surprise to your jewellery stack! For instance, you can opt for the 'Skyline Sparkle 14KT London Blue Topaz Drop Earrings’ featuring a royal navy blue sparkle. Add a gleaming focus to your everyday scrubs with this dazzling pair of drop earrings. You can also opt for earrings featuring a ‘pearly-delight’. While vibrant gemstones like rubies and sapphires can add a playful element to your look, the pearl detail featured in our 'Moon Shadow Melody 14KT Pearl Drop Earring’ can quickly turn up the ‘classy-notch!’
4. Layer a Little! A dainty necklace can be worn singly to elevate an outfit. At the same time, you can add further dimension and character to your look with the help of minimal layering. Especially, if you opt for 2-3 finely-structured pendants in combination with sleek gold chains – it’s going to give your good-old scrubs - a fresh, new radiance! This iconic bunch of necklace styling features quirky shapes, the glamorous appeal of semi-precious gemstones, the classic beauty of pearls and a neutral gold piece to tie it in, altogether.
5. Accessorise with Intention You can opt for jewellery which particularly speaks of and to your personality, passions and hobbies. Beyond being a doctor, you are a lovely daughter bringing a smile across every family member's face, the perfect girlfriend to your lover, a wise sister to your siblings, and more! Let your jewellery pick also represent and remind you of other aspects of life! You may also hone your talents in strumming the guitar while harmonising or taking Polaroid photographs everywhere you go. To stay connected to these, more personal bits of yourself – you can opt for symbolic charms. For example, wear our ‘Home Sweet Home Silver Charm’ as a sweet reminder of home, no matter where you are. Alternatively, have your passions on the show with our 'Snapshot Sparkle Camera Silver Charm’ or ‘Rock Riff Silver Guitar Charm’.
Types of Jewellery: Be a ‘Cool Doc’ Down the Street Are you ready to apply some of the styling tips right away? Stock up on the essentials with Mia by Tanishq, today! Here are some of our top picks in jewellery for doctors so you can slay your professional looks in style:
1. Gold Pendants
Opt for dainty gold pendants featuring minute details. Our ‘Meteor Charm 14KT Diamond Pendant with Chain’ is not only characterised by an alluring centre-piece but also other intricate gold details along the rest of the chain. You can pair this pendant with another plain gold chain to add a personal touch to your silk top and tailored trousers combo!
2. Gold Earrings
By opting for classic gold and diamond studs, you not only ensure that your timeless style finds outlet but also that you remain comfortable throughout your work shift. Style the ‘14KT Yellow Gold Shimmering Pear Diamond Stud Earrings’ with your tweed tops and formal trousers, to embody the ultimate ‘boss woman’ vibe. Plus, these shine-abundant stud earrings will also light up a button-down, white coat look!
3. Gold and Gemstone-studded Bracelet
Finally, explore some of our finely crafted bracelets featuring the allure of semi-precious gemstones alongside a polished gold finish. Our ‘Berry Bellini Baubles 14KT Ruby Bangle’ can serve as an element of surprise in your all-neutral outfit. This mix between a neutral outfit and a cheery pop of colour adds a high degree of interest to an overall ensemble. All the above-mentioned jewellery options are lightweight in make, and give off a 'less is more' aura. They are versatile enough to style with your different outfits while maintaining professionalism with jewellery.
Final Word for Docs Who Want to ‘Keep in Clean’ in Style This Doctor’s Day, not only do we want to appreciate doctors’ constant contribution towards enriching public healthcare initiatives – but also, see them for who they are beyond their profession. Mia by Tanishq brings the perfect collection of everyday jewellery for doctors who want to be on their ‘self-hood’ and their style while being devoted to their duties as well. Pick out pieces which align with our stylistic vision. Incorporate a sprinkle of sparkle as you develop new treatments and continue to make waves with medical research!

content.description: Looking for unique matching jewellery ideas to celebrate Friendship? Discover perfect pieces that symbolise your special bond. Explore now and make lasting memories!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Festivals And Celebrations
Celebrate Friendship with Matching Jewellery Ideas for You and Your Best Friend Do you remember the day you went through your first heartbreak, and how you vented to your best friend while she listened to you patiently? And do you remember the days you would run off to your best friend for any inconvenience? How beautiful is the bond that you share with that one person, how pure and gentle! These are the selfless souls who stand by us through thick and thin, the ones who know us inside and out, and who enrich our lives in ways we can't even measure. To honour these irreplaceable bonds, are you looking for gifts that are unique, thoughtful and resonate with the tales of your friendship? Then matching jewellery pieces are ideal for this wonderful day, as they offer a perfect way to symbolise the special connection you share with your best friend. Hence, read further in this blog and delve into an array of scintillating matching jewellery ideas that will scream “two pretty best friends!!’.
Matching Jewellery Ideas That Tell Your Story Are you and your best friend a stan of statement pieces or squeal at dainty jewellery pieces? Whatever your preference is, there are countless matching jewellery ideas for best friends to choose from. This allows you to find pieces that perfectly capture the essence of your friendship. Here are a few inspiring ideas to get you started:
For the Friends Who Met Young
That friend you have grown up with, who has seen you through life's ups and downs, deserves to be celebrated like no other. Consider getting matching necklaces with initials or symbols that represent significant messages or memories. This stunning necklace features two evil eyes adorned with glittering diamonds and crafted expertly with alluring yellow gold. The evil eye charm carries the special message that- “you are safe, no matter where you go. My good wishes will always protect and support you just as the sun supports the moon to shine its brightest in the night sky”. Celebrate your friendship with the resplendent aura of this necklace.
For the Friends Who Are Always Connected
The hardest thing about adulting is physically growing apart from that one friend. With the burden of responsibilities and unfulfilled dreams, we embark on our journeys. As a result, we may sometimes end up living in a different city or country to that of our best friend. But does the physical distance dampen the emotional closeness you two share, does it affect a true friendship? It never does! So commemorate the friend that lives far away with the infinity symbol gold and diamond rings. This finger ring showcases an infinity symbol that glistens with the charm of gold and the subtle sheen of diamonds. The charisma of this ring is emphasised by the sheen of diamonds of one infinity curve. Overall, the design of the ring represents the unbreakable bond that you share with your best friend, no matter the miles.
For the Friends Who Share a Dream or Passion
“One day, we will roam the world together”, “I can't wait to explore the loveliest things of the globe with you!”. These are the dreams you shared with your best friend, that you two are working hard each day to accomplish. This passion, these dreams, innocence and requited platonic love need to be honoured. The most ideal jewellery idea will be matching earrings - earrings with a charm that resonates with you two. This pair of stunning earrings reflect light from every angle, reminding you of the principle of your friendship - “your dreams are safe with me, and will glisten with the strength of our friendship, till we achieve them”. Let your ears whisper this like a mantra, as you glimmer with the silver sheen.
The Perfect Finishing Touch: A Friendship Gift That Lasts Matching jewellery is therefore a tangible symbol of the love and appreciation you have for your best friend. When you choose pieces that resonate with your unique friendship story, you are creating a lasting reminder of the special bond you share. So, this friendship day, ditch the ordinary and explore the world of matching jewellery ideas. With a little creativity, you can find the perfect pieces that will not only make your friend smile but also serve as a cherished reminder of your friendship for years to come.

Mangalsutra, according to Indian heritage, is considered to be one of the most auspicious ornaments for married women. A Mangalsutra is basically a necklace made up of a gold chain with black beads and a pendant. Just like how a wedding ring symbolizes marriage in western countries, a Mangalsutra is an accessory that signifies the marital status of women in India. Mangalsutras today are available in many contemporary designs for today's modern women. Since a mangalsutra is worn only by married women, the traditional designs were heavy and designed only to match with Indian traditional outfits.

Significance Of Mangalsutras In India

Wearing a Mangalsutra is considered to be holy for married women in India. Also known as the 'holy chain', a gold mangalsutra is believed to provide protection to the bond between the married couple. Considered a protector of the marriage from evil energy of all sorts, a Mangalsutra with black beads is said to fight off the negativity and maintain the marriage and husband's health and fortune.

Gold Mangalsutra holds a distinguished history and heritage of its own in India. The grand event of tying this auspicious necklace or chain is called Mangalya Dharanam and is celebrated with great grandeur by the families of the bride and the groom.

How to buy a Pendant with Chain? Here are 3 Tips To Save your Day

Self-love is all the rage right now, as it should be. For years we have been hard on ourselves and finally we have started to understand that it's important to keep ourselves first and care for ourselves both from the inside and the outside.

And what better way to self-care than with exquisite jewellery from our collection? We, at Mia by Tanishq have unique and mesmerizing designs curated carefully for the women of today. Our collection includes everything from necklaces, and rings to pendants with chains so that you can browse through the designs and find the perfect one for you.

In the spring season, a dainty and feminine gold pendant and chain is a must-have. It is a simple piece of jewellery that can instantly elevate your look with minimum effort. So, you might want to check out our collection of pendants with chain in unique designs at Mia by Tanishq.

But, before you do, here are 3 tips that would help you find the best pendant with chain online.

Select Your Metal

Shopping for a pendant with chain can seem daunting, but once you have the basics down, this can be a super fun process as well! The first thing to look for is the metal of the chain and clasp you want to go for.

Each precious metal like gold and silver has a unique appeal and selecting one for your pendant with chain can be confusing. The best way to select one is by assessing your skin tone and overall style. These two factors can determine which metal will look the best with your pendant with chain.

If you generally wear warmer tones like yellow, red, brown and more, then going with a gold pendant and chain will be the best option. As this necklace would flawlessly complement your style.

Whereas, if you generally dress in cooler tones like black, grey, and blue then pairing your outfits with a diamond pendant and chain should be the way to go!

Diamond Design

If there’s one thing that needs to be shopped for carefully it’s the diamond of your pendant with chain. After all, it is the centerpiece and deserves attention to detail. While browsing for various designs the 4Cs of diamonds must always be kept in mind

The carat determines the weight and price of your pendant with chain, the colour ranges from being opaque to crystal clear, the clarity of the diamond means that the diamond is pure. The more clearer the diamond, the better its quality.

And lastly, the cut of the diamond pendant and chain can also affect the overall look of your design. The most common cut women go for is the classic round brilliant cut diamond that has a classic appeal.

Choosing A Chain

The chain itself is the last component of your pendant with chain. Many people may not give the chain design importance, however, it makes up most of your neckpiece and deserves as much attention as the pendant.

While shopping for a pendant with chain, there are two things you need to look out for. It is the length and the design of the chain. The style you select depends on the purpose of your pendant with chain. If you will be wearing it solely on special occasions then you might want to go for a chain that is wider and blingy so that it catches everyone’s eye.

However, if you want a pendant with chain that is simple and can be worn on the daily then a sleek rolo chain design might be the way to go!

Now that you have all the tips you need, head onto Mia by Tanishq and start shopping!

Titan takes the privacy of your information seriously. This Privacy Notice describes the types of personal information we collect from you through our stores, websites including sub-domains and microsites and mobile applications.
