1. DEFINITIONS

In this Privacy Notice, the following definitions are used:

(a) Cookies: A small file placed on your device by our website or mobile application when you either visit or use certain features of our website or mobile application. A cookie generally allows a website to remember your actions or preference for a certain period of time.

(b) Data: Includes non-personal information, personal information and sensitive personal information about you, which either directly or indirectly in combination with other information, could allow you to be identified when you visit our stores, website and/or mobile application.

(c) Data Protection Laws: Any applicable law and guidelines notified by Government of India relating to the processing of Data.

(d) Partners: Select third parties (including Tata Group Entities) with whom we have contracts for the businesses described in this Privacy Notice.

(e) Service Providers: Includes entities to whom we or other Tata Group Entities will disclose your Data in order to process information for a specific purpose pursuant to written contract.

(f) Tata Group Entity: Tata Sons Private Limited, and its subsidiaries, affiliates, associate companies and joint venture companies with whom we have a contractual arrangement to, inter alia, share data for the purposes described in this Privacy Notice.

(g) User or you: The natural person who accesses our stores, website or mobile application.

2. WHAT DATA DO WE COLLECT ABOUT YOU

Titan collects Data for various purposes set out in this Privacy Notice. This Data includes, without limitation, the following categories:

(a) Contact information: first and last name, email address, postal address, country, employer, phone number and other similar contact data.

(b) Financial information: payment instrument information, transactions, transaction history, preferences, method, mode and manner of payment, spending pattern or trends, and other similar data.

(c) Technical information: website, device and mobile app usage, Internet Protocol (IP) address and similar information collected via automated means, such as cookies, pixels and similar technologies.

(d) Transaction information: the date of the transaction, total amount, transaction history and preferences and related details.

(e) Product and service information: Your account membership number, registration and payment information, and program-specific information, when you request products and/or services directly from us, or participate in marketing programs.

(f) Personal information: Age, sex, date of birth, marital status, nationality, details of government identification documents provided, occupation, ethnicity, religion, travel history, or any other personal information provided in responses to surveys or questionnaires.

(g) Personal data that is automatically collected when you use the wearable device and connected application which may include but is not limited to:

i. Data from sensors on the wearable device like heart rate, steps taken, sleep duration, etc.

ii. Schedule or appointments with health, fitness, wellness or swimming coaches.

iii. Your geographical location including GPS signals, cell tower IDs and Wi-Fi access points.

iv. Your usage information like IP address, bandwidth speed, browser type, language, operating system, cookie information, device or application identifier, standard server log information, and information about the software programs that are installed on your system.

(h) Your reviews, feedback and opinions about our products, programmes and services.

(i) Loyalty programme information: your loyalty membership information, account details, profile or password details and any frequent flyer or travel partner programme affiliation.

content.display-name: Style Pantone Color of the Year
content.description: Do you want to seal your position as the trendsetter this season? This blog will provide you with tips to style Pantone's Colour of the Year and embrace various aesthetics!

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Latest And Trending
How to Incorporate Pantone’s Colour of the Year into Your Wardrobe? The Pantone ‘Colour of the Year' is a major source of trend forecasts for a specific epoch. From being featured in digital art and popular periodicals to fashion ensembles across runways – the colour of the year reigns as the ‘crowd fav’! For the year 2024, Peach Fuzz (PANTONE 13-1023) has been dubbed as ‘Colour of the Year’. Peach is created from a cheery mix of soft orange, reminiscent of sunsets down the bay, and additional pigments of vibrant red and warm-toned white. The phrase ‘peach fuzz' refers to the tiny, fine hair particles found on a peach’s outer skin. While the shade is oddly particular – it is also an impossibly unique one, featured primarily on designers’, like Jacquemus’, clothing line launches. Apart from gaining popularity via features on runways, the peach is also a major symbol of new, blooming, unconventional love – as seen in the art film of the century, ‘Call Me by Your Name!’ If you’re looking to incorporate the shades of the Pantone Colour of the Year into your daily wardrobe – this is the perfect guide for you!
Ways to Style the Pantone ‘Colour of the Year’ Keep up with the latest trends in terms of colour and intrigue by incorporating the peach fuzz shade in your daily ensembles. You can include the shade in the form of clothing, jewellery or other accessories. In any case, owing to peach fuzz being a distinctive tint – it immediately adds a focus of outstanding interest to the overall look! Here are some simple ways to incorporate the Pantone ‘Colour of the Year’ - peach fuzz shade, to make it pop in all its glory:
1. Monochrome Ensemble A top-to-bottom peach fuzz look is surely going to steal any show. Especially, if you’re dressing up for a bright Summer morning, a day you’re ready to spend with your closest circle – a monochrome outfit with intentional gold accessorising will perfectly do the job of making your ensemble appear picture-perfect!
2. Mix & Match While mixing and matching can be super fun – make sure to settle on a ‘vibe’ beforehand! That way, you can put together a colour-abundant yet cohesive look. For example, as peach fuzz lies within the category of pastel with a larger scoop of white in the mix – pairing a peach blouse with a pencil skirt featuring pastel blues, greens and pinks will make the outfit feel 'well-thought-out', and not randomly thrown together! Pro Tip: Make all your outfits count by infusing them with intent as true style lies in the ability to control and wield your artistic wand!
3. Go for a Soft Glam Look The peach fuzz colour is an understated shade on its own. So, pairing it with a ‘soft’ glam look shall be the stylish route to undertake. Go for a rosy pink cheek blush and a cool-toned coral lip tint – there you have it, a 'no-makeup, makeup look’! Next, tie your hair up into a sleek bun and gel down any baby hair sticking out. While this is a glam look, you are softening it to match the muted tone of the peach fuzz colour. To complete the outfit, opt for gold-diamond accents and a subtle twist of sparkly mystique through jewellery!
4. Tread the Minimal Path You can go for an overall minimal vibe with your peach fuzz-dominated look. Opt for a loosely-fitted, silk peach blouse and pair it with flare-legged, white trousers – embody the ‘chic city-girl’ aura! Now, accessories with neutral elements like belts and watches are made of brown or beige bands. Finally, add gold or silver accents in the form of dainty pendants, earrings, rings and bracelets to add a bit of shiny flair to the ensemble!
5. Experiment with Rose-Gold The rose-gold metal is a classic choice – right up there with royal, yellow gold and lustrous silver. With peach fuzz as the base, the rose gold colour shall look divine in the form of layered necklaces. So, opt for rose-gold jewellery options to elevate your look and experiment with silk, flowy skirts of a mirrored shade. Now that you know where to start with styling your peach fuzz fits for the season – it's time we move on to a crucial component in outfit creation. Jewellery – it is what takes an outfit from 'good' to 'an absolute slay'! Thus, Mia by Tanishq has come up with a selection of versatile, everyday ornaments that are sure to sparkle and perfectly complement your peachy #OOTDs.
Types of Jewellery: The Glitzy ‘Fuzz’ to Your ‘Peach’ Embody the classic 'less is more' vibe while also remaining at par with the latest trends of the year, one of them being the feature of Pantone’s ‘Colour of the Year’ in your ensembles! To do so flawlessly – start with accessorising well. Jewellery is a must-include in your looks to draw and hold the beholder’s mesmerised gaze. Here are some of our favourite picks for your peach fuzz slays of the year:
1. Gold Pendant with a Chain
Opt for a dainty gold pendant with a chain and pair it with your flowy top and trousers combination. Have the peach colour feature on the blouse or your denim jeans, and add a neutral piece to balance out the colour wheel. The ‘Pinnacle Light 14 Kt Gold & Diamond Pendant with Chain’ is the perfect ‘cherry on top’ of your Summer look. This particular piece is characterised by a modern mould and a refined finish – plus, a side of bling!
2. Rose and White Gold Earrings
Pair your peach-coloured top with a romantic, rosey-blend satin shirt. Proceed to light a spark with the help of our ‘Dazzling Heart 14KT Rose & White Gold Diamond Drop Earrings’! Featuring a mix of a cutesy pinkish gold and an elegant white – this pair of earrings can complement a vast array of styles, appropriate for office wear, themed events and daytime outings!
3. Gold and Diamond Bracelets
The peach fuzz shade, in hindsight, is a unique fusion of red, orange and white – 3 of the colours associated with a ‘good time under a golden hour', a hearty laughter spree’ and of course, the undeniable connotations of romance! Echo the same vibes with your peach fuzz-covered (metaphorically) avatar by adorning our ‘Cupid Charm 14KT Gold & Diamond Bracelet’. It spells the word ‘LOVE’ out, representative of a honey-sweet notion –the blooming nature of affections. By pairing this ornament with your peachy look – you're tying the whole 'bubble-gum cherry' vibe to the silhouette.
4. Gemstone-studded Rings
If you’re going for the iconic monochrome look –include colours through the incorporation of jewels. For example, you can pick out the ‘Nebula's Glow Blue Topaz 14KT Finger Ring’ featuring a mix of blues, violets and yellows in the form of Topaz crystals. So, style the gemstone-studded ring with a monochrome peach fit for an explosion of colours in particular focal points. Also, add to the mix of gemstones by incorporating sapphires, rubies, amethysts and more. Check out pieces like our ‘Radiant Spiral Ruby & Diamond Stud Earrings’, ‘Ethereal Firefly Gold & Amethyst Bangle’ and ‘Twilight Halo Sapphire & Diamond’ to glow up with the colourful fiesta!
5. Silver Charms
You can also opt for a silver charm for your peach looks featuring a vein by cooler undertones. Our ‘Pink Blossom Flower Silver Charm’ is a particular vibe match to your peachy-toned fits! The flower motif is representative of sunny themes and Summer dew – radiating an uplifting aura overall.
Final Word on Finding the Perfect Jewel Matches to the Pantone ‘Colour of the Year’ Peach Fuzz is a unique colour that was only featured across the most aesthetic-adjacent Pinterest boards. However, being crowned as the 'Colour of the Year' in 2024, it is seen across iconic ensembles on reality TV shows, runways and magazines. You can also style the Pantone ‘Colour of the Year’ and get super artsy with it! So, explore Mia by Tanishq’s curated collection of dainty pendants, studs, rings and bracelets to make your peachy ensemble stand out. Besides, you can also style the same pieces with other colours or styles of outfits – so, designate the ‘go-to’ title to your to-be most worn jewellery pieces, at cost-effective rates!

Ring Stacking 101: Mastering The Art Of Layering Rings With Style Accessorising is a form of self-expression, and one of the oldest fashion trends that have captured the attention of fashion enthusiasts is ring stacking. Imagine the mesmerising sparkle of a diamond ring online, delicately nestled amidst a symphony of intricately crafted gold rings, each one a testament to your unique sense of style. Whether you prefer delicate and dainty rings or bold and chunky ones, mastering the art of ring stacking can elevate your jewellery game to a new level. 1. Mix and Match
The beauty of ring stacking lies in the freedom of mixing and matching different styles, metals, and gemstones. Don't be afraid to experiment with various textures, colours, and sizes. Combine delicate bands with statement rings or mix gold with silver for an eclectic look.
 
2. Create Balance and Proportions While experimentation is appreciated, it's crucial to maintain proportions when stacking rings. Consider the width of each ring and how it complements the others. For example, if you're wearing a chunky statement ring on one finger, balance it out with thinner, more delicate bands on the other fingers.
 
3. Vary Ring Placement Explore different finger placements to add visual interest to your ring stack. Try stacking rings on your index, middle, and ring fingers, leaving your pinky finger bare or adorned with a single statement ring. Alternatively, experiment with stacking multiple rings on one finger for a bolder and more dramatic effect.
 
4. Play with Symmetry and Asymmetry Symmetry and asymmetry both have their charm when it comes to ring stacking. Symmetry creates a balanced and structured look by mirroring ring placements on both hands. On the other hand, asymmetry adds an element of surprise and quirkiness.
 
5. Consider the Occasion Tailor your ring stack to the occasion or event you're attending. For a casual day out, opt for a more understated and minimalist approach with a few delicate bands. content.display-name: How to find out your Ring size

custom-attributes.custom-attribute:
Gifting
Online Shopping Made Easy: How To Find Out Your Ring Size Online shopping for jewellery has transformed the way we explore and purchase ornate pieces, offering unmatched convenience right from our homes. A standout benefit of this digital shift is the simplicity with which one can determine their ring size. Many online jewellery retailers now offer detailed guides and tutorials addressing the query, "how do you find out your ring size." These resources typically illustrate straightforward methods, such as using household items like a string or leveraging a printable ring sizing chart, ensuring accurate measurements of one's finger circumference. This eliminates the need to visit a physical store to determine your ring size, streamlining the entire purchasing process. Additionally, online retailers frequently offer size conversion charts to help customers easily understand and choose the right fit for their desired jewellery piece. Let us have a look at the DIY methods to determine ring size and translate measurements into ring sizes.
Beauty TIp
Take the time you need to make sure that what you bought makes you feel like the inner you
 
Why Ring Size Matters?
Knowing your ring size is essential for several reasons:
 
Comfort And Wearability A ring that fits properly is comfortable to wear. Too tight, and it might constrict the finger, potentially causing circulation issues or discomfort. Too loose, and there's a risk of it slipping off and getting lost.
Ensures Safety Rings that are too loose can easily slide off without the wearer noticing, leading to potential loss or damage. Conversely, a ring that's too tight can become stuck, which might necessitate professional removal.
Symbolic Importance Rings often symbolise special occasions or commitments, such as engagements, marriages, or personal milestones. A ring that fits perfectly enhances the joy and significance of the moment.
Preservation Of Design Some rings, especially those with intricate designs or stones set all the way around, can't be resized without altering or damaging the original design.
Avoiding Wear And Tear A properly sized ring minimises unnecessary wear and tear. A loose ring can get knocked around more, while a tight one experiences stress.
Enhances The Wearing Experience When you wear a ring that fits perfectly, you're more likely to enjoy the experience without having to constantly adjust it or worry about its fit.
DIY Methods To Determine Ring Size If you want to learn how to measure ring size at home or find out your ring size without visiting a jeweller, there are several DIY methods you can try. Here are some methods that may help you determine your ring size:
1. Use A Printable Ring Sizing Chart:
  • Search online for a printable ring sizing chart. Many jewellers and online jewellery stores offer these charts for free.
  • Ensure that the printed chart is to scale by checking the provided measurement or scale indicator on the chart.
  • Place one of your existing rings on the chart until you find the circle that matches the inside diameter of your ring. This should give you an accurate size measurement.
2. Measure Your Finger With A String:
  • To answer your question ‘how do you find out your ring size’, you can use a piece of string or a thin strip of paper.
  • Wrap it around the base of the finger where you plan to wear the ring, making sure it's a bit loose, not too tight.
  • Mark the point where the string or paper overlaps and measure its length in millimeters.
  • Once you have the measurement, use an online ring size chart to find your ring size based on the length you measured.
Translating Measurements Into Ring Sizes Translating measurements into ring sizes can be done with relative ease. If you're wondering how do you find out your ring size or how to know your ring size, below mentioned are some points you can adhere to while measuring your ring size:
Shop Now
1. Measure an Existing Ring: If you already have a ring that fits comfortably on the finger you want to wear your new ring on, you can measure its inner diameter using a ruler or a digital calliper. Match the measurement to the sizing chart to determine your ring size.
2. Finger Circumference Measurement: If you don't have an existing ring, you can measure the circumference of the finger you intend to wear the ring on. Use a flexible measuring tape to wrap around the base of the finger. Mark where the tape overlaps and then measure the length in millimetres. Match this measurement to the ring sizing chart.
3. Consider Ring Width: Keep in mind that wider rings feel tighter than thinner ones, so go up a half or full size for wider bands.
Expert Guidance For Ring Shopping Determining the right ring size is a pivotal step in purchasing a piece that not only represents a significant sentiment but also fits seamlessly. At this point, you should have a clear understanding of how to find out your ring size, a question many grapple with, especially when purchasing online. A Beginner's Guide To Understanding What Is Solitaire Diamond Have you ever wondered about the captivating charm of diamonds? These precious gems fascinated humanity for ce­nturies as if possessing a charm that captures everyone’s he­arts and embodies love, opule­nce, and eternal be­auty. Within solitaire diamond jewellery, one style stands out with timeless grace and unadorne­d elegance: the solitaire diamond. This guide takes you on a journey to uncover the true essence of the solitaire diamond's exceptional be­auty. Let's commence by exploring the question, "What solitaire diamonds?" and its distinct attributes. After exploring what the solitaire diamond means, we will dig into its e­nduring symbolism throughout history, revealing the secrets behind this flawless gem. Join us to learn "what is solitaire diamond" and plunge­ into its depths and unearth the captivating allure­ of the solitaire diamond!
What Is Solitaire Diamond?
Your quest to discover the meaning of "what is solitaire diamond or what solitaire diamond means?" concludes here. A solitaire diamond is a magnificent gem that shines brilliantly on its own. It is a unique work of art, and its design is elegantly simple. Now, that's the fundamental explanation of "what is solitaire diamond or what a solitaire diamond means?" Nevertheless, if you want to grasp its unique attributes, then it is vital that you thoroughly examine its defining characteristics after discovering solitaire meaning in jewellery.
 
1. Single Diamond Focus
Now that you understand "what is solitaire diamond or what a solitaire diamond means" and appreciate its remarkable quality – the essence of singularity – let's dive deeper. Unlike its counterparts, a solitaire diamond piece, whether it's a ring, pendant, or earrings, steadfastly embraces a single precious gem at its core. This solitary jewel naturally claims the spotlight, captivating attention and evoking admiration all on its own. Its mere presence surpasses the insignificance of the surrounding world as this extraordinary treasure takes centre stage.
 
2. Minimalist Design
Solitaire diamond jewellery epitomises simplicity at its fine­st. As discussed in the previous answer to the question "What is solitaire diamond," the deliberately unde­rstated setting cradles the diamond, captivating your attention with its brilliance­. The minimalist approach ensures that nothing de­tracts from the natural beauty of the diamond, resulting in a harmonious fusion of purity and elegance. In this instance, less truly signifies more.
 
Popularity Through The Ages
The most typical question, "What is solitaire meaning in jewellery, or what is solitaire diamond?" repeatedly arises as this gem often leaves people intrigued. However, this fascination towards a solitaire diamond or the urge to learn about a solitaire meaning in jewellery is far from a recent occurrence. It has withstood the test of time and transcended various cultures, captivating millions across ce­nturies.
 
1. Historical Significance
The concept of showcasing a single diamond can be traced back to ancient civilisations. A diamond, being rare and highly coveted, was often displayed individually to maximise its impact. This tradition, rooted in the belief that a diamond possessed mystical powers, continued through various cultures, symbolising wealth, power, and eternal love.
 
2. Engagement Rings
Engageme­nt rings often feature a solitaire­ diamond, which has become an iconic symbol. This tradition gaine­d prominence in the 20th century following the famous declaration that "a diamond is foreve­r." The simplicity of a solitaire diamond ring beautifully capture­s the essence­ of pure and everlasting love shared between two people. Additionally, diamonds, for generations, have been more than just dazzling gemstones; they are a powerful emblem of status, reflecting the stature and prestige of the wearer. Wearing a diamond does not just augment one's appearance, but it imbues a profound sense of confidence, resonating with the inner strength and self-worth of the individual. Beyond their undeniable sparkle, diamonds stand as symbols of self-love, serving as daily affirmations of one's unique worth and beauty.
 
Discover Mia By Tanishq: Your Solitaire Destination
Now that you comprehend "what is solitaire diamond," you can appreciate how it effortlessly steals the spotlight with its minimalist design. Its unwavering charm has captivated hearts throughout history and continues to do so today, a testament to its timeless appeal. Whether entranced by a solitaire ring or simply marvelling at these exquisite gems, learning solitaire meaning in jewellery deepens your reverence for nature's remarkable treasures. When seeking the perfect solitaire diamond, trust Mia by Tanishq. Our exquisite collection epitomises solitaire elegance, each piece a true masterpiece. .bsl .card-image { width: 100%; height: 200px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 35%, rgba(197, 165, 118, 0.22) 0%, transparent 55%), linear-gradient(135deg, #12070d 0%, #2a1018 40%, #3d1c1c 70%, #1e0e0b 100%); position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsl .card-image-photo { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; display: block; }
.bsl .card-image-badge { position: absolute; top: var(--space-4); left: var(--space-4); }

/* Badge */
.bsl .badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-full); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.bsl .badge--open { background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.12); color: #15803d; border: 1px solid rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.25); }
.bsl .badge--closed { background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.10); color: #b91c1c; border: 1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2); }
.bsl .badge-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }

/* Card Content */
.bsl .card-content { padding: var(--space-5); flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3); }
.bsl .card-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-3); }
.bsl .card-name { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: var(--text-lg); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-charcoal); line-height: 1.3; text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--transition-fast); }
.bsl .card-name:hover { color: var(--color-red); }
.bsl .card-rating { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsl .rating-star { color: var(--color-gold); font-size: var(--text-sm); }
.bsl .rating-value { font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-charcoal); }
.bsl .rating-count { font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--color-grey-500); }
.bsl .card-address { font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-grey-500); line-height: 1.5; }
.bsl .card-info-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-grey-700); }
.bsl .card-info-row svg { color: var(--color-gold); flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsl .card-info-row a { color: var(--color-grey-700); transition: color var(--transition-fast); }
.bsl .card-info-row a:hover { color: var(--color-red); }
.bsl .card-footer { margin-top: auto; padding-top: var(--space-3); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-grey-200); }
.bsl .btn-container { display: flex; gap: var(--space-2); align-items: center; }
.bsl .btn-container .btn-book { flex: 1; min-width: 0; white-space: normal; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; }

/* Buttons */
.bsl .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition-fast); text-decoration: none; border: 1.5px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; }
.bsl .btn-book { background: var(--color-red); color: var(--color-white); border-color: var(--color-red); }
.bsl .btn-book:hover { background: #b50930; border-color: #b50930; box-shadow: var(--shadow-red); }
.bsl .btn-directions { background: var(--color-grey-100); color: var(--color-charcoal); border-color: var(--color-grey-200); flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsl .btn-directions:hover { background: var(--color-charcoal); color: var(--color-white); border-color: var(--color-charcoal); }
.bsl .btn-call { background: var(--color-grey-100); color: var(--color-charcoal); border-color: var(--color-grey-200); width: 36px; min-width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
.bsl .btn-call:hover { background: var(--color-charcoal); color: var(--color-white); border-color: var(--color-charcoal); }
.bsl .btn-lg { padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-6); font-size: var(--text-sm); border-radius: var(--radius-full); }
.bsl .btn-primary { background: var(--color-red); color: var(--color-white); border-color: var(--color-red); padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-8); border-radius: var(--radius-full); font-size: var(--text-base); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.bsl .btn-primary:hover { background: #b50930; border-color: #b50930; box-shadow: var(--shadow-red); }
.bsl .btn-full { width: 100%; }

/* No Results */
.bsl .no-results { grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: var(--space-20) 0; }
.bsl .no-results-gem { color: var(--color-gold); opacity: 0.35; margin: 0 auto var(--space-6); }
.bsl .no-results-title { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: var(--text-2xl); color: var(--color-charcoal); margin-bottom: var(--space-3); }
.bsl .no-results-sub { font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--color-grey-500); }

/* Modal */
.bsl .modal-close { position: absolute; top: var(--space-4); right: var(--space-4); background: var(--color-grey-100); border: none; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; color: var(--color-grey-700); transition: background var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast); }
.bsl .modal-close:hover { background: var(--color-grey-200); color: var(--color-charcoal); }
.bsl .modal-header { padding-right: var(--space-10); margin-bottom: var(--space-6); }
.bsl .modal-header h2 { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: var(--text-2xl); color: var(--color-charcoal); margin-bottom: var(--space-1); }
.bsl .modal-header .modal-store-name { font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-grey-500); }

/* Form */
.bsl .form-group { margin-bottom: var(--space-4); }
.bsl .form-group label { display: block; font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-grey-700); margin-bottom: var(--space-2); }
.bsl .form-group input, .bsl .form-group select, .bsl .form-group textarea { width: 100%; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4); border: 1.5px solid var(--color-grey-300); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--color-charcoal); background: var(--color-white); transition: border-color var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast); outline: none; appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; }
.bsl .form-group input:focus, .bsl .form-group select:focus, .bsl .form-group textarea:focus { border-color: var(--color-gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(211, 11, 57, 0.18); }
.bsl .form-group input::placeholder, .bsl .form-group textarea::placeholder { color: var(--color-grey-500); }
.bsl .form-group input[readonly] { background: var(--color-grey-100); color: var(--color-grey-700); cursor: default; border-color: var(--color-grey-200); }
.bsl .form-group textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 90px; line-height: 1.6; }
.bsl .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--space-4); }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .bsl .form-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.bsl .form-divider { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-grey-200); margin: var(--space-5) 0; }

/* Booking Success */
.bsl .booking-success { text-align: center; padding: var(--space-8) 0; }
.bsl .success-icon-wrap { width: 64px; height: 64px; background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.1); border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0 auto var(--space-5); color: #15803d; }
.bsl .booking-success h3 { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: var(--text-2xl); color: var(--color-charcoal); margin-bottom: var(--space-3); }
.bsl .booking-success p { font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-grey-500); line-height: 1.7; }

/* Detail Page Components */
.bsl .detail-card { background: var(--color-white); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: var(--space-6); border: 1px solid var(--color-grey-200); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

.bsl .store-gallery { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--space-3); }
.bsl .gallery-img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; border-radius: var(--radius-md); display: block; }
.bsl .detail-card-title { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-gold); margin-bottom: var(--space-5); }
.bsl .detail-store-name { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-charcoal); line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: var(--space-4); }
.bsl .detail-meta-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-4); flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: var(--space-5); }
.bsl .detail-rating { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); }
.bsl .stars-row { display: flex; gap: 2px; color: var(--color-gold); font-size: var(--text-base); }
.bsl .detail-rating-value { font-weight: 700; font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--color-charcoal); }
.bsl .detail-review-count { font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-grey-500); }
.bsl .detail-address-block { display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); margin-bottom: var(--space-4); font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--color-grey-700); line-height: 1.6; }
.bsl .detail-address-block svg { color: var(--color-gold); flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 3px; }
.bsl .detail-phone-block { display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); margin-bottom: var(--space-4); font-size: var(--text-base); }
.bsl .detail-phone-block svg { color: var(--color-gold); flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsl .detail-phone-block a { color: var(--color-charcoal); transition: color var(--transition-fast); }
.bsl .detail-phone-block a:hover { color: var(--color-red); }
.bsl .hours-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.bsl .hours-table tr td { padding: var(--space-3) 0; font-size: var(--text-sm); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-grey-100); }
.bsl .hours-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.bsl .hours-table .day-name { color: var(--color-grey-700); font-weight: 500; width: 40%; }
.bsl .hours-table .day-hours { color: var(--color-charcoal); text-align: right; }
.bsl .hours-table tr.today .day-name { color: var(--color-charcoal); font-weight: 700; }
.bsl .hours-table tr.today .day-hours { font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-red); }
.bsl .attribute-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4); }
.bsl .attribute-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-charcoal); }
.bsl .attribute-item svg { color: var(--color-gold); flex-shrink: 0; }
.bsl .language-chips { display: flex; gap: var(--space-2); flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: var(--space-2); }
.bsl .lang-chip { padding: 3px 10px; background: rgba(211, 11, 57, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(211, 11, 57, 0.25); border-radius: var(--radius-full); font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--color-charcoal); font-weight: 500; }
.bsl .map-embed-wrap iframe { border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); display: block; }

/* Loading */
.bsl .stores-loading { grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: var(--space-16) 0; font-size: var(--text-base); color: var(--color-grey-500); }
</style>

<!-- ============================================================
     HTML — SINGLE-PAGE APP (listing + detail in one)
     ============================================================ -->
<div class="bsl" id="beyonStoreLocator">

  <!-- ===== VIEW: STORE LISTING ===== -->
  <div id="bslListView">

    <!-- Search & Filter -->
    <section class="search-section" aria-label="Search stores">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="filter-group">
          <div class="search-bar" role="search">
            <span class="search-icon" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>
            </span>
            <input type="search" id="bslSearch" name="storeSearch" placeholder="" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search stores" />
            <span class="search-flip-placeholder" id="bslFlipHolder" aria-hidden="true">
              Search by <span class="flip-word" id="bslFlipWord">city</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <button class="location-btn" id="bslLocBtn" type="button" aria-label="Find stores near me">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2a10 10 0 0 1 10 10c0 5.52-10 12-10 12S2 17.52 2 12A10 10 0 0 1 12 2z"/></svg>
            Use My Location
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- City Picker -->
    <section class="city-section" aria-label="Filter by city">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="city-row" id="bslCityRow" role="group" aria-label="City filter"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- Store Grid -->
    <main class="store-section" id="bslMain">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="section-meta">
          <h2 class="section-title">Our Stores</h2>
          <p class="store-count" id="bslCount" aria-live="polite"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="store-grid" id="bslGrid" role="list" aria-label="Store listings"></div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- ===== VIEW: STORE DETAIL ===== -->
  <div id="bslDetailView" style="display:none;">
    <div class="detail-action-bar" id="bslActionBar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Store quick actions">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="detail-action-bar-inner">
          <p class="store-breadcrumb">
            <a id="bslBackLink">← All Stores</a>
            <span id="bslBreadcrumb" style="margin-left:8px; color: var(--color-grey-500);"></span>
          </p>
          <div class="detail-ctas" id="bslDetailCtas"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <main class="detail-content" id="bslDetailContent">
      <div class="container">
        <div class="detail-grid">
          <div class="detail-main" id="bslDetailMain">
            <div style="text-align:center; padding: 4rem 0; color: var(--color-grey-500);"><p>Loading store details…</p></div>
          </div>
          <aside class="detail-sidebar" id="bslDetailSidebar"></aside>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- ===== BOOKING MODAL ===== -->
  <div class="modal-overlay hidden" id="bslModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="bslModalTitle">
    <div class="modal">
      <button class="modal-close" id="bslCloseModal" aria-label="Close booking form">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg>
      </button>
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h2 id="bslModalTitle">Book a Visit</h2>
        <p class="modal-store-name" id="bslModalStoreName">at Beyon Jewels</p>
      </div>
      <form class="booking-form" id="bslBookingForm" novalidate>
        <p class="form-section-label">Your Details</p>
        <div class="form-row">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="bslBkName">Full Name <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
            <input type="text" id="bslBkName" name="name" placeholder="Your name" required autocomplete="name" />
          </div>
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="bslBkPhone">Phone <span aria-hidden="true">*</span></label>
            <input type="tel" id="bslBkPhone" name="phone" placeholder="+91 00000 00000" required autocomplete="tel" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <hr class="form-divider" />
        <p class="form-section-label">Store & Time</p>
        <div class="form-row">
          <div class="form-group">
            <label for="bslBkCity">City</label>
            <input type="text" id="bslBkCity" name="city" readonly />

          <label for="bslBkNotes">Special Requests</label>
          <textarea id="bslBkNotes" name="notes" placeholder="Tell us about the occasion or any preferences…"></textarea>

      <div id="bslBookingSuccess" style="display:none;">
        <div class="booking-success">
          <div class="success-icon-wrap">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>
          </div>
          <h3>Appointment Requested</h3>
          <p>We've received your request and will confirm your appointment shortly via email or phone.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<!-- ============================================================
     ALL JAVASCRIPT INLINED
     ============================================================ -->
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ============================================================
     DATA LAYER (from data.js)
     ============================================================ */
  var CLIENT_ID = '230000171';
  var API_URL   = 'https://api-digitalwall.xploro.io/Google/GetBranchData/' + CLIENT_ID;
  var STORES    = [];
  var DAY_NAMES = ['SUNDAY','MONDAY','TUESDAY','WEDNESDAY','THURSDAY','FRIDAY','SATURDAY'];
  var DAY_SHORT = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];

  var CITY_PATTERNS = [
    'Mumbai','Navi Mumbai','Thane','Delhi','New Delhi','Bengaluru','Bangalore',
    'Pune','Chennai','Hyderabad','Kolkata','Ahmedabad','Surat','Jaipur','Lucknow',
    'Kochi','Cochin','Chandigarh','Indore','Bhopal','Nagpur','Visakhapatnam','Vadodara'
  ];

  function extractCity(address) {
    var lower = (address || '').toLowerCase();
    for (var i = 0; i < CITY_PATTERNS.length; i++) {
      if (lower.indexOf(CITY_PATTERNS[i].toLowerCase()) !== -1) return CITY_PATTERNS[i];
    }
    return 'Other';
  }

  function parseHours(storeHrs) {
    if (!storeHrs || typeof storeHrs !== 'object') return [];
    return Object.entries(storeHrs).map(function (entry) {
      var day = entry[0], range = entry[1];
      var parts = range.split(' - ');
      return { day: day.toUpperCase(), open: (parts[0] || '').trim(), close: (parts[1] || '').trim() };
    });
  }

  function fetchPage(page, pageSize) {
    var body = new URLSearchParams({ StoreCode: '', page: page, page_size: pageSize });
    return fetch(API_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: body.toString()
    }).then(function (res) {
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('API error: ' + res.status);
      return res.json();
    }).then(function (data) {
      if (data.Status !== 1) throw new Error('API status: ' + data.Status);
      return data.LocationInfo || [];
    });
  }

  function loadStores() {
    var PAGE_SIZE = 50;
    var page = 1;
    var all = [];

    function nextPage() {
      return fetchPage(page, PAGE_SIZE).then(function (batch) {
        all = all.concat(batch);
        if (batch.length < PAGE_SIZE) return all;
        page++;
        return nextPage();
      });
    }

    return nextPage().then(function (results) {
      STORES.length = 0;
      results.forEach(function (loc, i) {
        STORES.push({
          store_id:      'loc_' + (i + 1),
          name:           loc.StoreDisplayName || loc.BranchName || 'Store ' + (i + 1),
          city:           extractCity(loc.StoreAddress),
          coordinates:   { lat: loc.Latitude, lng: loc.Longitude },
          address:        loc.StoreAddress || '',
          maps_url:       loc.ReviewPageURL || null,
          phone:          loc.PhoneNumber || '',
          rating:         loc.GoogleAverageRating || 0,
          review_count:   loc.TotalGoogleReviewCount || 0,
          regular_hours:  parseHours(loc.StoreHrs),
          photos:         [],
          attributes:    { parking: false, languages: [] }
        });
      });
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     HELPERS
     ============================================================ */
  function getNowIST() {
    return new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }));
  }
  function toMinutes(t) { var p = t.split(':').map(Number); return p[0] * 60 + p[1]; }
  function formatTime(t) {
    var p = t.split(':').map(Number);
    var h = p[0], m = p[1];
    return (h % 12 || 12) + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ' ' + (h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM');
  }
  function getStoreStatus(store) {
    var now = getNowIST();
    var todayName = DAY_NAMES[now.getDay()];
    var todayHours = store.regular_hours.find(function (h) { return h.day === todayName; }) || null;
    if (!todayHours) return { isOpen: false, todayHours: null };
    var currentMin = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
    return { isOpen: currentMin >= toMinutes(todayHours.open) && currentMin < toMinutes(todayHours.close), todayHours: todayHours };
  }
  function haversineKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
    var R = 6371;
    var dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
    var dLon = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
    var a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
    return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  }

  /* ============================================================
     SVG ICONS
     ============================================================ */
  var ICONS = {
    clock:      '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>',
    phone:      '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-8.63-3.07A19.5 19.5 0 0 1 4.69 12a19.79 19.79 0 0 1-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 0 1 3.6 1.28h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72c.127.96.361 1.903.7 2.81a2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L7.91 8.91a16 16 0 0 0 6.08 6.08l1.79-1.79a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45c.907.339 1.85.573 2.81.7A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92z"/></svg>',
    directions: '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="3 11 22 2 13 21 11 13 3 11"/></svg>',
    calendar:   '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"/><line x1="16" y1="2" x2="16" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="2" x2="8" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="10" x2="21" y2="10"/></svg>',
    location:   '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2a10 10 0 0 1 10 10c0 5.52-10 12-10 12S2 17.52 2 12A10 10 0 0 1 12 2z"/></svg>',
    pin:        '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 10c0 7-9 13-9 13s-9-6-9-13a9 9 0 0 1 18 0z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/></svg>',
    gem:        '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="56" height="56" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="12 2 22 8.5 22 15.5 12 22 2 15.5 2 8.5 12 2"/><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="22"/><polyline points="2 8.5 12 13 22 8.5"/></svg>',
    phoneLg:    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 0 1-8.63-3.07A19.5 19.5 0 0 1 4.69 12a19.79 19.79 0 0 1-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 0 1 3.6 1.28h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.72c.127.96.361 1.903.7 2.81a2 2 0 0 1-.45 2.11L7.91 8.91a16 16 0 0 0 6.08 6.08l1.79-1.79a2 2 0 0 1 2.11-.45c.907.339 1.85.573 2.81.7A2 2 0 0 1 22 16.92z"/></svg>',
    parking:    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/><path d="M9 17V7h4a3 3 0 0 1 0 6H9"/></svg>',
    globe:      '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/><path d="M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg>'
  };

  /* ============================================================
     STATE
     ============================================================ */
  var currentCity   = 'all';
  var currentSearch = '';
  var bookingStoreId = null;
  var currentView   = 'list'; // 'list' or 'detail'

  /* ============================================================
     DOM REFS
     ============================================================ */
  var $  = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var listView   = $('bslListView');
  var detailView = $('bslDetailView');

  /* ============================================================
     VIEW SWITCHING (replaces multi-page navigation)
     ============================================================ */
  function showListView() {
    currentView = 'list';
    listView.style.display = '';
    detailView.style.display = 'none';
    // Scroll to top of the widget
    var root = $('beyonStoreLocator');
    if (root) root.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }

  function showDetailView(storeId) {
    currentView = 'detail';
    listView.style.display = 'none';
    detailView.style.display = '';
    renderDetailPage(storeId);
    var root = $('beyonStoreLocator');
    if (root) root.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER — STORE CARD
     ============================================================ */
  function createStoreCard(store) {
    var status = getStoreStatus(store);
    var isOpen = status.isOpen;
    var todayHours = status.todayHours;
    var reopensText = todayHours ? 'Reopens at ' + formatTime(todayHours.open) : 'Closed';
    var statusBadge = isOpen
      ? '<span class="badge badge--open"><span class="badge-dot"></span>Open Now</span>'
      : '<span class="badge badge--closed"><span class="badge-dot"></span>' + reopensText + '</span>';
    var hoursText = todayHours
      ? formatTime(todayHours.open) + ' – ' + formatTime(todayHours.close)
      : 'Hours unavailable';
    var mapsUrl = 'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=' + encodeURIComponent(store.name + ', ' + store.address);

    var article = document.createElement('article');
    article.className = 'store-card';
    article.setAttribute('data-store-id', store.store_id);
    article.setAttribute('data-city', store.city);

    article.innerHTML =
      '<div class="card-image">' +
        '<div class="card-image-badge">' + statusBadge + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="card-content">' +
        '<div class="card-header">' +
          '<span class="card-name">' + store.name + '</span>' +
          '<div class="card-rating">' +
            '<span class="rating-star">★</span>' +
            '<span class="rating-value">' + store.rating + '</span>' +
            '<span class="rating-count">(' + store.review_count + ')</span>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<p class="card-address">' + store.address + '</p>' +
        '<div class="card-info-row">' + ICONS.clock + '<span>Today: ' + hoursText + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="card-info-row">' + ICONS.phone + '<span>' + store.phone + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="card-footer">' +
          '<div class="btn-container">' +
            '<button class="btn btn-book js-open-booking" data-store-id="' + store.store_id + '" aria-label="Book appointment at ' + store.name + '">' + ICONS.calendar + ' Book a Visit</button>' +
            '<a href="' + mapsUrl + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn btn-directions js-stop-prop" aria-label="Get directions to ' + store.name + '">' + ICONS.directions + ' Directions</a>' +
            '<a href="tel:' + store.phone + '" class="btn btn-call js-stop-prop" aria-label="Call ' + store.name + '">' + ICONS.phone + '</a>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>';

    article.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      if (e.target.closest('.js-open-booking') || e.target.closest('.js-stop-prop')) return;
      showDetailView(store.store_id);
    });

    return article;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER — STORE GRID
     ============================================================ */
  function filterStores(searchTerm, city) {
    var term = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
    return STORES.filter(function (store) {
      var matchesCity   = city === 'all' || store.city === city;
      var matchesSearch = !term
        || store.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1
        || store.city.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1
        || store.address.toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1;
      return matchesCity && matchesSearch;
    });
  }

  function renderStores() {
    var grid    = $('bslGrid');
    var countEl = $('bslCount');
    var filtered = filterStores(currentSearch, currentCity);

    grid.innerHTML = '';

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      grid.innerHTML =
        '<div class="no-results">' +
          '<div class="no-results-gem">' + ICONS.gem + '</div>' +
          '<p class="no-results-title">No stores found</p>' +
          '<p class="no-results-sub">Try a different city or search term.</p>' +
        '</div>';
    } else {
      filtered.forEach(function (store) { grid.appendChild(createStoreCard(store)); });
    }

    if (countEl) {
      countEl.innerHTML = '<strong>' + filtered.length + '</strong> store' + (filtered.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' found';
    }
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER — CITY TILES
     ============================================================ */
  function renderCityTiles() {
    var cities = ['all'].concat([...new Set(STORES.map(function (s) { return s.city; }))]);
    var row = $('bslCityRow');
    if (!row) return;

    row.innerHTML = cities.map(function (city) {
      return '<button class="city-tile' + (city === currentCity ? ' active' : '') + '" data-city="' + city + '">' +
        (city === 'all' ? 'All Cities' : city) + '</button>';
    }).join('');

    row.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var tile = e.target.closest('.city-tile');
      if (!tile) return;
      currentCity = tile.dataset.city;
      row.querySelectorAll('.city-tile').forEach(function (t) { t.classList.remove('active'); });
      tile.classList.add('active');
      renderStores();
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     RENDER — DETAIL PAGE (SPA version)
     ============================================================ */
  function renderDetailPage(storeId) {
    var store = STORES.find(function (s) { return s.store_id === storeId; });

    if (!store) {
      $('bslDetailMain').innerHTML =
        '<div style="text-align:center; padding: 4rem 0;">' +
          '<p style="font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-charcoal); margin-bottom: 1rem;">Store Not Found</p>' +
          '<a style="color: var(--color-gold); font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; cursor:pointer;" class="js-back-list">← Back to all stores</a>' +
        '</div>';
      return;
    }

    /* Breadcrumb */
    $('bslBreadcrumb').textContent = '/ ' + store.name;

    /* Status */
    var now = getNowIST();
    var dayIdx = now.getDay();
    var todayName = DAY_NAMES[dayIdx];
    var todayHours = store.regular_hours.find(function (h) { return h.day === todayName; });
    var curMin = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes();
    var isOpen = todayHours ? curMin >= toMinutes(todayHours.open) && curMin < toMinutes(todayHours.close) : false;

    var statusBadge = isOpen
      ? '<span class="badge badge--open"><span class="badge-dot"></span>Open Now</span>'
      : '<span class="badge badge--closed"><span class="badge-dot"></span>Closed</span>';

    var closingNote = isOpen && todayHours
      ? '<span style="font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--color-grey-500); margin-left:8px;">Closes at ' + formatTime(todayHours.close) + '</span>'
      : (todayHours && !isOpen)
        ? '<span style="font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--color-grey-500); margin-left:8px;">Opens at ' + formatTime(todayHours.open) + '</span>'
        : '';

    /* Stars */
    var fullStars = Math.round(store.rating);
    var starsHtml = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      starsHtml += '<span style="color:' + (i < fullStars ? 'var(--color-gold)' : 'var(--color-grey-300)') + '">★</span>';
    }

    /* Google Maps URLs */
    var mapsUrl = 'https://maps.google.com/?q=' + encodeURIComponent(store.name) + '&ll=' + store.coordinates.lat + ',' + store.coordinates.lng + '&z=17';
    var dirUrl  = 'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=' + encodeURIComponent(store.name + ', ' + store.address);

    /* CTA Bar */
    $('bslDetailCtas').innerHTML =
      '<a href="tel:' + store.phone + '" class="btn btn-call btn-lg" aria-label="Call ' + store.name + '">' +
        ICONS.phoneLg + '<span class="btn-label">Call Store</span></a>' +
      '<a href="' + dirUrl + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="btn btn-directions btn-lg">' +
        ICONS.directions + '<span class="btn-label">Directions</span></a>' +
      '<button class="btn btn-book btn-lg js-open-booking-detail" data-store-id="' + store.store_id + '" type="button">' +
        ICONS.calendar + ' Book a Visit</button>';

    /* Hours Table */
    var hoursRows = DAY_NAMES.map(function (day, idx) {
      var h = store.regular_hours.find(function (r) { return r.day === day; });
      var isToday = idx === dayIdx;
      return '<tr class="' + (isToday ? 'today' : '') + '">' +
        '<td class="day-name">' + DAY_SHORT[idx] + (isToday ? ' <span style="font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--color-gold);letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;">Today</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="day-hours">' + (h ? formatTime(h.open) + ' – ' + formatTime(h.close) : 'Closed') + '</td></tr>';
    }).join('');

    /* Main Content */
    $('bslDetailMain').innerHTML =
      '<div class="detail-card">' +
        '<h1 class="detail-store-name">' + store.name + '</h1>' +
        '<div class="detail-meta-row">' + statusBadge + closingNote +
          '<div class="detail-rating"><div class="stars-row">' + starsHtml + '</div>' +
            '<span class="detail-rating-value">' + store.rating + '</span>' +
            '<span class="detail-review-count">(' + store.review_count + ' reviews)</span></div></div>' +
        '<div class="detail-address-block">' + ICONS.pin +
          '<div><p>' + store.address + '</p>' +
            '<a href="' + mapsUrl + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--color-gold); letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(211,11,57,0.4); padding-bottom:1px; display:inline-block; margin-top:6px;">View on Google Maps</a></div></div>' +
        '<div class="detail-phone-block">' + ICONS.phoneLg +
          '<a href="tel:' + store.phone + '">' + store.phone + '</a></div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="detail-card">' +
        '<p class="detail-card-title">Location</p>' +
        '<div class="map-embed-wrap">' +
          '<iframe src="https://maps.google.com/maps?q=' + store.coordinates.lat + ',' + store.coordinates.lng + '&z=17&output=embed" ' +
            'width="100%" height="280" style="border:0; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); display:block;" ' +
            'allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade" title="Map of ' + store.name + '"></iframe></div></div>';

    /* Sidebar */
    $('bslDetailSidebar').innerHTML =
      '<div class="detail-card">' +
        '<p class="detail-card-title">Opening Hours</p>' +
        '<table class="hours-table" aria-label="Store opening hours"><tbody>' + hoursRows + '</tbody></table></div>' +
      '<div class="detail-card" style="margin-top: var(--space-5);">' +
        '<p class="detail-card-title">Book a Visit</p>' +
        '<p style="font-size:var(--text-sm); color:var(--color-grey-500); margin-bottom:var(--space-5); line-height:1.6;">Drop by to play with jewellery<br>Or honestly, just come in for a cup of coffee!</p>' +
        '<button class="btn btn-primary btn-full js-open-booking-detail" data-store-id="' + store.store_id + '" type="button">Book a Visit</button></div>';

    /* Wire detail booking buttons */
    detailView.querySelectorAll('.js-open-booking-detail').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () { openBookingModal(btn.dataset.storeId); });
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     BOOKING MODAL
     ============================================================ */
  function openBookingModal(storeId) {
    bookingStoreId = storeId;
    var store   = STORES.find(function (s) { return s.store_id === storeId; });
    var modal   = $('bslModal');
    var formEl  = $('bslBookingForm');
    var successEl = $('bslBookingSuccess');

    if (!modal) return;
    if (formEl) { formEl.reset(); formEl.style.display = ''; }
    if (successEl) { successEl.style.display = 'none'; }

    if (store) {
      $('bslModalStoreName').textContent = 'at ' + store.name;
      $('bslBkCity').value  = store.city;
      $('bslBkStore').value = store.name;
    }

    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    setTimeout(function () {
      var first = modal.querySelector('input');
      if (first) first.focus();
    }, 100);
  }

  function closeBookingModal() {
    var modal = $('bslModal');
    if (!modal) return;
    modal.classList.add('hidden');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    bookingStoreId = null;
  }

  function handleBookingSubmit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var form = e.target;
    var name  = form.elements['name']  ? form.elements['name'].value.trim()  : '';
    var phone = form.elements['phone'] ? form.elements['phone'].value.trim() : '';
    var date  = form.elements['date']  ? form.elements['date'].value         : '';

    if (!name || !phone || !date) {
      alert('Please fill in all required fields.');
      return;
    }

    // Log appointment (replace with real API call in production)
    console.log('Appointment Request:', {
      store: form.elements['store'] ? form.elements['store'].value : '',
      city:  form.elements['city']  ? form.elements['city'].value  : '',
      name: name, phone: phone, date: date,
      notes: form.elements['notes'] ? form.elements['notes'].value : ''
    });

    $('bslBookingForm').style.display = 'none';
    $('bslBookingSuccess').style.display = '';
  }

  /* ============================================================
     USE MY LOCATION
     ============================================================ */
  function handleUseMyLocation() {
    var btn = $('bslLocBtn');
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      alert('Geolocation is not supported by your browser.');
      return;
    }
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Locating…'; btn.disabled = true; }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      function (position) {
        var lat = position.coords.latitude, lng = position.coords.longitude;
        var closest = STORES.reduce(function (best, store) {
          var d = haversineKm(lat, lng, store.coordinates.lat, store.coordinates.lng);
          return d < best.dist ? { store: store, dist: d } : best;
        }, { store: null, dist: Infinity });

        if (closest.store) {
          currentCity = closest.store.city;
          currentSearch = '';
          var searchInput = $('bslSearch');
          if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';
          renderCityTiles();
          renderStores();
        }
        if (btn) { btn.innerHTML = ICONS.location + ' Use My Location'; btn.disabled = false; }
      },
      function () {
        alert('Unable to retrieve your location.');
        if (btn) { btn.innerHTML = ICONS.location + ' Use My Location'; btn.disabled = false; }
      }
    );
  }

  /* ============================================================
     FLIP PLACEHOLDER ANIMATION
     ============================================================ */
  function initFlipPlaceholder() {
    var words   = ['city', 'store name', 'pincode'];
    var wordEl  = $('bslFlipWord');
    var holder  = $('bslFlipHolder');
    var input   = $('bslSearch');
    var idx = 0;

    function flipTo(next) {
      wordEl.classList.add('flip-out');
      setTimeout(function () {
        wordEl.textContent = next;
        wordEl.classList.remove('flip-out');
        wordEl.classList.add('flip-in');
        setTimeout(function () { wordEl.classList.remove('flip-in'); }, 220);
      }, 220);
    }

    setInterval(function () {
      idx = (idx + 1) % words.length;
      flipTo(words[idx]);
    }, 2200);

    input.addEventListener('input', function () {
      holder.classList.toggle('hidden', input.value.length > 0);
    });
    input.addEventListener('focus', function () { holder.classList.add('hidden'); });
    input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
      if (!input.value) holder.classList.remove('hidden');
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     BOOT
     ============================================================ */
  function showLoading() {
    var grid = $('bslGrid');
    if (grid) grid.innerHTML = '<div class="stores-loading">Loading stores…</div>';
  }

  function showLoadError() {
    var grid = $('bslGrid');
    if (grid) grid.innerHTML =
      '<div class="no-results">' +
        '<div class="no-results-gem">' + ICONS.gem + '</div>' +
        '<p class="no-results-title">Could not load stores</p>' +
        '<p class="no-results-sub">Please try refreshing the page.</p>' +
      '</div>';
  }

  function init() {
    showLoading();

    loadStores().then(function () {
      renderCityTiles();
      renderStores();

      /* Search input */
      var searchInput = $('bslSearch');
      if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function (e) {
          currentSearch = e.target.value;
          renderStores();
        });
      }

      /* Location button */
      var locBtn = $('bslLocBtn');
      if (locBtn) locBtn.addEventListener('click', handleUseMyLocation);

      /* Event delegation for booking buttons in grid */
      var grid = $('bslGrid');
      if (grid) {
        grid.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          var bookBtn = e.target.closest('.js-open-booking');
          if (bookBtn) {
            e.preventDefault();
            openBookingModal(bookBtn.dataset.storeId);
          }
        });
      }

      /* Modal close */
      var closeBtn = $('bslCloseModal');
      if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeBookingModal);

      var modal = $('bslModal');
      if (modal) modal.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === modal) closeBookingModal(); });

      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeBookingModal(); });

      /* Booking form */
      var bookingForm = $('bslBookingForm');
      if (bookingForm) bookingForm.addEventListener('submit', handleBookingSubmit);

      /* Back to list link */
      var backLink = $('bslBackLink');
      if (backLink) backLink.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); showListView(); });

      /* Flip placeholder */
      initFlipPlaceholder();

    }).catch(function (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load stores:', err);
      showLoadError();
    });
  }

  /* Wait for DOM — works whether script is in <head> or <body> */
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- ============================================================

<style>
/* === variables.css === */

.bsl .city-section { background: var(--color-white); padding: var(--space-4) 0 var(--space-5); }

.bsl .modal-overlay.hidden { display: none; }
.bsl .modal { background: var(--color-white); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); padding: var(--space-8); width: 100%; max-width: 560px; max-height: 92vh; overflow-y: auto; position: relative; animation: bslSlideUp var(--transition-base) ease; }
@keyframes bslFadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }

}

.bsl .location-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5); background: var(--color-white); border: 1.5px solid var(--color-gold); border-radius: var(--radius-full); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-charcoal); cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--transition-fast); white-space: nowrap; }
